items.detail: Significant progress has been made in automated problem-solving using societies of agents powered by large language models (LLMs). In finance, efforts have largely focused on single-agent systems handling specific tasks or multi-agent frameworks independently gathering data. However, the multi-agent systems' potential to replicate real-world trading firms' collaborative dynamics remains underexplored. TradingAgents proposes a novel stock trading framework inspired by trading firms, featuring LLM-powered agents in specialized roles such as fundamental analysts, sentiment analysts, technical analysts, and traders with varied risk profiles. The framework includes Bull and Bear researcher agents assessing market conditions, a risk management team monitoring exposure, and traders synthesizing insights from debates and historical data to make informed decisions. By simulating a dynamic, collaborative trading environment, this framework aims to improve trading performance. Detailed architecture and extensive experiments reveal its superiority over baseline models, with notable improvements in cumulative returns, Sharpe ratio, and maximum drawdown, highlighting the potential of multi-agent LLM frameworks in financial trading. TradingAgents is available at https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents.
items.title_zh: TradingAgents：基于多智能体大语言模型的金融交易框架
items.detail_zh: 在利用由大语言模型提供动力的代理人组成的社会自动解决问题方面取得了重大进展。在财务方面，工作主要集中于处理具体任务的单一代理系统或独立收集数据的多代理框架。然而，多种代理系统复制现实世界贸易公司合作动力的潜力仍然没有得到充分利用。贸易代理公司提出了一个新的股票交易框架，其灵感来自贸易公司，其特点是由LLM驱动的代理公司具有基本分析师、情绪分析师、技术分析师和具有不同风险特征的贸易商等专门作用。该框架包括公牛和熊的研究人员评估市场状况、风险管理小组监测风险，以及贸易商从辩论和历史数据中综合见解，以作出知情决定。这个框架通过模拟一个充满活力、协作的贸易环境，旨在改善贸易业绩。详细的架构和广泛的实验表明其优于基线模型，在累积收益、夏普比率和最大缩减方面有显著改善，突出了多种代理人LLM框架在金融交易中的潜力。贸易代理商可在https://github.com/TauricResearch/TradingAgents查询。
items.subtitle_zh: 虽然大语言模型驱动的多智能体系统已经能够协作解决复杂问题，金融领域的既有研究仍主要依赖单一 Agent，或者让多个 Agent 独立收集信息，尚未充分模拟真实交易公司的协作机制。TradingAgents 借鉴交易机构的组织方式，为基本面、市场情绪、技术分析和不同风险偏好的交易设置专门角色，并加入多空研究员辩论与风险管理团队，最终由交易 Agent 综合辩论与历史数据形成决策。

items.detail: The success of large-scale pre-training paradigm, exemplified by Large Language Models (LLMs), has inspired the development of Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs). However, their application to financial candlestick (K-line) data remains limited, often underperforming non-pre-trained architectures. Moreover, existing TSFMs often overlook crucial downstream tasks such as volatility prediction and synthetic data generation. To address these limitations, we propose Kronos, a unified, scalable pre-training framework tailored to financial K-line modeling. Kronos introduces a specialized tokenizer that discretizes continuous market information into token sequences, preserving both price dynamics and trade activity patterns. We pre-train Kronos using an autoregressive objective on a massive, multi-market corpus of over 12 billion K-line records from 45 global exchanges, enabling it to learn nuanced temporal and cross-asset representations. Kronos excels in a zero-shot setting across a diverse set of financial tasks. On benchmark datasets, Kronos boosts price series forecasting RankIC by 93% over the leading TSFM and 87% over the best non-pre-trained baseline. It also achieves a 9% lower MAE in volatility forecasting and a 22% improvement in generative fidelity for synthetic K-line sequences. These results establish Kronos as a robust, versatile foundation model for end-to-end financial time series analysis. Our pre-trained model is publicly available at https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos.
items.title_zh: Kronos：面向金融市场 K 线语言的基础模型
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLMS)为典型的大规模培训前范式的成功，启发了时代系列基础模型(TSFM)的发展。然而，它们在金融烛台(K线)数据的应用仍然有限，往往表现不佳的未经事先培训的架构。此外，现有的TSFMs往往忽略了波动预测和合成数据生成等关键的下游任务。为了克服这些限制，我们提议克罗诺斯(Kronos)，一个适合财务K线模型化的统一，可扩展的预培训框架。克罗诺斯引入了一种专门的代号器，将连续的市场信息曲解成代号序列，同时保留价格动态和贸易活动模式。我们预先训练克罗诺斯 利用一个自旋目标 在一个巨大的，多市场 超过120亿K线记录 从45个全球交易所，使其能够学习 细微的时间和跨资产表述。 Kronos在零镜头的设定中表现优异，跨越了各种财务任务。在基准数据集上，Kronos将价格系列预测RankIC比领先的TSFM提升93%，比最佳非预培训基线提升87%。它还在波动性预测中实现了9%的MAE，合成K线序列的基因忠诚度提高了22%。这些结果将Kronos确立为一个强有力的多功能的基础模型，用于对端到端的财务时间序列进行分析。我们经过预先培训的模型可在https://github.com/shiyu-coder/Kronos上公开查阅。
items.subtitle_zh: 大规模预训练推动了时间序列基础模型的发展，但这些模型用于金融 K 线数据时仍经常不如专门训练的架构，也容易忽略波动率预测、合成数据生成等下游任务。Kronos 提出面向金融 K 线的统一、可扩展预训练框架：使用专用 Tokenizer 将连续市场信息离散化，同时保留价格变化与交易活动模式，并在涵盖全球多个交易所的大规模跨市场 K 线数据上进行自回归预训练，以学习跨时间和资产的表示。

items.detail: Advances in frontier coding agents have sharply increased the token costs of AI-assisted software engineering. Their token efficiency is typically evaluated on isolated tasks, whereas real-world developers use them to continuously build, update, and maintain large-scale projects. This mismatch motivates us to evaluate agents over sequences of realistic coding tasks, where we find that agents exhibit recurring environment-dependent token costs that existing methods struggle to reduce. To minimize these costs, we introduce TokenEconomizer, an external controller that cuts environment-specific token costs over a sequence of tasks. These cuts come from determining (i) which operational micro-skills to inject, (ii) which persistently irrelevant tools to prune, and (iii) when to intervene in unproductive failure loops. Across Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot CLI paired with frontier models, TokenEconomizer reduces the average token cost by 18.4-30.9% with comparable task success. Savings hold in every repository under every tested agent-model setting and generalize to diverse domains such as sequential web development and security auditing, where costs fall by 6.4-21.2% depending on task structure. Our work establishes adaptive black-box cost control as a promising direction for reducing token costs of coding agents in realistic settings.
items.title_zh: TokenEconomizer：经验驱动的编码代理黑盒成本控制
items.detail_zh: 前沿编码代理商的进步使AI辅助软件工程的象征性成本急剧增加。他们的象征效率通常在孤立的任务上得到评价，而现实世界的开发者则利用它们来持续地构建，更新和维护大型项目。这种不匹配促使我们评价代理商超越现实的编码任务的序列，我们发现代理商表现出经常性的以环境为依存的象征性成本，而现有方法难以减少这些成本。为了尽量减少这些成本，我们引入了TokenEconomizer，一个外部控制器，通过一系列任务削减特定环境的象征性成本。这些削减来自于确定：(一) 注入哪些操作性微型技能，(二) 哪些工具一直无关紧要，以及(三) 何时干预非生产性故障循环。在Claude Code， Codex，和 GitHub 副驾驶CLI 与前沿模型对齐， TokenEconomizer 将平均代币成本降低了18.4%-30.9%，并取得了相似的任务成功。在每个经测试的代理模式设置下，每个存储库都有节余，并被概括到不同领域，如连续的网络开发和安全审计，根据任务结构，成本下降6.4至21.2%。我们的工作建立了适应性的黑盒成本控制，作为在现实环境中降低编码剂象征性成本的有希望的方向。

items.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World

items.detail: LLM agents' capabilities depend not only on their underlying models but also on their execution harnesses. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising approach to automatically evolve these harnesses. However, deploying RSI in open-world settings still faces two critical challenges. First, open-world tasks are typically unseen during the harness design phase and novel at test time, leaving no ground-truth verifiers to reliably guide online harness edits. Second, the RSI process remains highly task-specific and fails to generalize to novel scenarios. We introduce Harness^2, a plug-and-play, recursive agent harnessing framework that addresses these challenges through two connected levels of recursion. Task-level recursion refines the current task's harness using a contrastive Propose-Probe-Compose step that reliably guides edits without ground-truth verifiers, and can be scaled further via parallel or sequential recursion. Harnessing-level recursion then extracts experience from these edits to update a continual improvement harness, enabling the agent to better adapt to future tasks. Across three professional benchmarks and four model-harness configurations, a single step consistently improves GLM-5 and Gemini 3.5 Flash over their base harnesses, yielding gains of up to 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench, 4.5 points on JobBench, and 11.8 percentage points on LAB, with further gains as the task-level recursion budget increases.
items.title_zh: Harness^2：面向开放世界的递归式 Agent Harness 优化
items.detail_zh: LLM代理的能力不仅取决于其基本模式，还取决于其执行手段。递归自我改进(RSI)为自动发展这些绳索提供了一个很有希望的方法。然而，在开放世界环境中部署区域安全倡议仍然面临两个重大挑战。首先，开放世界的任务通常在利用设计阶段和试验时不为人知，没有地面实况核查员可靠地指导在线利用编辑。第二， " 区域倡议 " 进程仍然高度具体的任务，未能概括为新情况。我们引入了Harness ^2，一个插座与游戏，递归剂的利用框架，通过两个相互关联的递归层次来应对这些挑战。任务层面的重复利用对比性的提议-预测步骤改进了当前任务的利用，该步骤可靠地指导没有地面真实核查员的编辑工作，并通过平行或相继的重复可以进一步缩小。然后利用这些编辑的经验来更新不断改进的利用率，使代理人能够更好地适应未来的任务。通过三个专业基准和四个模型harness配置，一个步骤持续改进了GLM-5和双子座3.5 闪烁他们的底盘，在WorkBuddy-Bench上收获高达11.5分，在JobBench上收获4.5分，在LAB上收获11.8个百分点，随着任务层次的递归预算的增加，进一步收益。
items.subtitle_zh: LLM Agent 的能力不仅取决于底层模型，也取决于执行它的 Harness。递归自我改进（RSI）有望自动优化这些执行框架，但开放世界任务带来两个关键难题：一是测试时遇到的新任务通常没有标准答案验证器，难以可靠指导在线修改；二是现有 RSI 方法高度依赖具体任务，难以迁移到新场景。Harness^2 提出一套即插即用的双层递归框架：任务层通过对比式“提出—探测—组合”过程改进当前 Harness，并支持并行或串行扩展；更高层则尝试积累可迁移的优化经验。

items.detail: This report presents VibeVoice, a novel model designed to synthesize long-form speech with multiple speakers by employing next-token diffusion, which is a unified method for modeling continuous data by autoregressively generating latent vectors via diffusion. To enable this, we introduce a novel continuous speech tokenizer that, when compared to the popular Encodec model, improves data compression by 80 times while maintaining comparable performance. The tokenizer effectively preserves audio fidelity while significantly boosting computational efficiency for processing long sequences. Thus, VibeVoice can synthesize long-form speech for up to 90 minutes (in a 64K context window length) with a maximum of 4 speakers, capturing the authentic conversational ``vibe'' and surpassing open-source and proprietary dialogue models.
items.detail_zh: 本报告介绍了VibeVoice，这是一种新颖的模型，旨在通过使用近位传播来合成长式语音和多位扬声器，这是一种通过传播自旋生成潜在向量来模拟连续数据的统一方法。为了实现这一点，我们引入了一种新颖的连续语音表示器，与流行的Encodec模型相比，在保持可比性能的同时将数据压缩提高了80倍。标语器有效地保存了音频忠贞性，同时大大提高了处理长序列的计算效率。因此，VibeVoice可以合成最长90分钟的长式语音(在64K上下文窗口长度)，最多4个扬声器，捕捉真实的对白"vibe'，并超越开源和专有的对话模式。

items.title: FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution

items.detail: Frontier open-weight models are increasingly available, but serving them still largely assumes datacenter infrastructure. We present FreeToken, an edge-native MoE serving system that treats a personal machine not as a small GPU, but as a unified, elastic inference platform. FreeToken co-designs the full serving stack, including model layout and loading, expert residency, CPU--GPU execution, agentic state reuse, and runtime memory management, around two realities of local AI: agent workloads continuously change their execution pattern, and edge hardware exposes heterogeneous resources whose balance differs from machine to machine. Rather than committing to a fixed offloading strategy, FreeToken continuously maps computation and model state onto the resources actually available. FreeToken supports more than 20 MoE models and real coding and tool-using agents across hardware ranging from an 8GB laptop GPU to a single workstation GPU. More importantly, it changes what these machines can practically serve, from a 35B model on a laptop to a 284B model on a gaming desktop and the 753B GLM-5.2 on a single workstation GPU. FreeToken turns open weights into deployable local software, making the machines users already own a practical platform for frontier-scale intelligence. We release the system at flashml.ai.
items.title_zh: FreeToken：高效边疆部 与 Bandwidth 辅助执行
items.detail_zh: 边疆开放重量模型越来越多，但为这些模型服务在很大程度上仍假定数据中心基础设施。我们介绍FreeToken，一种边缘内置的MOE服务系统，它不把个人机器当作一个小的GPU，而是作为一个统一的弹性推论平台。 FreeToken共同设计了完整的服务堆栈，包括模型布局和加载，专家居住，CPU-GPU执行，代理状态再利用，以及运行时间内存管理，围绕本地AI的两个现实：代理工作量不断改变其执行模式，边缘硬件暴露出不同的资源，其平衡因机器而异。 FreeToken没有致力于固定的卸载战略，而是不断将计算和模型状态映射到实际可用的资源中。 FreeToken支持超过20个MOE模型以及从8GB笔记本电脑GPU到单一工作站GPU等跨硬件的真实编码和工具使用代理。更重要的是，它改变了这些机器实际上能够服务的东西，从笔记本电脑上的35B型改为游戏桌面上的284B型和单一工作站GPU上的753B GLM-5.2型。 FreeToken将开放的权重转化为可部署的本地软件，使得机器用户已经拥有了一个实用的前沿规模智能平台。我们发布系统 在闪存。

items.title: Unlimited OCR Works
items.subtitle: Recently, end-to-end OCR models, exemplified by DeepSeek OCR, have once again thrust OCR into the spotlight. A widely held view is that employing a large language model (LLM) as the decoder allows the model to leverage the prior distribution of language, leading to improved OCR performance. However, the downside is equally evident: as the output sequence lengthens, the accumulated KV cache drives up memory consumption and progressively slows down generation. items.detail: Recently, end-to-end OCR models, exemplified by DeepSeek OCR, have once again thrust OCR into the spotlight. A widely held view is that employing a large language model (LLM) as the decoder allows the model to leverage the prior distribution of language, leading to improved OCR performance. However, the downside is equally evident: as the output sequence lengthens, the accumulated KV cache drives up memory consumption and progressively slows down generation. This stands in stark contrast to humans, who exhibit no such decline in efficiency during long-horizon copying tasks. In this technical report, we propose Unlimited OCR, a model designed to emulate human parsing working memory. Taking DeepSeek OCR as the baseline, we replace all attention layers in the decoder with our proposed Reference Sliding Window Attention (R-SWA), which reduces attention computation costs while maintaining a constant KV cache throughout the entire decoding process. By combining the high compression rate of DeepSeek OCR's encoder with our constant KV cache design, Unlimited OCR can transcribe dozens of pages of documents in a single forward pass under a standard maximum length of 32K. More importantly, R-SWA is a general-purpose parsing attention mechanism - beyond OCR, it is equally applicable to tasks such as ASR, translation, etc. Codes and model weights are publicly available at http://github.com/baidu/Unlimited-OCR.

items.detail_zh: 最近，端到端的OCR模型，以Deep Seek OCR为例，再次将OCR推向了聚光灯。广泛持有的观点是，使用大语言模型(LLM)作为解码器可以让模型利用语言的事先分布，导致OCR性能的提高。然而，下行同样明显：随着输出序列的延长，累积的KV缓存驱动内存消耗，并逐渐减慢生成速度。这与人类形成了鲜明的对照，在长距离复制任务中，人类的效率并没有下降。在这份技术报告中，我们提出无限OCR，这个模型旨在模仿人类解析工作记忆。将DeepSeek OCR作为基线，我们用我们提议的参考滑动窗口注意(R-SWA)来取代解码器中的所有注意层，这降低了注意计算成本，同时在整个解码过程中保持一个恒定的KV缓存。通过将DeepSeek OCR编码器的高压缩速率与我们恒定的KV缓存设计相结合，无限制的OCR可以在标准最高长度为32K的单个前传中将数十页文件转录。更重要的是，R-SWA是一种通用的解析注意力机制——除了OCR之外，它同样适用于ASR，翻译等任务。代码和模型权重在http://github.com/baidu/Unlimited-OCR上公开。

items.detail: Robot-use Agents (RUAs) have shown promising zero-shot manipulation capabilities, but reliance on frontier, proprietary models limits research into further training. To democratize RUA research, we introduce uni-robot-agent, a unified harness for competitive open-weight robot use that supports further training. Without privileged inputs, an out-of-the-box Qwen3.8-Flash-Next achieves a RoboDojo Score of 31.39, surpassing the published GPT-6 Astra-RoboProbe result of 28.97 and many VLA/WAM baselines, and performs competitively on 19 real-world tasks. Our analysis across model generations, families, and sizes links effective robot use to four general capabilities, suggesting that future RUA training should develop them jointly.

items.detail: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha mattes. Architecturally, we integrate a lightweight pixel decoder into the VLM via a special <OBJ> token to generate instance-level pixel outputs. We train the model with a three-stage curriculum SFT followed by mixed-task RL. Across over 30 benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL demonstrates leading performance on both object-level and pixel-level tasks, while maintaining robust rejection for object-absent queries. By releasing WeVisOne-VL to the open-source community, we hope to advance VLMs from broad visual understanding toward truly reliable perception systems for real-world deployment.
items.title_zh: WeVisOne-VL：从对象到像素的统一视觉感受
items.detail_zh: 现有的视觉语言模型(VLMs)对于精细的视觉感知仍然不可靠。在本报告中，我们介绍了WeVisOne-VL(WeChat Vision All-in-One)，这是一种强大的VLM，通过结构化的下个托肯预测，统一对象级和像素级的感知。它支持多个视觉任务，包括对象检测，转介本地化，计数，OCR，分区化，以及交配，使得任何用户特定颗粒的本地化，从点和盒到面具和α垫。在建筑上，我们通过一个特殊的<OBJ>令牌，将一个轻量级像素解码器整合到VLM中，以生成实例级像素输出。我们用三个阶段的课程来训练这个模型 SFT 然后是混合任务RL。在超过30个基准中，WeVisOne-VL在对象级别和像素级别的任务中都表现出领先性能，同时对对象偏差查询保持强烈拒绝。通过将WeVisOne-VL释放给开源社区，我们希望将VLM从广义的视觉理解推进到真正可靠的感知系统，用于现实世界的部署。

items.title: Differentiable Data Augmentation with Kornia
items.subtitle: In this paper we present a review of the Kornia differentiable data augmentation (DDA) module for both for spatial (2D) and volumetric (3D) tensors. This module leverages differentiable computer vision solutions from Kornia, with an aim of integrating data augmentation (DA) pipelines and strategies to existing PyTorch components (e.g. autograd for differentiability, optim for optimization). In addition, we provide a benchmark comparing different DA frameworks and a short review for a number of approaches that make use of Kornia DDA.

items.detail: Driven by rapid advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs), agents are empowered to combine intrinsic knowledge with dynamic tool use, greatly enhancing their capacity to address real-world tasks. In line with such an evolution, AgentScope introduces major improvements in a new version (1.0), towards comprehensively supporting flexible and efficient tool-based agent-environment interactions for building agentic applications. Specifically, we abstract foundational components essential for agentic applications and provide unified interfaces and extensible modules, enabling developers to easily leverage the latest progress, such as new models and MCPs. Furthermore, we ground agent behaviors in the ReAct paradigm and offer advanced agent-level infrastructure based on a systematic asynchronous design, which enriches both human-agent and agent-agent interaction patterns while improving execution efficiency. Building on this foundation, we integrate several built-in agents tailored to specific practical scenarios. AgentScope also includes robust engineering support for developer-friendly experiences. We provide a scalable evaluation module with a visual studio interface, making the development of long-trajectory agentic applications more manageable and easier to trace. In addition, AgentScope offers a runtime sandbox to ensure safe agent execution and facilitates rapid deployment in production environments. With these enhancements, AgentScope provides a practical foundation for building scalable, adaptive, and effective agentic applications.
items.title_zh: AgentScope 1.0：构建代理应用程序的开发者-子框架
items.detail_zh: 在大语言模型(LLMS)快速进步的推动下，代理人被赋予将内在知识与动态工具使用相结合的能力，极大地增强了他们处理现实世界任务的能力。根据这种演变，AgentScope在新版本(1.0)中引入了重大改进，全面支持基于工具的Agent-Environment互动，以构建Agent应用。具体而言，我们抽象出对代理应用程序至关重要的基础组件，并提供统一的接口和可扩展模块，使开发人员能够轻松地利用最新进展，如新模型和MCP。此外，我们在ReAct范式中的地面代理人行为，并提供基于系统同步设计的高级代理人一级基础设施，这丰富了人与代理人和代理人之间的互动模式，同时提高了执行效率。在这个基础上，我们综合了几个适合具体实际情况的内在代理人。 AgentScope还包括对开发者友好体验的强大工程支持。我们提供了一个带有视觉工作室界面的可伸缩评价模块，使长射剂应用的开发更便于管理，更容易追踪。此外，AgentScope还提供运行时间沙盒，以确保安全剂执行，并促进在生产环境中的快速部署。借助这些增强，AgentScope为构建可伸缩性，适应性，有效的代理应用提供了实用的基础。

items.detail: High throughput serving of large language models (LLMs) requires batching sufficiently many requests at a time. However, existing systems struggle because the key-value cache (KV cache) memory for each request is huge and grows and shrinks dynamically. When managed inefficiently, this memory can be significantly wasted by fragmentation and redundant duplication, limiting the batch size. To address this problem, we propose PagedAttention, an attention algorithm inspired by the classical virtual memory and paging techniques in operating systems. On top of it, we build vLLM, an LLM serving system that achieves (1) near-zero waste in KV cache memory and (2) flexible sharing of KV cache within and across requests to further reduce memory usage. Our evaluations show that vLLM improves the throughput of popular LLMs by 2-4times with the same level of latency compared to the state-of-the-art systems, such as FasterTransformer and Orca. The improvement is more pronounced with longer sequences, larger models, and more complex decoding algorithms. vLLM's source code is publicly available at https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm
items.title_zh: 高效的大型语言模型内存管理
items.detail_zh: 服务于大型语言模型的高吞吐量需要一次批量处理足够多的请求。然而，由于每个请求的密钥-值缓存(KV缓存)内存巨大，并不断增长和动态收缩，所以现有系统挣扎。在管理效率低下的情况下，这种内存可能会被破碎和冗余的重复大量浪费，限制了批量大小。为了解决这个问题，我们提出PagedAttenty，一种受经典虚拟内存和操作系统中的呼唤技术启发的注意力算法。在它之上，我们建造了vLLM，一个LLM服务系统，实现(1) KV缓存内存中的近零浪费，以及(2) KV缓存在请求内部和相互之间灵活共享，以进一步减少内存使用。我们的评价表明，VLLM比最新系统，如S更快的Transformer和Orca，在耐久性上提高了2-4次流行LLM的吞吐量。改进更为显著的是较长的序列，更大的模型，更复杂的解码算法。 vLLM的源代码在https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm上公开发布。

items.detail: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have opened new avenues for applying multi-agent systems in very large-scale simulations. However, there remain several challenges when conducting multi-agent simulations with existing platforms, such as limited scalability and low efficiency, unsatisfied agent diversity, and effort-intensive management processes. To address these challenges, we develop several new features and components for AgentScope, a user-friendly multi-agent platform, enhancing its convenience and flexibility for supporting very large-scale multi-agent simulations. Specifically, we propose an actor-based distributed mechanism as the underlying technological infrastructure towards great scalability and high efficiency, and provide flexible environment support for simulating various real-world scenarios, which enables parallel execution of multiple agents, centralized workflow orchestration, and both inter-agent and agent-environment interactions among agents. Moreover, we integrate an easy-to-use configurable tool and an automatic background generation pipeline in AgentScope, simplifying the process of creating agents with diverse yet detailed background settings. Last but not least, we provide a web-based interface for conveniently monitoring and managing a large number of agents that might deploy across multiple devices. We conduct a comprehensive simulation to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed enhancements in AgentScope, and provide detailed observations and discussions to highlight the great potential of applying multi-agent systems in large-scale simulations. The source code is released on GitHub at https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope to inspire further research and development in large-scale multi-agent simulations.
items.title_zh: 特工中非常大的多代理模拟
items.detail_zh: 近期大语言模型(LLMs)的进步为在非常大规模的模拟中应用多剂系统开辟了新的途径。然而，在与现有平台进行多剂模拟时，仍面临若干挑战，例如可扩展性有限、效率低、代理多样性不尽人意、以及工作密集型管理程序。为了应对这些挑战，我们为AgentScope开发了几个新的功能和组件，AgentScope是一个方便用户的多代理平台，增强了它支持非常大规模多代理模拟的方便性和灵活性。具体地说，我们提议建立一个基于行为者的分布式机制，作为实现巨大可扩展性和高效益的基础技术基础设施，并为模拟各种现实世界情景提供灵活的环境支持，从而能够同时执行多种代理人、集中工作流程协调以及代理人之间和代理人与环境之间的互动。此外，我们在AgentScope中整合了一个易于配置的工具和自动背景生成管道，简化了创建具有多样但详细背景环境的代理的程序。最后但并非最不重要的是，我们提供了一个基于网络的界面，以方便地监测和管理可能跨多个设备部署的大量代理人。我们进行了全面的模拟，以展示AgentScope中拟议的增强措施的有效性，并提供详细的观察和讨论，以强调在大规模模拟中应用多剂系统的巨大潜力。源代码发布于GitHub上的https://github.com/modelscope/agentscope，以激励在大规模多剂模拟中的进一步研发。

items.detail: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) inference on consumer hardware is bounded by weight memory: a 35B-class model is 19.5GB at 4-bit, and sparsity shrinks the compute per token, not the bytes that must be held. Naive offloading to SSD does not help on its own, because layer N+1's experts must be chosen before layer N's output exists, so the reads cannot start early enough to hide behind compute. We present Edge0, a streaming MoE inference engine that closes the gap with a prerouter: a per-layer head predicts the next layer's routing one token ahead, and the prediction is consumed as the routing itself, so the staged expert set equals the routed set and nothing is dropped. An unmerged recovery LoRA, trained on the student path, pays back the quality lost to int4 quantization and routing replacement. On a single 24GB machine, Edge0 serves a 35B MoE at 20tok/s inside 3GiB of peak active memory, within a few points of its fp16 teacher on average across five public benchmarks. An 8B tier runs on the same framework, and the framework, checkpoints, and adapters are open source.
items.title_zh: 记忆墙的另一半：使用训练列车预告服务SSD的35B MoEs
items.detail_zh: 对消费硬件的Mixture-of-experiments(MoE)推论以重量内存为界：一个35B级模型在4位时为19.5GB，而sparsity缩小了每个符的计算，而不是必须持有的字节。将直觉卸载到SSD本身无济于事，因为N+1层的专家必须在N层输出存在之前被选中，因此读数不能提前开始到隐藏在计算后。我们提出Edge0，一种用前导线关闭缺口的流动的MOE推论引擎：每层头部预测下一层的路由前方的1个符号，而预测作为路由本身消耗，所以舞台专家集等于路由集，一无所获。一次未合并的恢复LORA，在学生路径上接受培训，将损失的质量还给Int4量化和路由替换。在一台24GB单机上，Edge0在峰值活动内存的3GiB内部以20tok/s的速度为35B MoE服务，平均在fp16老师的几点范围内服务于5个公共基准。 8B级在同一框架上运行，框架、检查站和适配器是开放源码。

items.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
items.subtitle: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. items.detail: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. Third, speculative decoding is deployment-specific, and no universal optimization fits every serving regime, drafter, target model and GPU. To address these challenges, we present SpecPilot, an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each deployment. In each round, a cost model locates the largest gaps between the current system and its ceiling. Parallel agents explore directions and integrate the successful ones. Token forcing checks every output token against stock to detect reward hacking. A structured memory carries validated mechanisms to new rounds and deployments. SpecPilot discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms. We evaluate it across four target models, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks. Without training or quality loss, it raises the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46times to 10.87times with one request, and from 1.94times to 3.93times with batching.
items.title_zh: SpecPilot：光谱解码的自主算法发现和系统优化
items.detail_zh: 光谱解码加速了内存绑定的LLM解码，使用轻量级的起草器，并行的起草器通过在一条前传中起草一个整块来延长这个速度。然而，目前还不清楚它们所发布的系统(库存)是否达到平行起草许可的全部速度。我们确定了三项挑战。首先，只要有一个请求，每个步骤都接受很少的符号，但读取每个目标重量。第二，随着分批进行，按要求进行的核查工作比自动退缩(AR)解码的速度大致减半。第三，投机性解码是针对部署的，任何通用优化都不符合每个服务制度，起草者，目标模型和GPU。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了SpecPilot，一个自主的代理循环，为每次部署发现了算法和系统优化。在每一轮中，费用模型都确定了现行制度与其上限之间最大的差距。平行代理人探索方向，整合成功方向。 Token强迫检查每个输出符与股票，以发现奖励黑客。结构化的内存将经过验证的机制带入新一轮和部署。 SpecPilot发现了一种通用的无损失的12位重量格式，混合常态目标树的校验，两级校验和三个批量机制。我们通过四个目标模型、三个起草者、两个GPU平台和五个基准对其进行评估。没有训练或质量损失，它会将AR以上的速度从股票的4.46次提升到10.87次，一次请求，一次请求从1.94次提升到3.93次。

items.detail: Software is one of the most powerful tools that we humans have at our disposal; it allows a skilled programmer to interact with the world in complex and profound ways. At the same time, thanks to improvements in large language models (LLMs), there has also been a rapid development in AI agents that interact with and affect change in their surrounding environments. In this paper, we introduce OpenDevin, a platform for the development of powerful and flexible AI agents that interact with the world in similar ways to those of a human developer: by writing code, interacting with a command line, and browsing the web. We describe how the platform allows for the implementation of new agents, safe interaction with sandboxed environments for code execution, coordination between multiple agents, and incorporation of evaluation benchmarks. Based on our currently incorporated benchmarks, we perform an evaluation of agents over 15 challenging tasks, including software engineering (e.g., SWE-Bench) and web browsing (e.g., WebArena), among others. Released under the permissive MIT license, OpenDevin is a community project spanning academia and industry with more than 1.3K contributions from over 160 contributors and will improve going forward.
items.title_zh: OpenDevin： AI软件开发者作为通用代理的开放平台

items.title: Xiaomi-OCR-0 Technical Report
items.subtitle: Compact OCR-specific vision-language models achieve strong document parsing performance, but often rely on costly supervision and focus primarily on visual-text reconstruction. We introduce Xiaomi-OCR-0, a unified 0.8B model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding. We build an approximately 170M-sample OCR-centric corpus using an automated data engine that combines expert consensus, render-based verification, and targeted synthesis. Starting from Qwen3.5-0.8B, our progressive training recipe combines Q-Mask-based text anchoring, continued pretraining, and mixed-task reinforcement learning (Mix-RL). Xiaomi-OCR-0 achieves 95.24 on Real5-OmniDocBench, 96.83 on OmniDocBench v1.6, and
items.detail: Compact OCR-specific vision-language models achieve strong document parsing performance, but often rely on costly supervision and focus primarily on visual-text reconstruction. We introduce Xiaomi-OCR-0, a unified 0.8B model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding. We build an approximately 170M-sample OCR-centric corpus using an automated data engine that combines expert consensus, render-based verification, and targeted synthesis. Starting from Qwen3.5-0.8B, our progressive training recipe combines Q-Mask-based text anchoring, continued pretraining, and mixed-task reinforcement learning (Mix-RL). Xiaomi-OCR-0 achieves 95.24 on Real5-OmniDocBench, 96.83 on OmniDocBench v1.6, and 87.94 on Wild-OmniDocBench, while reaching an average score of 83.2 across five OCR-oriented VQA benchmarks. Ablations further show that, with sufficient parsing training, OCR-centric understanding supervision provides additional gains for document parsing. Homepage: https://huggingface.co/spaces/SeerRay-Lab/Xiaomi-OCR-0.
items.title_zh: 小米-OCR-0技术报告
items.detail_zh: 紧凑的OCR特有视觉语言模型实现了强大的文档解析性能，但往往依赖于昂贵的监督并主要专注于视觉文字重建。我们引入了Xiaomi-OCR-0，一个统一的0.8B模型，用于文档解析和OCR-中心理解。我们利用一个自动化数据引擎，将专家的共识、基于渲染的核查和有针对性的综合结合起来，建立一个大约170M-样本OCR中心体。从Qwen3.5-0.8B开始，我们的渐进式训练菜谱结合了以Q-mask为基础的文本主锚，持续预训，以及混合任务强化学习(Mix-RL)。小米-OCR-0在Real5-OmniDoc Bench上实现了95.24分，在OmniDoc Bench v1.6上实现了96.83分，在Wild-OmniDoc Bench上实现了87.94分，同时在面向OCR的VQA5个基准上达到了83.2分的平均分。拨款情况进一步表明，经过充分的解析培训，以OCR为中心的理解监督为文件解析提供了额外的收益。主页：https://huggingface.co/spaces/SeerRay-Lab/小米-OCR-0。

items.detail: The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is built from hair cards: artist-placed ribbons whose geometry is the visible hair, animated by spring bones. Existing image-based methods produce realistic hair or a single fused mesh, while CHARM, the only generator of stylized hair cards, decodes a hairstyle autoregressively as a long sequence of control points. Observing that a card hairstyle is an unordered set of artist-defined primitives, we propose HairDeck, which generates it as one: each card is a single token, and a set diffusion transformer denoises all cards together. From a single image, HairDeck generates the cards and the spring-bone chains that drive them, yielding an animatable asset that exports to ready-to-use downstream formats. On CHARM's own test set, it lowers Chamfer distance by 44% and card-orientation error by more than half while running 33 times faster, and from single images it outperforms CHARM, image-to-3D pipelines and strand-based methods. Project page: https://hyzcluster.github.io/HairDeck
items.title_zh: HairDeck：动画-从单一图像中提取的静态发卡
items.detail_zh: 游戏和相声中花纹化人物的发型由发卡来构建：艺术家-被放置的丝带，其几何是可见发型，由春骨作动画。现有的以图像为基础的方法产生出现实的发型或单个被引信的网状发型，而CHARM作为分型发卡的唯一生成器，自动地将发型解码为长序的控制点。观察到一卡通发型是一组无序由艺术家定义的原始人，我们提出"海尔德克"(HairDeck)，将它产生为一卡通：每张卡是一单一的符牌，而一集扩散变压器会将所有卡片都一起放出。 HairDeck从一幅相片中生成出卡和驱动出卡的弹簧骨链，从而产生出一个向现成使用下游格式输出的可想象资产。在CHARM自己的测试设定上，它将Chamfer距离降低了44%，卡向误差在运行快33倍时降低了一半以上，从单个图像来看，它的表现超过了CHARM，图像到到到3D的管道和线程方法。项目网页：https://hyz cluster.github.io/HairDeck

items.detail: This report describes ARIS (Auto-Research-in-sleep), an open-source research harness for autonomous research, including its architecture, assurance mechanisms, and early deployment experience. The performance of agent systems built on LLMs depends on both the model weights and the harness around them, which governs what information to store, retrieve, and present to the model. For long-horizon research workflows, the central failure mode is not a visible breakdown but a plausible unsupported success: a long-running agent can produce claims whose evidential support is incomplete, misreported, or silently inherited from the executor's framing. Therefore, we present ARIS as a research harness that coordinates machine-learning research workflows through cross-model adversarial collaboration as a default configuration: an executor model drives forward progress while a reviewer from a different model family is recommended to critique intermediate artifacts and request revisions. ARIS has three architectural layers. The execution layer provides more than 65 reusable Markdown-defined skills, model integrations via MCP, a persistent research wiki for iterative reuse of prior findings, and deterministic figure generation. The orchestration layer coordinates five end-to-end workflows with adjustable effort settings and configurable routing to reviewer models. The assurance layer includes a three-stage process for checking whether experimental claims are supported by evidence: integrity verification, result-to-claim mapping, and claim auditing that cross-checks manuscript statements against the claim ledger and raw evidence, as well as a five-pass scientific-editing pipeline, mathematical-proof checks, and visual inspection of the rendered PDF. A prototype self-improvement loop records research traces and proposes harness improvements that are adopted only after reviewer approval.
items.title_zh: ARIS：通过横向多代理协作进行自主研究
items.detail_zh: 本报告介绍了ARIS(Auto-Reledge-in-sleep)，这是一种用于自主研究的开源研究工具，包括其架构，保证机制，以及早期部署经验。以LLMS为基础的代理系统的性能取决于模型重量及其周围的牵引力，这些牵引力支配着存储、检索和提交模型的信息。对于长视研究工作流程来说，中央故障模式并不是一个明显的崩溃，而是一种可能得不到支持的成功：一个长期运行的代理商可以提出其证据支持不完整，报告错误，或者默默继承自执行人的设定。因此，我们把ARIS作为一个研究工具，通过跨模型对抗性协作协调机器学习研究工作流程，作为默认的配置：一个执行器模型推动进步，而来自不同模型家族的审查员则被推荐批评中间文物并要求修改。 ARIS有三个建筑层。执行层提供了超过65个可重复使用的Markdown定义技能，通过MCP的模型集成，一个用于迭代重用先前发现的持久研究wiki，以及确定性的数字生成。管弦乐层协调五个端到端的工作流程，具有可调整的工作设置和可配置的路由到审查者模型。保证层包括一个三阶段程序，用于检查实验性索赔是否有证据支持：完整性核实、结果对索赔的映射、对照索赔分类账和原始证据对手稿报表进行交叉核对的索赔审计，以及五通科学编辑管道、数学防伪检查和对提供的PDF进行直观检查。一个原型的自改进循环记录研究痕迹，并提议在审查者批准后才采用的利用改进。

items.detail: We introduce MinerU2.5, a 1.2B-parameter document parsing vision-language model that achieves state-of-the-art recognition accuracy while maintaining exceptional computational efficiency. Our approach employs a coarse-to-fine, two-stage parsing strategy that decouples global layout analysis from local content recognition. In the first stage, the model performs efficient layout analysis on downsampled images to identify structural elements, circumventing the computational overhead of processing high-resolution inputs. In the second stage, guided by the global layout, it performs targeted content recognition on native-resolution crops extracted from the original image, preserving fine-grained details in dense text, complex formulas, and tables. To support this strategy, we developed a comprehensive data engine that generates diverse, large-scale training corpora for both pretraining and fine-tuning. Ultimately, MinerU2.5 demonstrates strong document parsing ability, achieving state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks, surpassing both general-purpose and domain-specific models across various recognition tasks, while maintaining significantly lower computational overhead.
items.title_zh: MinerU2.5：高效高分辨率文档解析脱钩的视野-语言模型
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍MinerU2.5，这是一个1.2B参数文件，分析视觉语言模型，在保持特殊计算效率的同时，实现最新识别精度。我们的方法采用了粗糙的、两阶段的解析战略，将全球布局分析与当地内容识别脱钩。在第一阶段，该模型对下取样的图像进行高效的布局分析，以识别结构元素，绕过处理高分辨率输入的计算间接费用。在第二阶段，它以全球布局为指导，对从原始图像中提取的原生分辨率作物进行目标明确的内容识别，保留密集文本、复杂公式和表格中的精细细节。为了支持这一战略，我们开发了一个全面的数据引擎，为预训和微调产生多样化的大规模培训公司。归根结底，MinerU2.5显示出强大的文件解析能力，在多种基准上实现了最先进的性能，超越了各种识别任务的通用模式和特定领域模式，同时维持了显著较低的计算间接费用。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable prowess in generating contextually coherent responses, yet their fixed context windows pose fundamental challenges for maintaining consistency over prolonged multi-session dialogues. We introduce Mem0, a scalable memory-centric architecture that addresses this issue by dynamically extracting, consolidating, and retrieving salient information from ongoing conversations. Building on this foundation, we further propose an enhanced variant that leverages graph-based memory representations to capture complex relational structures among conversational elements. Through comprehensive evaluations on LOCOMO benchmark, we systematically compare our approaches against six baseline categories: (i) established memory-augmented systems, (ii) retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with varying chunk sizes and k-values, (iii) a full-context approach that processes the entire conversation history, (iv) an open-source memory solution, (v) a proprietary model system, and (vi) a dedicated memory management platform. Empirical results show that our methods consistently outperform all existing memory systems across four question categories: single-hop, temporal, multi-hop, and open-domain. Notably, Mem0 achieves 26% relative improvements in the LLM-as-a-Judge metric over OpenAI, while Mem0 with graph memory achieves around 2% higher overall score than the base configuration. Beyond accuracy gains, we also markedly reduce computational overhead compared to full-context method. In particular, Mem0 attains a 91% lower p95 latency and saves more than 90% token cost, offering a compelling balance between advanced reasoning capabilities and practical deployment constraints. Our findings highlight critical role of structured, persistent memory mechanisms for long-term conversational coherence, paving the way for more reliable and efficient LLM-driven AI agents.
items.title_zh: Mem0：搭建具有可伸缩长期记忆的制作- Ready AI代理
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型在生成背景一致的响应方面表现出了显著的优势，但其固定的上下文窗口对在长时间的多会对话中保持一致性构成根本性挑战。我们介绍Mem0，一种可伸缩的以记忆为中心的架构，它通过动态地提取，整合，以及从正在进行的对话中获取显著信息来解决这个问题。在这个基础上，我们进一步提出了一种增强的变体，利用基于图表的内存表达来捕捉对话要素之间的复杂关系结构。通过对LOCOMO基准的全面评价，我们系统地将我们的方法与六个基准类别进行比较：(一) 已建立的内存增强系统，(二) 具有不同块大小和k值的检索增强生成(RAG)，(三) 处理整个对话历史的完整文本方法，(四) 开源内存解决方案，(五) 专有模式系统，(六) 专用内存管理平台。经验结果显示，我们的方法在四个问题类别中，即单跳、时跳、多跳和开放域，持续地超过所有现有的内存系统。值得注意的是，Mem0比OpenAI在LLM-as-a-Judge度量上实现了26%的相对改进，而具有图内存的Mem0的总得分则比基础配置高出约2%。除了准确性提高之外，我们还显著降低了计算间接费用，而不是全文方法。尤其是，Mem0的p95延迟度降低91%，节省了90%以上的象征性费用，在先进的推理能力与实际部署限制之间提供了令人信服的平衡。我们的调查结果突出了结构合理、持久的记忆机制对于长期对话一致性的关键作用，为更可靠、更高效的LLM驱动AI代理铺平了道路。

items.title: A decoder-only foundation model for time-series forecasting
items.subtitle: Motivated by recent advances in large language models for Natural Language Processing (NLP), we design a time-series foundation model for forecasting whose out-of-the-box zero-shot performance on a variety of public datasets comes close to the accuracy of state-of-the-art supervised forecasting models for each individual dataset. Our model is based on pretraining a patched-decoder style attention model on a large time-series corpus, and can work well across different forecasting history lengths, prediction lengths and temporal granularities.

items.detail: Assistants from 2011 answered and waited, and agents from 2023 did a task and stopped. In September 2026 Meta's Muse showed an agent for one person, with accounts, devices, memory and a conversation that lasts, closed, in a vendor's cloud, in one country. Such an agent is expected to act on a person's accounts and devices, remember them across weeks, speak first when it is worth it, and answer for what it did. It is a kind of software, not a model, and until now had no open counterpart. This report defines the personal agent in five questions and three horizons. It reads how Muse is built from Meta's public record and a copy of its production prompt, each statement marked by its source. It then presents nanoMuse, the open-source counterpart under the GPL-3.0, one agent on every device a person owns, with hands on the phone's screen and the computer's. They share one conversation over a relay anyone can run; every action goes through a Sentinel, memory is files the person can read, and the model is their choice. Its size and cost are given as estimates. What is open, memory with provenance, an evaluation suite for the hands and an open model for them, is set out as a roadmap.
items.title_zh: 纳米Muse：每个设备的开源个人代理
items.detail_zh: 2011年的助理回答并等待，2023年的特工做了一项任务并停下来。 2026年9月，Meta's Muse为一人展示了一名经纪人，其账户，设备，内存和对话持续，关闭，在一个卖家的云中，在一个国家。这样的代理人应该根据一个人的帐户和装置行事，在几周内记住这些帐户和装置，在值得的时候首先发言，并对它的所作所为负责。它是一种软件，不是模型，直到现在还没有开放的对应物。这份报告在五个问题和三个视野中定义了个人代理人。它读到Muse是如何从Meta的公开记录和它制作的即时副本中构建的，每个声明都有其来源的标记。然后呈现纳米Muse，GPL-3.0下的开源对应器，在一个人拥有的每个设备上都有一个代理，手机屏幕和计算机上都有手。他们通过一个接力分享一个对话 任何人都可以运行；每一个动作都通过一个哨兵，记忆是个人能够读到的文件，模型是他们的选择。其规模和费用作为估计数列出。开放的、有原产地的记忆、手的一套评价套件和手的开放式模型都作为路线图列出。

items.detail: We introduce PaddleOCR-VL-1.6, an upgraded compact document parsing model built upon PaddleOCR-VL-1.5. Although PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 establishes a strong 0.9B baseline, its remaining errors concentrate in under-optimized regions where model behavior is unstable, data coverage is sparse, or supervision is unreliable. Rather than expanding the training corpus indiscriminately, PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 introduces a region-aware data optimization framework that identifies weak regions from the previous model, applies targeted enhancement to these regions, and improves the reliability of supervision signals. It further adopts a progressive post-training recipe based on curated data selection and reinforcement learning, pushing model performance to a higher level through staged optimization. PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 achieves a new state-of-the-art score of 96.33% on OmniDocBench v1.6, demonstrates strong competitiveness against top-tier VLMs, and provides a practical post-training recipe for the PaddleOCR-VL series.
items.title_zh: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6：扩展文件解析范围与未优化区域 完善和渐进后培训
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了PaddleOCR-VL-1.6，这是一个基于PaddleOCR-VL-1.5的升级压缩文件解析模型。尽管PaddleOCR-VL-1.5确立了一个强大的0.9B基线，但其剩余错误集中在模型行为不稳定、数据覆盖不足或监管不可靠的地区。 PaddleOCR-VL-1.6没有不加区别地扩大培训内容，而是引入了一个区域意识数据优化框架，从以前的模型中找出薄弱区域，对这些区域进行有针对性的增强，并提高监督信号的可靠性。它进一步采用了基于整理数据选择和强化学习的渐进式培训后方法，通过分阶段优化将模型性能推向更高水平。 PaddleOCR-VL-1.6在OmniDoc Bench v1.6上实现了96.33%的新高分数，表现出了对顶级VLM的强大竞争力，并为PaddleOCR-VL系列提供了实用的训练后配方。

items.detail: Recent closed-source image generation systems can produce diverse visual content from simple compositions to information-dense graphics, yet open-weight text-to-image models still struggle with dense text and intricate layouts. To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. Second, we develop an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancement (PE) module that translates diverse user requests into detailed content and layout specifications. Together, they enable MOSS-Image to generate text-rich and layout-coherent images. We further introduce LongLongTextBench (LLTB) for evaluating long-form English and Chinese text rendering, and RealLayoutArena (RLA) for end-to-end layout-rich generation. MOSS-Image achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models on LLTB, with an average text coverage of 96.3%. On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.
items.title_zh: 最低业务安全标准-图像技术报告
items.detail_zh: 最近的闭源图像生成系统可以产生从简单的组成到信息密集的图形的不同视觉内容，然而开放式的文本到图像模型仍然与密集的文本和复杂的布局相抗衡。为了缩小这一差距，我们引入了MOSS-Image，一种开放的生成系统，将高真性视觉合成与意向意识组成相结合。首先，我们用精心设计的食谱，从头开始预先训练5B型单流扩散变压器(DIT)，使双语长式文本渲染和精确布局控制成为可能。第二，我们开发了一个意向意识的即时增强(PE)模块，将不同的用户请求转化为详细的内容和布局规格。它们共同使MOSS-Image生成内容丰富且布局一致的图像。我们进一步引入了LongLongText Bench(LLTB)来评价长式英文和中文文本渲染，以及RealLayoutArena(RLA)来评价端到端布局丰富的一代。 MOSS-Image在LLTB上的开放量级模型中实现了最先进的性能，平均文本覆盖率为96.3%。在RALA方面，MOSS-Image在端对端系统比较中排名第二，而其骨干在使用共享增强提示器评价的发电机中排名第一。我们将发布模式、培训食谱和评价框架，以支持进一步研究，并促进文本到图像社区。

items.detail: Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. At the system level, an outer world-data-model flywheel continuously incorporates open-world corpus and leverages evolving model weaknesses to guide subsequent data construction and optimization iterations. At the data level, an inner flywheel couples open-world seeding and autocatalytic propagation. The former mines authentic workflows as seed tasks from instructional videos, and employs visual-semantic dual-path trajectory reconstruction; The latter transforms these seeds into reusable primitives for controllable synthesis of diverse, complex, and verifiable tasks. To enable efficient and reliable trajectory collection, we further introduce a feedback-guided snapshot-rollback retry mechanism in various real environments. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CUA-Master-27B achieves competitive performance across GUI-only and GUI-CLI hybrid benchmarks, scoring 80.2 on OSWorld Verified, 36.9 on OSWorld 2.0, 43.9 on WeaveBench, and 25.0 on Agents' Last Exam. Our framework also substantially improves the quality and efficiency of data synthesis, and exhibits continuous gains across recursive iterations.
items.title_zh: CUA-Master：通过开放世界递减改进来扩大计算机使用代理
items.detail_zh: 尽管海关统一协议最近有所进展，但由于互动数据的多样性、可控制性和可靠性有限，其发展仍然受到限制。此外，常规优化管道缺乏迭接反馈，而现有的递归性改进方法往往依赖自生的经验，限制能力扩展并产生收益减少。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了CUA-Master，一个嵌入式双径回转改进框架。在系统一级，一个外部世界数据模型飞轮不断纳入开放世界体并利用不断演变的模型弱点来指导随后的数据构建并优化迭代。在数据层面，一对内层飞轮夫妇开放世界播种和自动催化传播。前地雷作为教学录像的种子工作流程，并采用视觉语义双向轨道重建；后者将这些种子转化为可再利用的原始物来可控地合成多样，复杂和可核查的任务。为了能够有效和可靠地收集轨迹，我们还在各种实际环境中引入了反馈制导快照回滚机制。广泛的实验表明，CUA-Master-27B在只使用GUI和GUI-CLI混合基准之间实现了竞争性表现，在OSWorld Verife上评分为80.2分，在OSWorld 2.0上评分为36.9分，在织本克上评分为43.9分，在代理最后考试上评分为25.0分。我们的框架还大大提高了数据综合的质量和效率，并显示在递归迭代方面的持续进展。

items.detail: We introduce SmolDocling, an ultra-compact vision-language model targeting end-to-end document conversion. Our model comprehensively processes entire pages by generating DocTags, a new universal markup format that captures all page elements in their full context with location. Unlike existing approaches that rely on large foundational models, or ensemble solutions that rely on handcrafted pipelines of multiple specialized models, SmolDocling offers an end-to-end conversion for accurately capturing content, structure and spatial location of document elements in a 256M parameters vision-language model. SmolDocling exhibits robust performance in correctly reproducing document features such as code listings, tables, equations, charts, lists, and more across a diverse range of document types including business documents, academic papers, technical reports, patents, and forms -- significantly extending beyond the commonly observed focus on scientific papers. Additionally, we contribute novel publicly sourced datasets for charts, tables, equations, and code recognition. Experimental results demonstrate that SmolDocling competes with other Vision Language Models that are up to 27 times larger in size, while reducing computational requirements substantially. The model is currently available, datasets will be publicly available soon.
items.title_zh: SmolDocling：用于端到端多模式文件转换的超共性视觉语言模型
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍SmolDocling，一种超共性视觉语言模型，瞄准端到端文档转换。我们的模型通过生成 DocTags 来全面处理整个页面，这是一种新的通用的标记格式，它将所有页面元素与位置完全结合。与依赖大型基础模型的现有方法，或依赖多种专业模型的手动管道的共聚解决方案不同，SmolDocling提供了一个端到端的转换，以便在256M参数视觉语言模型中准确捕捉文件元素的内容，结构和空间位置。 SmolDocling在正确复制文件特征(例如代码列表、表格、方程式、图表、清单)方面表现出强劲的性能，在包括商业文件、学术论文、技术报告、专利和表格在内的各种文件类型中表现得更多 -- -- 大大超出了通常观察到的科学论文重点。此外，我们还提供图表、表格、方程式和代码识别等新的公开来源数据集。实验结果显示，SmolDocling与其他尺寸可达27倍的Vision语言模型竞争，同时大幅降低了计算要求。目前已有该模型，数据集将很快公开。

items.detail: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has advanced generative model post-training in verifiable domains such as code and mathematics, but evaluating video quality, especially emotional expression, often depends on subjective aesthetics and has no uniquely correct target. Existing approaches typically rely on fixed rewards for visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment that poorly capture emotional intent and can invite reward hacking, while RLHF is difficult to scale and subject to individual aesthetic differences that complicate the calibration of facial, body motion, and chromatic cues across narrative contexts. We introduce EmoReward, a new self-evolving training mechanism that distills evidence reliability from reward traces collected during an actual training run to adaptively guide multi-reward weight allocation in subsequent training by determining which emotional evidence to trust and how much to weight it. EmoReward first plans specific grounding cues from the emotional prompt to guide evaluation, then uses heterogeneous signal primitives to score the generated video during the act stage. Reflective Reward Gating calibrates their contributions through instance-level gates for phase, face confidence, conflict, and subtlety, then renormalizes weights over the active set to produce the sample's fused reward. RewardMemory then estimates each primitive's reliability from rollout scores and outcomes within each emotional regime in the finished training run, then fixes bounded multipliers that calibrate fusion weights in the next training run without updating reward models. Experiments on HunyuanVideo 1.5 show improvements across multiple RL algorithms and compare EmoReward with other agentic reward methods under SAGE-GRPO. Ablations and transfer experiments on SD 3.5 and FLUX further support adaptive reward calibration for visual generation.
items.title_zh: EmoReward：情感视频生成的自演取回校正 RL
items.detail_zh: 集团相对政策优化(GRPO)在代码和数学等可核查领域拥有先进的基因模型后培训，但评价视频质量，特别是情感表达，往往依赖于主观美学，没有独特的正确目标。现有方法通常依赖于视觉质量、运动质量和文本对接的固定奖励，这些奖励不能很好地抓住情感意图，并可能招致奖励黑客，而RLHF则难以衡量规模，并受到个人审美差异的影响，使面部、身体运动和不同叙事背景的色调提示的校正复杂化。我们引入了EmoReward(EmoReward)，这是一种新的自我演变的训练机制，它从实际训练期间所收集的奖励痕迹中提炼出证据的可靠性，通过确定哪些情感证据可以信任，以及有多少重量来适应性地指导后续训练的多奖励分量分配。 EmoReward首先计划从情感的提示来引导评价的特定地基提示，然后在动作阶段使用多样的信号原始来分分出生成的视频。反射性奖励Gating通过实例级门校正其贡献用于相位，面对信心，冲突，和微妙性，然后将重力重于活性组进行再常化以产生样本被保险的奖励。然后，Reward Memory根据完成的训练中每个情感制度内的推出分数和结果来估计出每个原始人的可靠性，然后在下次训练中修正校正聚变分量的受限乘数，而不更新奖励模式。 HunyuanVideo 1.5上的实验显示多个RL算法的改进，并比较了SAGE-GROPO下的其他代理奖励方法。 SD 3.5和FLUX的校正和转移实验进一步支持了可视生成的适应性奖励校正。

items.detail: Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decides actions, delegation, and acceptance, while the runtime maintains state and feedback. Its three-layer architecture enables direct execution or delegation to Subagents, synchronously or asynchronously, under stable responsibilities. Through a shared application layer, humans and agents inspect and revise the same evolving documents, presentations, CAD models, and Blender scenes, so human-in-the-loop participation can enter both through conversation and through direct modification of the work itself. To sustain continuity across agents and sessions, CoworkOS further introduces hierarchical workspaces and persistent semantic memory, so working files, key decisions, and long-running Job logs remain shareable, reusable, and resumable after interruption. Across 12 benchmarks and 6 categories of real-world applications, CoworkOS proves highly competitive with frontier agent applications such as Codex and DeepSeek Harness. As a sustained-work case study, CoworkOS uses GLM-5.3 as its backbone to conduct RSI-driven automated post-training on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Over five rounds, the model's average score across eight benchmarks rose from 33.19 to 42.95 (+9.76). Looking ahead, we believe CoworkOS opens a meaningful path toward general cowork-agent intelligence.
items.title_zh: CoworkOS：真实世界自动化的缩放代理同事
items.detail_zh: 合作代理商的快速进步正在将人与AI的合作转向现实世界的自动化，交付软件，设计等文物。然而，这种生产力工作既需要高质量地完成复杂的生产力任务，也需要长期持续地监测和决策，这仍然是一项公开的挑战。我们引入了CoworkOS，一种用于长视野工作的通用工具，它把任务战略与执行管理区分开来：模型决定行动，授权和接受，而运行时间则保持状态和反馈。其三层结构使得能够以稳定的责任，同步或同步地直接执行或授权给子代理人。通过一个共享的应用层，人类和代理人检查并修改了相同的演化文件，演示，CAD模型和Blender场景，因此人入会参与可以通过对话以及直接修改作品本身进入。为了保持代理和会话之间的连续性，CowoOS进一步引入了分级的工作空间和持久的语义内存，因此工作文件，关键决定，以及长期运行的工作日志仍然可以共享，可再使用，中断后可以恢复。在12个基准和6个类别的现实世界应用中，CoworkOS被证明与诸如Codex和DeepSeek Harness等前沿代理应用具有高度的竞争力。作为持续工作的案例研究，CoworkOS使用GLM-5.3作为骨干，在Qune3.6-35B-A3B上进行RSI驱动的自动化后培训。超过5轮，该模型在8个基准中的平均分从33.19分上升到42.95分(+9.76分)。展望未来，我们相信CoworkOS打开了一条通往一般合作代理情报的有意义的道路。

items.detail: Symbolic models make melody, harmony, rhythm, and form explicit but typically stop before a finished recording; audio models produce complete songs while leaving composition implicit. We introduce YuE2, which unifies symbolic and audio music generation at frontier quality through symbolic planning. A single AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) first writes a readable score specifying melody and harmony, expands it into semantic music tokens, and realizes it as full-song audio. In comparisons using the same checkpoint, experts prefer symbolic planning for overall quality and musicality, with 49.3% of overall preferences versus 34.6% without planning. Experts also favor the unified model over a separate language model and diffusion Transformer. On WildSongBench, YuE2 scores 6.73 on SongBench Global Avg, exceeding all evaluated public baselines. Selecting from eight candidates (best-of-8), YuE2 reaches 6.96, the highest observed mean among all evaluated systems. Expert listening further establishes its competitiveness with proprietary song generators, favoring best-of-8 over Suno v4.5 and yielding nearly balanced preferences against Suno v5. To learn this generation process from recordings without aligned scores, we introduce MERT2 and SheetSage2 to supply semantic and symbolic supervision. MERT2 sets a new state of the art in music representation learning, surpassing previous best results on 14 of 15 MARBLE metrics; SheetSage2 leads 12 of 15 benchmark-metric pairs in our lead-sheet transcription comparison. The same checkpoint follows score edits while largely preserving unedited musical content and generates zero-shot covers without cover-specific training. Its readable score also enables agentic music editing, with external language models translating user feedback into revisions of the composition.
items.title_zh: YUE2：统一符号和音频音乐生成，以前沿质量
items.detail_zh: 符号模型使旋律，和谐，节奏，并形成清晰但一般在完成录制之前停止；音频模型产生完整的歌曲，同时隐含成分。我们介绍YUE2，它通过象征性的规划，统一了象征和音频音乐的制作，具有前沿质量。单曲AR-NAR Mixture-of-Transformers(MOT)首先写了一个可读的分数，指定了旋律与和谐，将其扩展为语义音乐符号，并实现为全声乐。在使用同一检查站进行比较时，专家倾向于对整体质量和音乐性进行象征性规划，49.3%的总体偏好，34.6%没有规划。专家们也赞成统一模式，而不是单独的语言模式和传播变形器。在WildSong Bench上，YuE2在Song Bench Global Avg上得分6.73，超过了所有评价的公共基线。从8名候选人(最佳8名)中挑选，YUE2达到6.96，是所有被评价系统中观察到的最高平均值。专家的倾听进一步确立了其与专有歌曲生成器的竞争力，倾向于优胜8胜于Suno v4.5，并产生对Suno v5的近乎平衡的偏好。为了从没有对齐分数的录音中学习这个生成过程，我们引入了MERT2和SeetSage2来提供语义和符号监督。 MERT2设定了音乐表现学习的新艺术水平，超越了15个MARBLE 度量衡中的14个的以往最佳成绩； SheetSage2 领先了15个基准度量配对中的12个，在我们的铅板抄录比较中。同一检查点遵循分数编辑，同时基本上保留未经编辑的音乐内容，并产生零镜头封面，而不进行特定封面训练。它的可读分数也使得代理音乐编辑成为可能，外部语言模型将用户反馈翻译为对构成的修订。

items.title: UniMate: One Unified Model to Animate Diverse Skeletons

items.detail: Recent advances in automatic rigging now deliver animation-ready 3D assets at scale, yet generating the motion to drive them remains a bottleneck. Existing learned animators are topology-constrained: they rely on category-specific templates or require per-skeleton fine-tuning and reference motions at inference. We present UniMate, a unified foundation model that synthesizes articulated motion for arbitrary skeletons from a rigged 3D asset and a text prompt, with no test-time optimization or per-skeleton retraining. UniMate introduces a topology-aware diffusion transformer, which integrates skeletal topology into attention via three mechanisms: (1) a graph-aware attention bias from pairwise joint relations and geodesic distances; (2) a spectral rotary position embedding generalizing RoPE to arbitrary kinematic trees via the graph Laplacian; and (3) a global topological conditioner attention-pooled from the rest-pose skeleton. We also curate UniML3D, 13,006 motion sequences spanning bipedal, quadrupedal, avian, marine, insectoid, serpentine, and articulated rigid objects with unified canonicalization and text pairing. Trained on this dataset, UniMate outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in quality, generalization, and efficiency, and supports zero-shot cross-topology transfer, in-betweening, expansion, and text-guided editing. Our project page is available at https://linzhanmou.com/unimate/.
items.title_zh: UniMate：将千变万化的 Skeletons 动画统一模型
items.detail_zh: 近期在自动操纵方面的进步现在可以大规模地提供动画准备的3D资产，但驱动这些资产的运动仍然是一个瓶颈。现有学习的动画师在地形学上是受制约的：他们依赖特定类别的模板，或者要求每斯凯莱顿在推论时进行微调和参考运动。我们提出UniMate，一个统一的基础模型，它从一个被操纵的3D资产和文本提示器中合成任意骨架的清晰运动，没有测试时间优化或每斯凯莱顿再培训。 UniMate引入了一种地形感知扩散变压器，通过三种机制将骨骼感知融合到注意力中：(1)对偶联关系和大地测量距离的图感知注意力偏差；(2)通过图Laplacian嵌入RoPE的光谱回转位置，将RoPE通化到任意运动树上；(3)从休眠骨架上汇集全球地形感知器注意力。我们还管理UniML3D、13 006个运动序列，这些序列跨越两面体、四面体、禽类、海洋、昆虫、蛇形动物和具有统一条形化和文本配对的刚性物体。受此数据集训练，UniMate在质量，通俗化，效率方面超越了最先进的基线，支持零镜头跨地形传输，介于间隙，扩展，以及文本引导编辑。我们的项目网页见https://linzhanmou.com/unimate/。

items.detail: We introduce Zep, a novel memory layer service for AI agents that outperforms the current state-of-the-art system, MemGPT, in the Deep Memory Retrieval (DMR) benchmark. Additionally, Zep excels in more comprehensive and challenging evaluations than DMR that better reflect real-world enterprise use cases. While existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frameworks for large language model (LLM)-based agents are limited to static document retrieval, enterprise applications demand dynamic knowledge integration from diverse sources including ongoing conversations and business data. Zep addresses this fundamental limitation through its core component Graphiti -- a temporally-aware knowledge graph engine that dynamically synthesizes both unstructured conversational data and structured business data while maintaining historical relationships. In the DMR benchmark, which the MemGPT team established as their primary evaluation metric, Zep demonstrates superior performance (94.8% vs 93.4%). Beyond DMR, Zep's capabilities are further validated through the more challenging LongMemEval benchmark, which better reflects enterprise use cases through complex temporal reasoning tasks. In this evaluation, Zep achieves substantial results with accuracy improvements of up to 18.5% while simultaneously reducing response latency by 90% compared to baseline implementations. These results are particularly pronounced in enterprise-critical tasks such as cross-session information synthesis and long-term context maintenance, demonstrating Zep's effectiveness for deployment in real-world applications.
items.title_zh: Zep：代理内存的时空知识图架构
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Zep，这是AI代理的新记忆层服务，在深记忆检索(DMR)基准中，它的表现超过了目前最先进的系统MemGPT。此外，Zep在比DMR更全面和更具挑战性的评价方面表现优异，能够更好地反映现实世界的企业使用案例。虽然基于大语言模型(LLM)的代理商的现有检索-增强生成(RAG)框架仅限于静态文件检索，但企业应用程序需要从不同来源，包括正在进行的对话和业务数据，进行动态知识整合。 Zep通过它的核心成分Graphiti来解决这一根本的局限性——一种时间意识的知识图引擎，在保持历史关系的同时，动态地合成非结构的对话数据和结构化的商业数据。在作为主要评价指标的多指标类集调查小组制定的DMR基准中，Zep显示业绩优异(94.8%对93.4%)。除了DMR，泽普的能力通过更具挑战性的LongMemEval基准进一步验证，通过复杂的时间推理任务更好地反映企业的使用案例。在本次评价中，泽普取得了实质性成果，精度提高高达18.5%，同时与基线实施相比，反应延迟度降低了90%。这些成果在跨会间信息综合和长期上下文维护等企业关键任务中尤为突出，显示出泽普在现实世界应用中的部署效果。

items.detail: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. Its instruction-tuning corpus combines over 100 educational resources and general instruction sources, organized around four capabilities: subject competence, curriculum grounding, diagnostic reasoning, and pedagogical action and scaffolding. Our pipeline integrates deterministic cleaning, semantic auditing and rewriting, task-specific quality scoring, token-budgeted diversity selection, and pedagogical instruction assignment. It yields 69,999 examples and 15.96M supervised response tokens, including 60,951 education-specific examples. We fine-tune 4B, 9B, and 27B models and evaluate curriculum grounding, K-12 problem solving, and pedagogical tutoring, alongside general capability. Education-oriented tuning consistently improves all three educational benchmark groups across model scales. OmniEdu-27B achieves 63.12% EM and 76.69% F1 on K12-Bench, 85.89% on MathFish, 86.95% on EDUMATH, and 78.74% in MathTutorBench's Scaffold setting. It also achieves the highest Teaching average on LongTutor among the evaluated models, at 3.02. These results demonstrate the value of curated, capability-balanced supervision for adapting general language models to educational tasks spanning problem solving, curriculum understanding, and instructional support.
items.title_zh: OmniEdu：开放的学习和教学基础模式
items.detail_zh: 教育基础模式必须解决问题，了解课程结构，诊断学习者的困难，并提供适当的教学支持。现有的教育语言模式往往侧重于解决问题或辅导，培训混合物按来源或任务而不是能力来安排。我们介绍OmniEdu，一个开放的K-12学习和教学的基础模式家庭。其教学调校法将100多家教育资源和一般教学来源结合起来，围绕四个能力组织：学科能力、课程基础、诊断推理、教学行动和脚手架。我们的管道将确定性清洁、语义审计和重写、特定任务的质量评分、象征性预算的多样性选择以及教学指导任务结合起来。它产生了69 999个实例和15 96M监督反应标志，包括60 951个教育特有实例。我们微调4B、9B和27B模式，评估课程基础、K-12问题的解决和教学辅导以及一般能力。以教育为导向的调整不断改善所有三个教育基准组的示范规模。 OmniEdu-27B在K12-Bench上实现63.12%EM和76.69%F1，在MathFish上达到85.89%，在EDUMATH上达到86.95%，在MathTutor Bench的脚手架设置上达到78.74%。它还在被评价的模型中实现了LongTutor教学平均最高，为3.02。这些结果表明，在使通用语言模式适应解决各种问题、理解课程和提供教学支持等教育任务方面，经过管理、能力平衡的监督很有价值。

items.detail: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems significantly advance over traditional turn-based dialogue systems, as they allow simultaneous bidirectional communication, closely mirroring human-human interactions. However, achieving low latency and natural interactions in full-duplex dialogue systems remains a significant challenge, especially considering human conversation dynamics such as interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. In this paper, we introduce a novel End-to-End GPT-based model OmniFlatten for full-duplex conversation, capable of effectively modeling the complex behaviors inherent to natural conversations with low latency. To achieve full-duplex communication capabilities, we propose a multi-stage post-training scheme that progressively adapts a text-based large language model (LLM) backbone into a speech-text dialogue LLM, capable of generating text and speech in real time, without modifying the architecture of the backbone LLM. The training process comprises three stages: modality alignment, half-duplex dialogue learning, and full-duplex dialogue learning. Throughout all training stages, we standardize the data using a flattening operation, which allows us to unify the training methods and the model architecture across different modalities and tasks. Our approach offers a straightforward modeling technique and a promising research direction for developing efficient and natural end-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue systems. Audio samples of dialogues generated by OmniFlatten can be found at this web site (https://omniflatten.github.io/).
items.title_zh: OmniFlatten：无缝语音对话的端对端GPT模型
items.detail_zh: 完全繁复的口语对话系统比传统的回合式对话系统大有进步，因为它们可以同时进行双向交流，密切地反映人与人之间的互动。然而，在全复式对话系统中实现低延迟和自然互动仍然是一个重大挑战，特别是考虑到人的对话动态，如中断、后通道和重叠的言论。在本文中，我们引入了以端对端GPT为基础的小说模型OmniFlatten，用于全复式对话，能够有效模拟低纬度的自然对话所固有的复杂行为。为了实现全方位的交流能力，我们提出一个多阶段的后培训计划，将基于文本的大型语言模型(LLM)主干逐步改编为语音-文本对话LLM，能够实时生成文本和语音，而不修改主干LLM的结构。培训过程包括三个阶段：模式调整、半复式对话学习和全复式对话学习。在所有培训阶段，我们使用一个平整操作使数据标准化，使我们能够统一不同模式和任务的训练方法和示范结构。我们的方法为发展高效的、自然的、端到端的完全复杂的口语对话系统提供了直接的建模技术和有希望的研究方向。在该网站(https://omniflatten.github.io/)可以找到OmniFlatten生成的对话框的音频样本。

items.detail: Recent progress in natural language processing has been driven by advances in both model architecture and model pretraining. Transformer architectures have facilitated building higher-capacity models and pretraining has made it possible to effectively utilize this capacity for a wide variety of tasks. Transformers is an open-source library with the goal of opening up these advances to the wider machine learning community. The library consists of carefully engineered state-of-the art Transformer architectures under a unified API. Backing this library is a curated collection of pretrained models made by and available for the community. Transformers is designed to be extensible by researchers, simple for practitioners, and fast and robust in industrial deployments. The library is available at https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.
items.title_zh: HuggingFace变身器：最先进的自然语言处理
items.detail_zh: 最近自然语言处理方面的进展是由模型架构和模型预训的进步推动的。变换器结构有助于建立更高的能力模式，预先培训使得能够有效地利用这种能力完成各种各样的任务。变形器是一个开源的图书馆，目的是向更广泛的机器学习界开放这些进步。图书馆由在统一的API下精心设计的最先进的艺术变形器建筑组成。支持这个图书馆是一套由社区提供和可供社区使用的训练有素的模型。变形器被设计成可以被研究者扩展，对从业者来说简单，在工业部署上快速而有力。该图书馆可在https://github.com/huggingface/transfers上查阅。

items.detail: Real-time vision demands models that are accurate, efficient, and simple to deploy across diverse hardware. The YOLO family has become widely deployed for this reason, yet most YOLO detectors still rely on non-maximum suppression at inference, carry heavy detection heads due to Distribution Focal Loss, require long training schedules, and can leave the smallest objects without positive label assignments. We present Ultralytics YOLO26, a unified real-time vision model family that addresses these limitations through coordinated architecture and training advances. YOLO26 uses a dual-head design for native NMS-free end-to-end inference and removes DFL entirely, yielding a lighter head with unconstrained regression range. Its training pipeline combines MuSGD, a hybrid Muon-SGD optimizer adapted from large language model training; Progressive Loss, which shifts supervision toward the inference-time head; and STAL, a label assignment strategy that guarantees positive coverage for small objects. Beyond detection, YOLO26 introduces task-specific head and loss designs for instance segmentation, pose estimation, and oriented detection, producing consistent gains across tasks and scales. The family spans five scales (n/s/m/l/x) and supports detection, instance segmentation, pose estimation, classification, and oriented detection in a single pipeline, with an open-vocabulary extension, YOLOE-26, for text-, visual-, and prompt-free inference. Across all scales, YOLO26 achieves 40.9-57.5 mAP on COCO at 1.7-11.8 ms T4 TensorRT latency, advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto front over prior real-time detectors, while YOLOE-26x reaches 40.6 AP on LVIS minival under text prompting. Code and models are available at https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics.
items.title_zh: 超解YOLO26：统一实时端对端视野模型
items.detail_zh: 实时视觉需要准确，高效，简便的模型，以在各种硬件中部署。 YOLO家族因此被广泛部署，然而大多数YOLO探测器在推论上仍然依赖非最大压制，由于分布焦距损失而携带重探测头，需要较长的训练时间表，可以让最小的物体没有正面的标签任务。我们介绍Ultralytics YOLO26，这是一个统一的实时视野模型家族，通过协调的建筑和培训进步来克服这些局限性。 YOLO26为本土NMS无端对端推论使用双头设计，并完全去除DFL，产生一个没有约束的回归范围的较轻头。其培训管道结合了MuSGD这一混合的Muon-SGD优化器，根据大型语言模式培训加以调整；进步损失，将监督转向推论时间头；和STAL，一种标签分配策略，它保证对小物体的正面覆盖。除检测外，YOLO26还引入了特定任务头和损失设计，例如分解，提出估计和定向检测，在任务和尺度之间产生一致的收益。家族跨越5个尺度(n/s/m/l/x)，支持检测，实例分解，在单一的管道中提出估计，分类，并定向检测，并带有开放式的vocabulary扩展，YOLOE-26，用于文本，视觉，以及即时的免费推断。在所有尺度上，YOLO26在COCO上以1.7至11.8 ms T4 TensorRT的耐久性达到40.9至57.5 mAP，将精度-常帕雷托正面推进到之前的实时探测器上，而YOLOE-26x在文字提示下在LVIS小val上达到40.6 AP。代码和模型见https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics。

items.detail: The rapid evolution of 3D content creation, encompassing both AI-powered methods and traditional workflows, is driving an unprecedented demand for automated rigging solutions that can keep pace with the increasing complexity and diversity of 3D models. We introduce UniRig, a novel, unified framework for automatic skeletal rigging that leverages the power of large autoregressive models and a bone-point cross-attention mechanism to generate both high-quality skeletons and skinning weights. Unlike previous methods that struggle with complex or non-standard topologies, UniRig accurately predicts topologically valid skeleton structures thanks to a new Skeleton Tree Tokenization method that efficiently encodes hierarchical relationships within the skeleton. To train and evaluate UniRig, we present Rig-XL, a new large-scale dataset of over 14,000 rigged 3D models spanning a wide range of categories. UniRig significantly outperforms state-of-the-art academic and commercial methods, achieving a 215% improvement in rigging accuracy and a 194% improvement in motion accuracy on challenging datasets. Our method works seamlessly across diverse object categories, from detailed anime characters to complex organic and inorganic structures, demonstrating its versatility and robustness. By automating the tedious and time-consuming rigging process, UniRig has the potential to speed up animation pipelines with unprecedented ease and efficiency. Project Page: https://zjp-shadow.github.io/works/UniRig/

items.detail_zh: 3D内容创作的迅速发展，包括AI驱动方法和传统工作流程，正在推动对自动操纵解决方案的前所未有的需求，这些解决方案能够跟上3D模型日益复杂和多样化的步伐。我们引入了UniRig，一种新颖的，统一的自动骨架操纵框架，它利用了大型自相回转模型的能动性，以及骨点相交机制来生成高质量的骨架和剥取重量。与之前与复杂地貌或非标准地貌相抗争的方法不同，UniRig由于新的Skeleton Tree Tokenization方法高效地将骨架内的等级关系编码，准确预测了地形上有效的骨架结构。为了训练和评价UniRig，我们提出了Rig-XL，这是一个新的大型数据集，由14 000多个操纵的三维模型组成，涵盖广泛的类别。 UniRig显著地超越了最先进的学术和商业方法，使操纵精度提高215%，使挑战数据集的运动精度提高194%。我们的方法在各种物体类别之间无缝地工作，从详细的动因字符到复杂的有机和无机结构，显示了它的多面性和坚固性。 UniRig通过将疲惫而耗时的操纵过程自动化，有可能以前所未有的便利和效率来加速动画管道。项目网页：https://zjp-shadow.github.io/works/UniRig/

items.detail: One-step and few-step text-to-image generation must accurately render the details specified in the prompt despite limited opportunities for refinement. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) uses score differences to bring the generated distribution closer to a reference distribution. Following prior work, we estimate this difference with internal velocity branches, avoiding a separate fake-score network. We ask whether an explicit moment constraint improves this learned score supervision. A decomposition of the reverse-KL field into a Gaussian moment component and a non-Gaussian residual identifies statistics that can be constrained explicitly. We introduce Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM), which retains the full DMD correction and matches feature means and per-coordinate standard deviations using the generator's exponential-moving-average (EMA) copy, requiring no external feature encoder. Experiments use full-parameter and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) tuning on Z-Image-Turbo 6B and Qwen-Image 20B. At two network evaluations, IDM reaches 94.25% and 90.20% on Chinese and English LongText-Bench, the highest scores among the compared methods at this budget. Controlled ablations show gains from the added moment loss, while generator EMA features perform competitively with an external DINOv2 encoder across the five reported metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/IDM.
items.title_zh: 内向分布匹配
items.detail_zh: 单步和少步文字到图像生成必须准确地使速报中规定的细节得到完善，尽管改进的机会有限。分布相配蒸馏(DMD)使用分数差异来使所生成的分布更接近参考分布。在之前的工作之后，我们估计了与内部速度分支的这一差异，避免了单独的假分分数网络。我们问一个明确的瞬间限制是否改善了这种对学到的分数的监督。将反向-KL字段分解为高斯瞬间元件，并分解出非高斯剩余能明确受限的统计。我们引入了 Intrinsic Distribution Matching(IDM)，它保留了完整的 DMD 校正并匹配特性手段和每个坐标标准偏差，使用生成器的指数-移动-平均(EMA)副本，不需要外部特性编码器。实验在Z-Image-Turbo 6B和Quen-Image 20B上采用全参数和低等调取(LORA)调取。在两次网络评价中，IDM在中英文"LongText-Bench"中达到94.25%和90.20%，是本预算比较方法中得分最高的。受控活化显示，增加的瞬间损失可以产生收益，而发电机EMA的特性则与外部的DINOv2编码器在五个报告度量衡上竞争。代码见https://github.com/inclucionAI/IDM。

items.detail: Scaling computer-use agents from individual actions to complex software work requires experience that connects decisions to complete outcomes. We present NorthCUA, an integrated system for turbocharging computer-use agents through experience at scale. Its Experience Flywheel supplies diverse executable tasks to the NorthCUA Harness, which sustains long interactions, records decisions, and checks task outcomes. The Flywheel uses these records to curate verified trajectories. For unsolved tasks, recursive self-improvement evolves reusable skills and preserves verified milestones so later attempts build on earlier progress. Staged Learning combines this experience with grounding data from the Flywheel to develop GUI competence through mid-training and long-horizon supervised fine-tuning. The policy then learns from fresh attempts in the same Harness through joint desktop-web reinforcement learning, closing the loop between experience production and policy improvement. The resulting Nano, Mini, and Pro family achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source models across GUI grounding, desktop execution, and Web interaction under the reported evaluation settings. For more responsive Web workflows, NorthCUA-Ultrafast pairs direct action selection with open-ended generation on pre-RL Nano, offering a measured quality-latency tradeoff. Together, these advances establish NorthCUA as a high-performing model family and a reusable foundation for agents that carry complex software work from intent to completion.
items.title_zh: 北CUA技术报告：通过规模经验充电计算机使用代理
items.detail_zh: 将计算机使用代理人从个别行动扩大到复杂的软件工作需要经验，将决定联系起来以完成结果。我们介绍NorthCUA，这是一个集成系统，通过规模经验为一体的涡轮充电计算机使用剂。其"经验"(Experience Flywheel)向NorthCUA Harness(英语：NorthCUA Harness)提供多种可执行的任务，维持了长时间的互动，记录决定，并检查任务结果。飞轮使用这些记录来校正已核实的轨迹。对于未完成的任务，递归自我改进会演变出可再用的技能并保留已核实的里程碑，因此以后的尝试会建立在更早的进展上。分阶段学习将这种经验与从飞轮上得到的地基数据结合起来，通过中试和长视野监督的微调来发展GUI能力。该政策然后通过联合桌面-网络强化学习，从同一Harness的新尝试中吸取教训，从而结束经验制作与政策改进之间的循环。由此产生的Nano、Mini和Pro Family在GUI的开源模型中实现最新结果，在所报告的评价设置下实现桌面执行和Web互动。对于更具有响应力的Web工作流程，NorthCUA-Ultrafast在RL Nano前作上与可开放的一代对接直接动作选择，提供量度质量相对应。这些进步共同将NorthCUA确立为一个高性能的模范家族，并为从意图到完成的复杂软件工作的代理商提供了可重复使用的基础。

items.detail: Real-time long-video generation requires continuous output with consistent appearance and natural motion. Existing chunk-wise autoregressive methods face challenges in both generation efficiency and long-video quality: serialized denoising and history-cache refresh require two forward passes even with one-step denoising, and longer rollouts can degrade quality and cause camera drift. We propose Wave Forcing (WF), which co-designs generation, training, and execution for continuous video output with multi-step denoising. WF uses chunk-wise causal attention to access earlier, cleaner chunks before their denoising is complete, and distributes staggered denoising and cache-refresh stages across full-model replicas to achieve 1F1C: one output chunk per concurrent forward round after pipeline fill. To adapt the model to this continuous generation process, we develop a three-stage training procedure that successively introduces mixed-noise denoising, motion supervision, and causal adaptation using self-generated history. To execute this process efficiently, Wave Runtime (WaveRT) uses Wave Parallelism (WP) for early K/V delivery and communication-computation overlap, together with optimized kernels and pipelined VAE decoding. Experiments on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B show that 5-step WF maintains overall quality comparable to Rolling Forcing while achieving higher Dynamic Degree on both short and long videos. Our system efficiency experiments show that 4-step WF achieves 147.6 DiT FPS and 134.8 end-to-end FPS on eight H200 GPUs, yielding 7.07x the single-GPU end-to-end throughput. In DiT-only tests with matched SageAttention+W8A8 backends, denoising steps, and GPU counts, WP delivers up to 2.53x the throughput of the faster of the Ulysses and Ring context-parallel baselines across six model scales (1.3B-14B).

items.detail: LLM agents are increasingly expected not only to complete isolated tasks, but also to carry bounded representations of human expertise, judgment, and interaction style. Building such person-grounded agents remains difficult because actionable knowledge associated with a person or role is usually embedded in heterogeneous traces rather than written as clean instructions. Existing memory and persona systems capture fragments of this evidence, while skill frameworks provide portable packaging formats; however, there is no end-to-end workflow for distilling these traces into inspectable, correctable, and agent-usable skills. We present an automated trace-to-skill distillation system for generating person-grounded AI skills via expert knowledge distillation. Given materials from a target person or role, COLLEAGUE.SKILL produces a versioned skill package with two coordinated tracks: a capability track for practices, mental models, and decision heuristics, and a bounded behavior track for communication style, interaction rules, and correction history. The package can be inspected, invoked, updated through natural-language feedback, rolled back, installed across agent hosts, and optionally prepared for controlled distribution. We describe the artifact contract, generation workflow, correction lifecycle, deployment surface, and domain presets implemented in the open-source system. At the time of writing, the public repository has approximately 18.5k GitHub stars; the gallery lists 215 skills from 165 contributors and more than 100k cumulative stars across listed skill cards. The system illustrates how person-grounded skills can be represented as portable, correctable packages rather than opaque prompts or hidden memories.
items.title_zh: COLLEAGUE.SKILLL：通过专家知识扭曲实现自动AI技能生成
items.detail_zh: 人们日益期望LLM代理人不仅完成孤立的任务，而且还要承担人的专门知识、判断和互动风格的有限表述。建立这种以人为基础的代理人仍然很困难，因为与一个人或角色有关的可操作的知识通常嵌入各种痕迹，而不是写成干净的指示。现有的内存和人名系统收集这些证据的碎片，而技能框架则提供便携式包装格式；然而，没有从端到端的工作流程将这些痕迹分馏成可检查、可纠正和可用剂的技能。我们提出一个自动追踪技能蒸馏系统，通过专家知识蒸馏产生个人的人工智能技能。由于来自目标人或角色的材料，COLLEAGUE.SKILL制作了一个版本技能包，有两条协调的音轨：练习能力音轨，心理模型和决定heuristics，以及交流风格，互动规则，以及校正历史的限定行为音轨。该套件可以检查，引用，通过自然语言反馈更新，回滚，跨代理主机安装，并可选择为控制发行做准备。我们描述了在开源系统中实施的文物合同、生成工作流程、修正生命周期、部署表面和域预设。在写作时，公共寄存器大约有18.5k GitHub星；画廊列出了165名贡献者的215个技能，以及超过100k的累计恒星横跨列表技能卡。该系统说明个人定位技能如何能够被表现为便携式，可纠正的包，而不是不透明的提示或隐藏的记忆。
