items.title: PDFMathTranslate: Scientific Document Translation Preserving Layouts
items.subtitle: Language barriers in scientific documents hinder the diffusion and development of science and technologies. However, prior efforts in translating such documents largely overlooked the information in layouts. To bridge the gap, we introduce PDFMathTranslate, the world's first open-source software for translating scientific documents while preserving layouts. Leveraging the most recent advances in large language models and precise layout detection, we contribute to the community with key improvements in precision, flexibility, and efficiency. The work has been open-sourced at https://github.com/byaidu/pdfmathtranslate with more than 222k downloads.

items.title_zh: PDFMath 翻译：科学文档翻译保留版式
items.detail_zh: 科学文件中的语言障碍阻碍了科学技术的传播和发展。然而，以前在翻译这类文件方面所作的努力基本上忽略了排版信息。为了弥补差距，我们引入了PDFMathTranslate，这是世界上第一个用于翻译科学文件，同时保留布局的开源软件。我们利用在大语言模型和精确布局检测方面的最新进展，在精度、灵活性和效率方面作出关键改进，为社区作出贡献。作品在https://github.com/byaidu/pdfmathtranslate上已开源，下载量超过222k。

items.detail: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/
items.title_zh: SUPRA-TEX：带有超对齐纹理的 3D 生成
items.detail_zh: 单图像 3D 生成旨在将一个给定的 3D 网格以可燃材料着装，同时忠实地保存一个参考图像的视觉细节。现有方法要么在调和不一致的多视图预测时引入文物，要么通过隐含的图像特性条件来努力保存细微细节。为了应对这些挑战，我们采用了SUPRA-Tex，其基础是可视材料估算、表面对齐和观察制导3D完成脱钩的原则。这种分工使得经过有限3D数据培训的3D生成器能够将其能力集中于保存可见证据和完成无法观察的表面。具体而言，我们首先培训一个基于MLLM的图像编辑模型，在参考视图中预测照明分离的PBR地图。然后把这些地图投射到可见的表面 用预先训练过的材料 VAE编码器 编码成原生观测潜伏体 共享生成目标潜伏空间 间叶流变压器将这些潜伏物作为固定的、只读的锚，同时交替进行未观测区域和全表面更新，以产生完整的物质潜伏物。这个设计实现了与参考物的超调和，在可见区域上传递你所看到的是忠诚的事物，在看不见的表面上连贯完成。 SUPRA-Tex只接受公共数据集的培训，在几何条件的纹理和端到端资产生成方面都实现了SOTA的性能，比对甚至超过了在闪烁的图像上领先的商业系统。项目网页：https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/

items.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
items.subtitle: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. items.detail: While multi-turn agentic reinforcement learning (RL) excels on long-horizon tasks, its performance gains remain highly sensitive to interaction constraints. Evaluating across sampling breadth K and interaction depth T via Pass@(K,T), we show that trajectory-level RL advantages depend on sufficient turn budgets, diminishing significantly when budgets tighten. Besides, agentic RL does not uniformly elevate single-step decision quality; rather, its strength concentrates in error recovery and long-horizon resilience. To mitigate the deployment risks caused by this budget dependence, we provide a preliminary discussion on the benefits and limitations of process supervision signals and introduce BudgetMix RL as an alternative that varies interaction budgets during training. Experiments demonstrate that BudgetMix RL achieves robust performance across diverse execution settings. Project Page: https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/
items.title_zh: 在LLM代理中，多种强化学习真正有什么改进？
items.detail_zh: 虽然多回合促进强化学习(RL)在长距离任务上表现优异，但其业绩的提高仍然对互动限制非常敏感。在通过Pass@(K，T)评估取样宽度K和互动深度T之间，我们显示，轨迹水平的RL优势取决于足够的转折预算，在预算收紧时显著减少。此外，代理式RL并没有统一提升单步骤决策质量；相反，其强度集中在故障恢复和长视距复原力上。为了减轻这种预算依赖所造成的部署风险，我们初步讨论了流程监督信号的好处和局限性，并引入了“预算混合”RL，作为培训期间互动预算的替代办法。实验表明，"预算混合RL"在不同的执行设置中实现了强劲的性能。项目网页：https://rethinking-agentic-rl.github.io/

items.detail: Large language models are deployed as long-horizon agents that compose diverse tools across MCP services into executable workflows. Existing MCP environment-scaling methods are data-centric: they first synthesize a database and scenario, then derive tools and tasks from them. As a result, tool interfaces may not match real ones, tool compositions are not grounded in execution, and tasks rarely span more than one environment. We propose ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework that reverses this order. ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies from adjacent calls in execution traces of real MCP services and open agent corpora, using deterministic rules rather than LLM judgment, and clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments. Databases are synthesized only for state-mutating environments, while query and stateless tools replay recorded returns. ToolSpace then performs state-aware random walks with rollback and decompiles each chain into a natural-language task with assertion-based checks, keeping only samples that replay successfully from the initial state. Applied to AutomationBench and tau3-Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which 7 frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points. Across seven long-horizon tool-use benchmarks, ToolSpace raises Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from 23.0 to 41.0 average score (43.2 with RL) and GLM-5.2 from 44.6 to 56.6, on par with Claude Opus 5. Ablations show that execution-witnessed edges clearly outperform LLM-judged ones, and performance keeps improving with data and environment scale.
items.title_zh: 工具空间：长视星等代理工具-科学环境综合
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型作为长视距代理被部署，将跨MCP服务的各种工具编成可执行的工作流程。现有的MCP环境尺度方法以数据为中心：它们首先合成一个数据库和情景，然后从中获取工具和任务。因此，工具界面可能不匹配真实的界面，工具构成不基于执行，任务很少跨越一个以上的环境。我们提出"工具空间"，一个以工具为中心的框架来扭转这个顺序。 ToolSpace矿井数据、状态和重试来自相邻电话的依赖性，在实际MCP服务和开源代理公司的执行痕迹中，使用确定性规则而不是LLM判断，并将由此产生的加权工具组合图分组到环境中。数据库只针对状态变换环境进行合成，而查询和无国籍工具则重放记录的返回。 ToolSpace然后以回滚方式进行状态意识随机行走，将每个链条分解为自然语言任务，并进行基于断言的检查，只保留从初始状态成功重播的样本。该管道适用于自动化奔驰和Tau3-奔驰银行业务，生产更硬的Pro版本，7个前沿型号下降最多38.2点。在7个长视距工具使用基准中，TollectSpace将Qwen3.6-35B-A3B从23.0提高到41.0平均分(43.2与RL)，GLM-5.2从44.6提高到56.6，与克劳德·奥普斯5持平。差距表明，被处决的目击证人的优势明显高于LLM判断的优势，而且随着数据和环境尺度的扩大，性能不断提高。

items.detail: We introduce Axion 1.0, a fully open agent foundation model that combines strong and broad agentic capabilities with a remarkably simple training recipe. Axion 1.0 is trained in only three stages: two lightweight supervised fine-tuning stages followed by reinforcement learning, without dedicated mid-training, direct preference optimization (DPO), or on-policy distillation (OPD). The first SFT stage develops strong self-contained reasoning through model-aware data construction, where we synthesize challenging problems and adversarially strengthen them based on the base model's own successful solution strategies. The second stage extends these capabilities to tool-dependent reasoning through a scalable pipeline for constructing diverse and automatically verifiable tasks grounded in real-world data sources and deterministic computation. Finally, reinforcement learning further strengthens long-horizon reasoning and interaction with external tools and environments. Despite this compact training recipe, Axion 1.0 achieves strong performance across a broad suite of agentic benchmarks and is competitive with leading commercial models on several of them. Equally importantly, Axion 1.0 is open beyond model weights: we release the complete recipe, including data construction, generation, filtering, verification, prompts, and training code, enabling the entire development process to be reproduced and extended. Axion 1.0 demonstrates that strong agent foundation models can be both open and simple, offering a practical and reproducible path toward advancing open agentic intelligence.
items.title_zh: Axion 1.0：开放代理基础模型，简化
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Axion 1.0，一个完全开放的代理基础模型，它结合了强大和广泛的代理能力 和一个非常简单的培训配方。 Axion 1.0只经过三个阶段的训练：两个轻量级有监督的微调阶段，然后是强化学习，没有专门的中训，直接偏好优化(DPO)，或者政策蒸馏(OPD)。第一个SFT阶段通过模型意识数据构建发展了强大的自成一体的推理，我们在这里综合了挑战性的问题，并在基础模型自身成功的解决方案策略的基础上进行了对抗性强化。第二阶段通过可扩展的管道将这些能力扩展至依靠工具的推理，以构建基于现实世界数据源和决定性计算的各种可自动核查的任务。最后，强化学习进一步加强了长期推理和与外部工具和环境的互动。尽管有这种紧凑的训练方法，Axion 1.0在一系列广泛的代理基准上都取得了良好的业绩，并在其中几个基准上与领先的商业模式具有竞争力。同样重要的是，Axion 1.0是开放的，超出了模型权重：我们发布完整的食谱，包括数据构建，生成，过滤，验证，提示，和训练代码，使得整个开发过程能够复制和扩展。 Axion 1.0表明，强大的物剂基础模型既可以开放又简单，为推进物剂开放智能提供了实用和可复制的途径。

items.detail: Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) conjectures that they do as they scale, but without a proof it offers neither a guarantee nor a recipe. We turn the hypothesis into a theorem. First, we prove a Platonic Representation Theorem: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) trained separately on any number of modalities learn the same representation up to one rotation whenever their positive pairs are two observations of one scene--good views--and their misalignment is bounded otherwise. Second, we show that next-token prediction is a JEPA with bad views, parts of a single document, which explains why language models align with vision only through scale. Third, we validate the theory from 145k captions to the texts of 940M web images, and uncover a scaling law of alignment that predicts unseen runs within seed noise. Good views need 42 times fewer training samples than next-token prediction on the same corpus to reach the same alignment, and a 109M-parameter text JEPA aligns with DINOv2 and CLIP's image encoders better than every language model we evaluated, up to 72B parameters, and than CLIP's text encoder: next-token prediction is a remarkably inefficient route to platonic representations. As a showcase, one rotation turns separately trained encoders into an image captioner (CIDEr .838 on COCO). Even that rotation needs no pair: on the latest pair-free benchmark, our text JEPA beats every zero-shot accuracy reported with language models up to 8B parameters, e.g., 64\% against at most 56\% top-5 on ImageNet-100. Positive views, and not scale alone, are thus the lever to build platonic representations.
items.title_zh: 证明和改进与联合环保局的柏拉图代表假说
items.detail_zh: 接受不同模式培训的模型是否与世界的同一代表性相融合，是大赦国际的核心。柏拉图代表假说(PRH)猜想他们按照自己的规模行事，但没有证据，它既不提供保证，也不提供食谱。我们把假设变成定理 首先，我们证明一个柏拉图式的代表定理：联合预测建筑(JEPAs)在任何一种模式上分别培训，只要其正对对一个场景的好观点的两种观察，就学会同一个代表直到一个旋转。第二，我们显示，下一个预测是一个JEPA，不好的观点，单文件的部分，这解释了为什么语言模型只通过尺度与视觉一致。第三，我们验证这个理论 从145k 标题到940M网络图像的文本，并发现一个缩放定律 对种子噪声的不见声进行预测。良好的观点需要比同一实体的下个切入式预测少42倍的训练样本才能达到相同的对接，109M参数的文本JEPA与DINOv2和CLIP的图像编码器比我们评价的每一个语言模型都更好，多达72B参数，也比CLIP的文本编码器：下个切入式预测是极低效的去柏拉图表达的路径。作为展示，一个旋转将经过单独训练的编码器变为图像字幕器(COCO上的CIDER 838)。即使这种旋转也不需要对：在最新的无对基准上，我们的文本JEPA击败了每条零射精度，语言模型上报告的精确度可达8B参数，例如，64QQ在ImageNet-100上最高为56QQ。因此，积极的观点，而不仅仅是规模，是建立柏拉图表述的杠杆。

items.detail: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion enables efficient generation, yet maintaining consistency over long rollouts remains challenging, especially when subjects or scenes reappear after going out of sight. Despite progress in fidelity and rollout robustness, existing distillation methods do not fully exploit richer historical information to constrain the student's current prediction. To address this gap, we introduce History Forcing, a unified on-policy distillation framework that strengthens historical supervision for few-step autoregressive video generators. The framework uses the residual between teacher predictions with and without informative historical context to decouple this supervision. Such a historical context can be obtained using earlier generated chunks with less accumulated drift or a fixed-view teacher rollout that keeps the scene visible while the student looks away. The residual is then weighted and added to the score or velocity prediction used for distillation, forming a corrected target. By aligning the student with this corrected target through distillation, History Forcing incorporates long-range historical constraints into autoregressive generation. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among 1.3B models, with a VBench quality score of 85.07 for 15s video generation and a VBench-Long aggregate score of 79.82 for 60s generation. For out-of-sight world modeling, evaluations further demonstrate more plausible scene evolution and more consistent states when the camera returns, with Evolution Quality improving from 2.35 to 2.70 on PlayWorld and Object Consistency from 58.43 to 62.18 on MemoBench.
items.title_zh: 历史要塞：扭曲历史-对长视视频世界模式的依赖性延续
items.detail_zh: 低步自动视频传播能够高效生成，但保持长期推出的一致性仍然具有挑战性，特别是在主体或场景消失后重新出现的情况下。尽管在忠诚和推出稳健性方面取得了进展，但现有的蒸馏方法并没有充分利用更丰富的历史信息来限制学生目前的预测。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了History Forcing，一个统一的政策提炼框架，它加强了对几步自动视频生成器的历史监督。框架利用教师预测与不提供信息的历史背景之间的剩余部分来解开这种监督。这种历史背景可以使用较早产生的积聚漂移较少的块来获得，也可以使用固定视野的教师推出，在学生视而不见时保持场景可见。然后将剩余部分加权，并添加到用于蒸馏的分数或速度预测中，形成一个修正的目标。历史堡垒通过蒸馏使学生与这个经过校正的目标保持一致，将长期的历史限制纳入自递生成。我们的方法在1.3B模型中实现了最先进的性能，15s视频生成的VBench质量分数为85.07分，60s生成的VBench-Long总分为79.82分。对于透视世界模型，评价进一步展示了镜头回归时更可信的场景演化和更加一致的状态，进化质量在PlayWorld上从2.35提高到2.70，在Memo Bench上从58.43提高到62.18。

items.title: Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders

items.detail: AI-generated text detectors are increasingly deployed in consequential settings---peer review, education, admissions, journalism, and content moderation---where their outputs directly affect individuals. Yet the strongest detectors are fine-tuned neural classifiers whose decisions are opaque, while transparent alternatives (stylometric and linguistic-feature classifiers) underperform them by wide margins. We present a pipeline that converts a fine-tuned neural detector into a classifier that operates on human-readable concepts. We accomplish this by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) directly on a detector's residual stream, assigning auto-interpretation labels to each SAE feature, and retaining only features whose generated descriptions pass a global fidelity threshold. We then train a lightweight classifier on just the interpretable features. We find that our SAEs recover latent concepts that correspond to highly specific and predictive linguistic "tells" of AI-generated text. Classifiers built on these extracted features are not only highly interpretable but exhibit stronger performance on out-of-distribution texts than either neural or stylometric alternatives.
items.title_zh: 使用 Sparse 自动编码器构建可审计的 AI 文本检测器
items.detail_zh: AI生成的文本探测器越来越多地被部署在相应的环境中 -- -- 同行审查、教育、录取、新闻和内容节制 -- -- 其产出直接影响到个人。然而最强的探测器是微调的神经分级器，其决定不透明，而透明的替代方法(时态和语言特征分级器)则以宽边差来使其表现不佳。我们提出一个管道，将一个微调神经探测器转换成一个在人可读概念上运作的分类器。我们通过直接在探测器的剩余流上培训稀少的自动编码器来完成这项工作，为每个自动编码器的特性分配自动解释标签，并只保留其生成的描述超过全球忠诚阈值的特性。然后，我们训练一个轻量级分类器 仅关于可解释的特性。我们发现我们的SAE恢复了潜伏的概念，这些概念与AI生成的文本中高度具体和预测性的语言"言语"相对应。以这些取出的特点为基础的分类器不仅具有高度的可解释性，而且在分配外文本上的性能也比神经或分型的替代品要强。

items.detail: Financial agents must form forecasts and investment judgments from decision-time evidence, with predictions evaluated against subsequent outcomes. Existing benchmarks assess financial knowledge, research workflows, or forecasting, but evaluating the full research process requires a strictly frozen information set and professional evaluation criteria. We introduce Investor's Last Exam (ILE), an equity-research benchmark led by experienced buy-side investors and fund managers. Its three components are a versioned financial database spanning 3.43 million document versions and nine source categories, supplemented by structured market data, with validated timestamps governing retrieval and computation; a task taxonomy organized around professional analyst deliverables; and an expert-led framework linking scoring criteria to sources, calculations, and assumptions through financial dependency graphs. Evaluation spans 86 assignments and jointly assesses research quality, forecast accuracy, and simulated investment performance. GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 lead overall at 68.1 and 66.9 out of 100, yet even Astra scores only 52.5 on Forecast & Model. Our results show that even state-of-the-art models fail to translate overall research capability into predictive performance. ILE shifts the evaluation unit from isolated capabilities to the evidence--assumption--judgment chain, allowing researchers to locate where analytical advantages fail to translate into forecasts and investment judgments, and providing a traceable, diagnostic foundation for training and evaluating financial agents.
items.title_zh: 投资者最后的考试：AI代理公司能否在没有看到未来的情况下进行股权投资？。
items.detail_zh: 金融代理人必须根据决策时间证据作出预测和投资判断，并根据随后的结果对预测进行评价。现有基准评估财务知识，研究工作流程，或预测，但评价整个研究过程需要严格冻结的信息集和专业评价标准。我们引入了投资者最后考试(ILE)，这是一个由有经验的买入方投资者和基金经理领导的股票研究基准。其三个组成部分是：一个涵盖343万个文件版本和9个来源类别的版本财务数据库，由结构化的市场数据加以补充，并附有关于检索和计算的有效时间戳；围绕专业分析师可交付成果组织的任务分类；一个专家主导的框架，通过财务依赖图将评分标准与来源、计算和假设联系起来。评价涉及86项任务，共同评估研究质量、预测准确性并模拟投资业绩。 GPT-6 Astra和克洛德·奥普斯·5.5以68.1分和66.9分的总比分领先100分，而即使是Astra在"预测与模型"上也只得52.5分。我们的结果表明，即使最先进的模型也无法将总体研究能力转化为预测性能。 ILE将评价单位从孤立的能力转移到证据-假设-判断链上，使研究人员能够找到分析优势未能转化为预测和投资判断的地方，并为培训和评价金融代理人提供可追踪的诊断基础。

items.title: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
items.subtitle: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. items.detail: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. At matched parameter scales, NCM achieves better generative perplexity than the strongest DLM baseline on LM1B while running 21times faster. On OpenWebText, NCM is competitive with the strongest DLM while running 10times faster; on XSum, it matches the strongest DLM's ROUGE-L while being 31times faster. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations.

items.detail: Dense 3D tracking from monocular video requires establishing point correspondences over time, estimating their depth, and inferring their trajectories during occlusion. Existing methods typically learn these tasks jointly, a demanding objective given the scarcity of 4D supervision. We show that strong pretrained 2D trackers and 3D geometry models provide an effective foundation: lifted trajectories, with occluded segments simply interpolated, already rival dedicated 3D trackers using the same geometry. However, lifted trajectories inherit correspondence and depth errors, and under occlusion, their depth comes from the occluder rather than the tracked point. We introduce ReLift, an efficient feed-forward framework that recasts dense 3D tracking as geometric trajectory repair and completion. At its core, a trajectory corrector alternates attention along and across trajectories to preserve reliable observations, repair corrupted positions, and complete missing motion. Using only geometric inputs allows us to train directly on 3D trajectories with simulated lifting errors, decoupling training from images and from any specific tracker or geometry model. Concentrating 4D supervision on trajectory refinement yields a reusable model that consistently improves lifted trajectories across trackers and geometry providers without retraining, so it benefits directly from future advances in either component. On WorldTrack, ReLift achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracy, improving on the strongest baselines by 2.1 APD on all points and 3.0 on dynamic points, with faster configurations remaining competitive with leading 3D trackers while running faster than 4RC. Visit our supplementry page for more examples and code.
items.title_zh: ReLift：被抬起的轨迹修复时的 Dense 3D 跟踪
items.detail_zh: Dense 3D从单视视频中跟踪，需要随着时间推移建立点通信，估计其深度，并推断其在被隔离期间的轨迹。现有方法通常共同学习这些任务，鉴于缺乏4D监督，这是一个要求很高的目标。我们显示，强大的预先训练的2D跟踪器和3D几何模型提供了一个有效的基础：被升起的轨迹，有被占用的片段只是插入的，已经与使用同样几何的专用3D跟踪器相竞争。然而，被升起的轨迹继承了函证和深度误差，在被封存的情况下，其深度来自被封存者而不是跟踪点。我们引入了ReLift，一个高效的向导框架，将密集的3D跟踪重塑为几何轨道修复和完成。其核心是轨迹校正器在轨道上和轨道上交替注意，以保存可靠的观测，修复被腐蚀的位置，并完成缺失的运动。只使用几何输入可以让我们直接在3D轨迹上进行模拟起重出错的训练，从图像和任何特定的跟踪器或几何模型中解开训练。将4D监督集中在轨迹改进上会产生一种可重复使用的模型，在不进行再培训的情况下，不断改进轨迹在跟踪器和几何提供者之间被提升的轨迹，因此它直接受益于这两个组成部分的未来进展。在"World Track"上，ReLift实现了最先进的平均精度，在最强的基线上在所有点上提高了2.1APD和在动态点上提高了3.0，更快的配置仍然与领先的3D跟踪器竞争，同时跑得快于4RC。访问我们的补充页面，了解更多实例和代码。

items.detail: Adversarial diffusion distillation has conventionally relied on image features for discrimination. We revisit this choice for multimodal diffusion transformers (MMDiTs), whose text stream becomes image-dependent through joint attention. We introduce Text-Stream Adversarial Distillation (TSAD), which exploits intermediate text-token states as a new adversarial representation. Because the text stream has already read the image while remaining tied to the text condition, changing that condition changes what information it extracts from the image. Building on this property, we introduce Aspect-Cued Discrimination (ACD), which conditions the discriminator on different aspects of the sample, such as typography, objects, or style, to steer which properties are emphasized during adversarial training. Building on the expert-discriminator design of NitroFusion, we integrate TSAD and ACD in NitroFusion2. NitroFusion2 brings few-step distillation from the conventional 4-8-step regime down to just 1-2 steps at comparable quality. At one step, it produces sharp rendered text and rich fine-grained details, making one-step generation practical rather than merely a stress test for distillation. At two steps, it remains competitive across the evaluated benchmarks. These results establish the MMDiT text stream as a powerful and steerable representation for adversarial diffusion distillation.
items.title_zh: NitroFusion2：将逆差损失带入多式联运变换器的文本流
items.detail_zh: 横向扩散蒸馏在传统上依赖图像特征进行歧视。我们重新审视多式联运变压器(MMDITs)的这一选择，其文本流通过联合关注而变得依赖图像。我们采用 " 文本扭曲扭曲 " (TSAD)，它利用中间文本基态作为新的对抗性代表。因为文本流已经读取了图像，同时仍然绑定在文本条件上，所以修改该条件会改变它从图像中提取的信息。在这项财产的基础上，我们引入了Spect-Cued Discrimination(ACD)，它规定歧视者在样本的不同方面，例如打字、物品或风格方面，指导在对抗性训练中强调哪些财产。在硝基聚合物的专家-歧视者设计的基础上，我们将TSAD和ACD融合到硝基聚合物2中。 NitroFusion2从常规的4-8步制下到相当质量的只有1-2步的蒸馏很少。一步一步，它产生尖锐的渲染文本和丰富的精细细节，使一步一代实用，而不仅仅是一种蒸馏的压力测试。在两个步骤上，它仍然具有各种评估基准的竞争力。这些结果确立了MMdiT文本流作为对抗性扩散蒸馏的强大和可引导的体现。

items.detail: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows. Yet interfaces centered on screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions can impose a human-interaction prior, requiring repeated screen interpretation while leaving the computer's semantic and programmatic capabilities underexposed. We argue for exposing these capabilities and letting models choose and combine them. We introduce Hybrid Computer Use (HCU), a unified interface for general agents that combines three complementary channels: programmatic interaction through code and command-line tools, semantic interaction through accessibility (AX), and visual interaction through graphical user interfaces (GUI). Our HCU supports efficient AX interaction and guards against stale-state actions during channel switching. A supplementary HCU skill guides agents in selecting and coordinating channels to use the unified interface effectively. Our designed AX tools return compact observations, execute actions in batches, and report their effects as AX diffs, so the model needs fewer round trips. On OSWorld 2.0, HCU achieves the highest Partial and Binary scores among the compared systems. Analyzing agent trajectories, we find that all evaluated models improve with HCU yet allocate work across the channels differently and consistently outperform compared baselines in terms of both efficiency and task success, highlighting the value of unified computer-use interfaces that allow flexible channel selection and combination.
items.title_zh: 混合计算机使用：通用代理的统一程序、语义和视觉界面
items.detail_zh: 计算机使用代理人越来越多地处理从日常桌面活动到长期专业工作流程等各种任务。然而，以截图和鼠标键盘动作为核心的界面可以先强制进行人际互动，需要反复进行屏幕解释，同时使计算机的语义能力和程序能力暴露不足。我们主张揭露这些能力，让模型选择和结合它们。我们引入了混合计算机使用(HCU)，这是一个通用代理的统一界面，它结合了三个互补通道：通过代码和命令行工具的程序交互，通过无障碍(AX)的语义交互，以及通过图形用户界面(GUI)的视觉交互。我们的HCU支持高效的AX交互，并在频道切换时守护防滞状态动作。一种补充的HCU技能指导代理人选择和协调频道以有效使用统一接口。我们设计的AX工具返回紧凑的观测，分批执行动作，并以AX diffs报告其效果，所以模型需要减少往返。在OSWorld 2.0上，HCU在比较系统中实现了最高的部分和二进制分数。分析剂轨迹，我们发现所有被评价的模型随着HCU的改进而有所改进，然而在效率和任务成功方面对跨渠道的工作分配却不同，而且始终高于基线，突出了统一计算机使用接口的价值，从而能够灵活选择和组合信道。

items.detail: Traditional image cropping assumes the photograph already contains the composition worth keeping, and asks only where to crop. A full 360^{circ} scene offers no such guarantee: the viewing direction in a scene has to be discovered before anything can be framed. We present PhotoGuider, a measure-then-frame method that answers both questions with compact learned scorers over one shared set of composition-aware features. The designed features are extracted using foundation and task-specific vision models and structured into four photographic tokens: Subject, Composition, Aesthetics, and Integrity. Our MLLM explainer is fine-tuned to generate composition-related explanations conditioned on images and measured token assessments. To our knowledge, PhotoGuider is the first method to combine explicit composition-based direction selection in 360^{circ} panoramas with refined framing, camera-parameter output for native re-rendering, and measurement-conditioned explanations. On two standard 2D cropping benchmarks, PhotoGuider achieves the highest average mIoU performance against ground-truth crops. In a blind ranking study, 120 participants ranked three cropping methods over 100 panoramic scenes from the public Poly Haven HDRI library, placing our framings first in 53.2% of cases, against 27.3% and 19.5% for two strong alternatives. Project page: https://ntuneillee.github.io/research/photoguider/
items.title_zh: PhotoGuider：组成- 智能裁剪和 360^{circ} 带有解释性摄影评估的视图
items.detail_zh: 传统的图像裁剪假设照片中已经包含值得保存的成分，只询问在哪里收割。一个完整的360QCirc}的场景并没有提供这样的保证：在任何设定之前，都必须发现一个场景的取景方向。我们提出PhotoGuider，一种当时的衡量方法，它用精密的学习分数计数器来回答这两个问题。设计的特点利用基础和任务特定愿景模型取出，并分为四个摄影标志：主题、组成、美学和诚信。我们的MLLM解释器经过了微调，以生成以图像和量度符号评估为条件的与组成相关的解释。据我们所知，PhotoGuider是第一个将360-Circ}全景中明确的基于成分的取向选择与精细的框架、用于原生回落的相机参数输出以及测量条件解释相结合的方法。根据两个标准二维收割基准，PhotoGuider对地真能收割作物的平均MIOU性能最高。在一项盲目排名研究中，120名参与者在公共PolyHaven HDRI图书馆的100个全景场景中排名了三种栽培方法，在53.2%的案例中，我们的布局位居第一位，在两种强的替代品中，比例分别为27.3%和19.5%。项目网页：https://ntuneille.github.io/research/photoguider/

items.title: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
items.subtitle: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. items.detail: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. Our central design aligns structured video captions with action-aware causal attention: descriptive context remains accessible across segments, while action instructions are restricted to their intended temporal windows. A vision-language Prompt Enhancer (PE) translates user requests and multimodal interaction histories into structured conditions for the next segment. A multi-stage curriculum progressively introduces causal generation, text interaction, camera control, and training on model-generated histories, followed by diffusion distillation. In human evaluation, Hy-Nomas shows superior performance over existing world models. We release model weights, code and benchmarks, together with a lightweight adaptation workflow, to support reproducible research on interactive world generation.

items.detail: The fast growth of open-source AI infrastructure, from model serving engines and agent platforms to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem and the language models themselves, has outpaced the security tooling available to defend it. We present AI-Infra-Guard, an open-source framework that organizes AI red teaming around a single observation: the attack surface of an AI agent is stratified across layers (infrastructure, protocol/tool, agent behavior, and model), and no single detection paradigm fits all of them. The framework therefore matches a paradigm to each layer, from deterministic rule matching over 75+ AI components and 1{,}400+ vulnerability rules, through LLM-driven agentic auditing of MCP servers and agent-skill packages and multi-turn black-box agent red teaming, to a jailbreak harness with 26+ attack operators over sixteen datasets. To our knowledge it is the only open-source framework to span all of these, including supply-chain auditing of the agent skills that increasingly extend AI agents. We release AI-Infra-Guard as open source so that layer-paradigm matching can serve as a practical foundation for agent security and a shared base for the community to build on.
items.title_zh: 保障人工智能代理：多层代理红色团队统一框架
items.detail_zh: 开源AI基础设施的快速发展，从模型服务引擎和代理平台，到模型背景协议(MCP)生态系统和语言模型本身，都超过了可用于防御它的安全工具。我们提出AI-Infra-Guard，这是一个开源框架，它组织AI红色团队围绕一个单一的观察：AI代理的攻击表面分层分层(基础设施，协议/工具，代理行为，以及模型)，没有一个单一的检测范式适合所有这些。因此，框架将一个范式与每一层相匹配，从确定规则比75+ AI组件和1{，}400+脆弱性规则，通过LLM驱动的代理审计MCP服务器和代理技能包以及多回合黑箱代理红色组合，到26+攻击操作员超过16个数据集的越狱控制带。据我们所知，这是涵盖所有这一切的唯一开放源码框架，包括对代理技能进行供应链审计，从而日益扩展AI代理。我们释放AI-Infra-Guard作为开放源代码，这样层-paradigm匹配就可以作为代理安全的实际基础和共享的基础，让社区在此基础上更进一步。

items.detail: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.
items.title_zh: 主干员：自我改进的RLM技巧
items.detail_zh: 语言模型是顺序处理器，但长视距机构需要外部信息以及超出模型权重和活性背景的计算。 Prime Agent是用于长视评价和编码代理工作流程的开源控制器。持续的IPython REPL遵循Recursive Language Model抽象，用于程序上下文处理和测试时间计算，而Continual Harness则保存历史，记忆，技能，提示，以及跨轨迹的亚剂规格。递归亚剂通过直接的代理对代理通信进行协调，代理视图让人类检查和管理守护进程支持的会话。主干员将执行、恢复、核查和资源核算标准化，同时将战略构建留给模型。这种低温，显性薄膜防止了操纵故障成为模型故障，并将测量推向模型真正的最大基础能力。 Prime Agent将ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1从30%提升到95.5%，并匹配或超过本地和流行的拉带，跨越长文本编码，GPU-内核生成，模拟构建，以及自主的纳米GPT增速运行。关于Infantio，我们发现改进可以使技术不断进步，而专用的子剂可以使工作并行。代码见https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent。

items.detail: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. We argue the skill should instead be trained as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible. SkillOpt is, to our knowledge, the first systematic controllable text-space optimizer for agent skills: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill document, and an edit is accepted only when it strictly improves a held-out validation score. A textual learning-rate budget, rejected-edit buffer, and epoch-wise slow/meta update make skill training stable while adding zero inference-time model calls at deployment. Across six benchmarks, seven target models, and three execution harnesses (direct chat, Codex, Claude Code), SkillOpt is best or tied on all 52 evaluated (model, benchmark, harness) cells and beats every per-cell competitor among human, one-shot LLM, Trace2Skill, TextGrad, GEPA, and EvoSkill skills. On GPT-5.5 it lifts the average no-skill accuracy by +23.5 points in direct chat, by +24.8 inside the Codex agentic loop, and by +19.1 inside Claude Code. Transfer experiments further show that optimized skill artifacts retain value when moved across model scales, between Codex and Claude Code execution environments, and to a nearby math benchmark without further optimization.
items.title_zh: SkillOpt：自我发展代理技能执行战略
items.detail_zh: 今天的代理技能是手工制作的，产生一弹一弹，或者通过松散控制的自译自审来演化，其中没有任何一种表现得像技能的深层学习优化器，没有任何一种在反馈下可靠地改善了它的起点。我们主张技能应该作为冷冻剂的外部状态来训练，具有同样的学科，使得重量空间优化可以再生产。据我们所知，SkillOpt是代理技能的首个系统可控文本空间优化器：一个单独的优化器模型将打分的推出转换成在单一技能文档上绑定的添加/删除/替换编辑，只有在严格改进被搁置的验证分数时才接受编辑。文本学习率预算、拒绝编辑缓冲和划时代的慢/元更新使技能培训稳定，同时在部署时增加零推断时间模型呼叫。在6个基准、7个目标模型和3个执行工具(直接聊天、Codex、Claude Code)中，SkillOpt是最佳的或与所有52个被评价的细胞(模型、基准、带)捆绑在一起的，并击败了人类中每个细胞的每个竞争者、一击LM、Trace2Skill、TextGrad、GEPA和EvoSkill技能。在GPT-5.5上，它通过直接聊天的+23.5分，Codex代理循环的+24.8分和Claude代码的+19.1分提高平均无技能精度。转移实验进一步显示，优化的技能文物在跨模型尺度移动时，在Codex和Claude代码执行环境之间，以及在不进一步优化的情况下，保留到附近的数学基准上的价值。

items.title: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
items.subtitle: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedente
items.detail: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., π0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.
items.title_zh: GPT-6-Astra是否实现了健全的情报工作？
items.detail_zh: GPT-6-Astra在机器人操纵和导航方面表现出一定的能力，对为个别任务和表现建立专门模式的传统模式提出了挑战。在本报告中，我们不仅询问GPT-6-Astra的能力如何，而且询问它的能力对该领域意味着什么。首先，我们探索独立的GPT-6-Astra的极限。我们对12项代表性基准进行大规模评估，这些基准涉及桌面操纵、人造物、移动平台和狡猾的手。根据统一协议，允许从培训设置的演示中学习内容，并大大增加执行步骤的数量，GPT-6-Astra取得了前所未有的成绩(图1)。未来的研究可能侧重于改善1)ICL(2)的成本和执行时间的普遍性，3)物理状态核查，4)从不可逆转的故障中恢复，5)长期保持进展。第二，我们研究 内含控制的力量。我们确认，一个高级"System 2"(即GPT-6-Astra)和低级"System 1"控制器(即"0.5")之间的近距离协调成本高而有效。第三，我们审查GPT-6-Astra的实际情况。我们关于8个机器人配置的实验揭示出巨大的差距：1)ICL所需的机器人演示费很昂贵的收集，2)在物理限制下以较长的执行时间换取更高的成功率是不可信的。第四，我们设想下一代包含的基准。我们开发了一个原型，即：(1) 任务来自现实世界的需要；(2) 不提供内部示范；(3) 法官在不断运转的世界时钟上进行审理。总而言之，我们的结果表明，GPT-6-Astra已基本跨越了已体现的能力界限，但尚未超越实际体现的智力界限。

As the generated history grows, retaining all previous content becomes increasingly expensive and redundant, making effective historical selection essential. Existing approaches often determine historical relevance based on the current content. However, information relevant to the present is not necessarily useful for future generation, while seemingly less relevant history may become important later. Our key insight is that historical information should be selected according to its relevance to future information needs. Capturing these needs does not require generating the full future; instead, a compact representation of what becomes important next is sufficient to guide historical selection. Building on this insight, we propose FrameMorrow, a prospective frame selector that predicts a small set of prospective tokens representing future information needs and uses them to identify relevant information from history. FrameMorrow selects explicit historical frames rather than model-specific internal states, enabling plug-and-play integration across diverse generators, including closed-source models, with little additional inference cost. We evaluate FrameMorrow across five benchmarks and 11 generative models spanning long-video generation, interactive generation, and action-conditioned world models. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in long-range consistency, visual quality, and action alignment across diverse generation settings.
items.title_zh: FrameMorrow：未来指导框架选择，并带有可视的Tokens用于长视视频生成
items.detail_zh: 长视视频生成需要模型来有效地利用越来越长的一代历史。随着所产生历史的不断增长，保留所有以前的内容变得越来越昂贵和多余，因此有效的历史选择必不可少。现有办法往往根据现有内容确定历史相关性。然而，与目前有关的资料不一定对后世有用，而似乎不太相关的历史在后世可能变得重要。我们的主要见解是，历史信息应根据其与未来信息需要的相关性加以选择。抓住这些需要并不要求创造出完整的未来；相反，紧凑地表述出今后的重要内容足以指导历史选择。基于这一见解，我们提议FrameMorrow，一个预测未来信号的预选框架选择器，它预示着代表未来信息需要的一小组预想信号，并利用它们来识别历史中的相关信息。 FrameMorrow选择了明确的历史框架，而不是模型特定的内部状态，使得插值和游戏集成能够跨出包括闭源模型在内的各种发电机，几乎没有额外的推论成本。我们通过五个基准和11个基因模型来评估框架未来，这些模型包括长视频生成、互动生成和有条件行动的世界模型。广泛的实验表明，在不同世代环境中，在远程一致性、视觉质量和行动一致性方面，不断改进。

items.detail: Recent advancements in 3D generative modeling have significantly improved the generation realism, yet the field is still hampered by existing representations, which struggle to capture assets with complex topologies and detailed appearance. This paper present an approach for learning a structured latent representation from native 3D data to address this challenge. At its core is a new sparse voxel structure called O-Voxel, an omni-voxel representation that encodes both geometry and appearance. O-Voxel can robustly model arbitrary topology, including open, non-manifold, and fully-enclosed surfaces, while capturing comprehensive surface attributes beyond texture color, such as physically-based rendering parameters. Based on O-Voxel, we design a Sparse Compression VAE which provides a high spatial compression rate and a compact latent space. We train large-scale flow-matching models comprising 4B parameters for 3D generation using diverse public 3D asset datasets. Despite their scale, inference remains highly efficient. Meanwhile, the geometry and material quality of our generated assets far exceed those of existing models. We believe our approach offers a significant advancement in 3D generative modeling.
items.title_zh: 3D 世代的本地和契约结构的后人
items.detail_zh: 最近在3D基因模型化方面的进步大大改进了生成现实主义，然而这个领域仍然受到现有表述的阻碍，这些表述试图用复杂的地形和详细的外观来捕捉资产。本文件介绍了从本地立体数据中学习结构化潜在代表性以应对这一挑战的方法。其核心是一种新的稀疏的阴道结构，称为O-Voxel，是一种omni-voxel代表，它同时编码几何和外观。 O-Voxel可以强力地模拟任意地形，包括开放的，非狂形的，和完全封闭的表面，同时捕捉到超出纹理颜色的全面表面属性，如物理渲染参数。基于O-Voxel，我们设计了Sparse Compression VAE，提供高空间压缩率和紧凑的潜伏空间。我们利用不同的公共三维资产数据集，为三维生成培训由4B参数组成的大规模流量匹配模型。尽管其规模很大，但推断仍然非常有效。与此同时，我们创造的资产的几何和物质质量远远超过现有模型。我们认为，我们的做法在三维基因模型的制作方面取得重大进展。

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance large language models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge sources, enabling more accurate and contextually relevant responses tailored to user needs. However, existing RAG systems have significant limitations, including reliance on flat data representations and inadequate contextual awareness, which can lead to fragmented answers that fail to capture complex inter-dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose LightRAG, which incorporates graph structures into text indexing and retrieval processes. This innovative framework employs a dual-level retrieval system that enhances comprehensive information retrieval from both low-level and high-level knowledge discovery. Additionally, the integration of graph structures with vector representations facilitates efficient retrieval of related entities and their relationships, significantly improving response times while maintaining contextual relevance. This capability is further enhanced by an incremental update algorithm that ensures the timely integration of new data, allowing the system to remain effective and responsive in rapidly changing data environments. Extensive experimental validation demonstrates considerable improvements in retrieval accuracy and efficiency compared to existing approaches. We have made our LightRAG open-source and available at the link: https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG.
items.title_zh: LightRAG：简单且快速的检索增强生成
items.detail_zh: 检索增强生成(RAG)系统通过整合外部知识来源来增强大型语言模型(LLMS)，从而能够根据用户需求做出更加准确和符合具体情况的反应。然而，现有的RAG系统有重大的局限性，包括依赖统一的数据表示和缺乏对背景的认识，这可能导致答案分散，无法反映复杂的相互依存关系。为了应对这些挑战，我们提议使用LightRAG，将图表结构纳入文本索引和检索过程。这一创新框架采用双层检索系统，加强从低层和高级知识发现中的全面信息检索。此外，将图表结构与矢量表示法结合起来，有助于高效检索相关实体及其关系，大大改善反应时间，同时保持关联性。这一能力通过递增更新算法得到进一步加强，该算法确保了新数据的及时整合，使该系统能够在迅速变化的数据环境中保持效力和反应能力。与现有方法相比，广泛的实验验证表明，检索的准确性和效率有相当大的提高。我们开放了我们的LightRAG的源代码，可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG。

items.detail: Agentic coding tools receive goals written in natural language as input, break them down into specific tasks, and write or execute the actual code with minimal human intervention. Central to this process are agent context files ("READMEs for agents") that provide persistent, project-level instructions. In this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 2,303 agent context files from 1,925 repositories to characterize their structure, maintenance, and content. We find that these files are not static documentation but complex, difficult-to-read artifacts that evolve like configuration code, maintained through frequent, small additions. Our content analysis of 16 instruction types shows that developers prioritize functional context, such as build and run commands (62.3%), implementation details (69.9%), and architecture (67.7%). We also identify a significant gap: non-functional requirements like security (14.5%) and performance (14.5%) are rarely specified. These findings indicate that while developers use context files to make agents functional, they provide few guardrails to ensure that agent-written code is secure or performant, highlighting the need for improved tooling and practices.
items.title_zh: 代理 READMEs：代理编码背景文件的实证研究
items.detail_zh: 代理编码工具接收以自然语言写成的目标作为输入，将其细分为具体任务，并在最小的人类干预下编写或执行实际代码。这个过程的核心是代理上下文文件("用于代理的READMEs")，提供持久，项目级指令。在本文中，我们对来自1,925个寄存器的2,303个代理上下文文件进行了第一次大规模的实证研究，以描述其结构、维护和内容。我们发现，这些文件不是静态文件，而是复杂，难以阅读的文物，它们像配置代码一样演化，通过频繁的小添加来维护。我们对16种指令类型的内容分析显示，开发者优先排序功能环境，如构建和运行命令(62.3%)，实施细节(69.9%)，以及架构(67.7%)。我们还发现存在一个重大差距：安保(14.5%)和业绩(14.5%)等不起作用的要求很少得到说明。这些发现表明，开发者虽然使用上下文文件来使代理机功能化，但是他们提供很少的护栏来保证代理机写代码的安全性或性能，突出了改进工具和做法的必要性。

items.detail: This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of the PyTorch distributed data parallel module. PyTorch is a widely-adopted scientific computing package used in deep learning research and applications. Recent advances in deep learning argue for the value of large datasets and large models, which necessitates the ability to scale out model training to more computational resources. Data parallelism has emerged as a popular solution for distributed training thanks to its straightforward principle and broad applicability. In general, the technique of distributed data parallelism replicates the model on every computational resource to generate gradients independently and then communicates those gradients at each iteration to keep model replicas consistent. Despite the conceptual simplicity of the technique, the subtle dependencies between computation and communication make it non-trivial to optimize the distributed training efficiency. As of v1.5, PyTorch natively provides several techniques to accelerate distributed data parallel, including bucketing gradients, overlapping computation with communication, and skipping gradient synchronization. Evaluations show that, when configured appropriately, the PyTorch distributed data parallel module attains near-linear scalability using 256 GPUs.
items.title_zh: PyTorch 分布：加速数据并行培训的经验
items.detail_zh: 本文件介绍了PyTorch分布式数据平行模块的设计、实施和评价。 PyTorch是一个被广泛采纳的科学计算包，用于深层学习研究和应用。近期在深入学习方面的进展论证了大型数据集和大型模型的价值，这就要求有能力将模型培训扩大到更多的计算资源。由于数据平行原则的直截了当和广泛适用性，数据平行主义已成为分发培训的受欢迎的解决办法。一般来说，分布式数据平行主义的技术复制了每个计算资源上的模式来独立生成梯度，然后在每个迭代上传达出这些梯度来保持模型复制的一致性。尽管技术在概念上很简洁，但计算和通信之间的微妙依赖性使得优化分布式培训效率成为非三角性。截至v1.5，PyTorch本土提供了几种技术来加速分布式数据平行，包括桶式梯度，与通信相重叠的计算，并跳过梯度同步。评价显示，PyTorch分布式数据平行模块在适当配置时，使用256GPU实现近线性可扩展性。

items.title: Turns Matter: Advancing Streaming Video RL via Turn-Level Credit
items.subtitle: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures. We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions. TurnWise addresses the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level interaction, promoting informative responses and reducing redundancy
items.detail: Streaming video understanding requires models to repeatedly decide whether to respond or continue observing. Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been applied to this setting, with existing approaches emphasizing reward design while retaining a single trajectory-level advantage across turns. Such shared credit can reinforce redundant replies after earlier successes and discourage useful follow-ups after earlier failures. We propose TurnWise, a turn-level GRPO framework that aligns learning with individual streaming decisions. TurnWise addresses the mismatch between trajectory-level feedback and turn-level interaction, promoting informative responses and reducing redundancy. Specifically, turn-level credit assignment uses silence-completed prefix scoring to construct group-relative advantages from each decision's remaining return, separating its learning signal from earlier rewards. Turn-mean policy optimization averages token losses within each turn and then across turns, giving response and waiting decisions equal weight regardless of output length. These complementary designs improve streaming policy learning without a learned critic or additional rollouts. Extensive experiments show our method outperforms prior RL approaches for streaming video understanding.
items.detail_zh: 流取视频理解需要模型反复决定是回应还是继续观测。最近，集团相对政策优化(GPRO)被应用于这一背景，现有做法强调奖励设计，同时保持单一的轨迹水平优势。这种共享信贷可以加强先前成功之后的多余答复，并阻碍先前失败之后的有益后续行动。我们提议TurnWise，这是一个将学习与单个流程决定相协调的回合级GPRO框架。 TurnWise解决了轨迹级反馈和转动级互动之间的不匹配，促进信息化响应并减少冗余。具体地说，回合级信用分配使用静态完成的前缀分来构建与每个决定的剩余回报相适应的集团关系优势，将其学习信号与更早的奖励区分开来。转动政策优化平均在每个转动周期内和转动周期内出现象征性损失，无论输出长度如何，给予响应和等待决定同等权重。这些互补设计改进了无有学问的批评者或额外推出的流派政策学习。广泛的实验显示，我们的方法在流媒体视频理解方面比以往的RL方法要好。

items.detail: Recently, large language model (LLM) based text-to-speech (TTS) systems have gradually become the mainstream in the industry due to their high naturalness and powerful zero-shot voice cloning capabilities.Here, we introduce the IndexTTS system, which is mainly based on the XTTS and Tortoise model. We add some novel improvements. Specifically, in Chinese scenarios, we adopt a hybrid modeling method that combines characters and pinyin, making the pronunciations of polyphonic characters and long-tail characters controllable. We also performed a comparative analysis of the Vector Quantization (VQ) with Finite-Scalar Quantization (FSQ) for codebook utilization of acoustic speech tokens. To further enhance the effect and stability of voice cloning, we introduce a conformer-based speech conditional encoder and replace the speechcode decoder with BigVGAN2. Compared with XTTS, it has achieved significant improvements in naturalness, content consistency, and zero-shot voice cloning. As for the popular TTS systems in the open-source, such as Fish-Speech, CosyVoice2, FireRedTTS and F5-TTS, IndexTTS has a relatively simple training process, more controllable usage, and faster inference speed. Moreover, its performance surpasses that of these systems. Our demos are available at https://index-tts.github.io.
items.title_zh: IndexTTS：工业一级可控和高效的零热文本对语音系统
items.detail_zh: 最近，基于文字对语音(TTS)的大型语言模型(LLM)系统由于具有较高的自然性和强大的零镜头语音克隆能力，逐渐成为业界的主流。在这里，我们引入了IndexTTS系统，该系统主要基于XTTS和龟模型。我们补充了一些新的改进。具体来说，在汉语情景中，我们采用混合模型方法，将字符和pinyin结合，使多音字符和长尾字符的发音可以控制。我们还与Finite-Scalar Quantization(FSQ)对矢量量量化(VQ)进行了比较分析，用于编码本使用声学语音符号。为了进一步提高语音克隆的效果和稳定性，我们引入了以听素为基础的语音条件编码器，并将语音码解码器替换为BigVGAN2。与XTTS相比，在自然性，内容一致性，以及零镜头语音克隆方面都取得了显著的改善。至于开源软件中流行的TTS系统，如Fish-Speech，CosyVoice2，FireRedTTS和F5-TTS，IndexTTS的训练过程相对简单，使用率比较可控，推论速度更快。此外，其业绩超过了这些系统。我们的演示可在https://index-ts.github.io上查阅。

items.detail: The financial market is a mission-critical playground for AI agents due to its temporal dynamics and low signal-to-noise ratio. Building an effective algorithmic trading system may require a professional team to develop and test over the years. In this paper, we propose an orchestration framework for financial agents, which aims to democratize financial intelligence to the general public. We map each component of the traditional algorithmic trading system to agents, including planner, orchestrator, alpha agents, risk agents, portfolio agents, backtest agents, execution agents, audit agents, and memory agent. We present two in-house trading examples. For the stock trading task (hourly data from 04/2024 to 12/2024), our approach achieved a return of 20.42%, a Sharpe ratio of 2.63, and a maximum drawdown of -3.59%, while the S&P 500 index yielded a return of 15.97%. For the BTC trading task (minute data from 27/07/2025 to 13/08/2025), our approach achieved a return of 8.39%, a Sharpe ratio of 0.38, and a maximum drawdown of -2.80%, whereas the BTC price increased by 3.80%. Our code is available on https://github.com/Open-Finance-Lab/AgenticTrading{GitHub}.
items.title_zh: 金融代理商的管弦框架：从算术贸易到代理贸易
items.detail_zh: 金融市场由于其时间动态和低信号与噪音比率，是AI代理商的任务关键游乐场。建立有效的算法交易系统可能需要专业团队来发展和测试这些年。在本文中，我们提出了金融代理人的合谋框架，其目的是使金融情报对公众民主化。我们把传统算法交易系统的每个组成部分都映射到代理人，包括计划员，管弦乐手，α代理人，风险代理人，组合代理人，回试代理人，执行代理人，审计代理人，以及记忆代理人。我们提出两个内部贸易的例子。对于股票交易任务(小时数据从04/2024到12/2024)，我们的方法实现了20.42%的回报率，夏普比为2.63，最高提成为-3.59%，而S&P500指数的回报率为15.97%。对于BTC交易任务(分钟数据从2025年7月27日到2025年8月13日)，我们的方法实现了8.39%的回报率，夏普比为0.38，最高提成为-2.80%，而BTC价格则上涨了3.80%。我们的代码可以在https://github.com/Open-finance-Lab/AgenticTrading{GitHub}上找到。

items.detail: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through experience, and orchestrate them across domains. We introduce Raven, The Harness of Harnesses, an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically constructs and evolves modular harnesses for specific models and domains, treating each executable model--harness pair as a composable unit of intelligence. To support an All-Domain Collaboration Network, its Host Agent decomposes goals, matches subtasks to specialized agents, coordinates execution dependencies, and integrates results, while a host archive and EverOS preserve experience across tasks and Skill Forge makes that experience available as reusable procedures. Our theory establishes sufficient conditions for such composition to expand reliable task coverage beyond that of the available individual agents under a shared resource budget. On complex and long-horizon tasks, Raven significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art agent systems, pushing the frontier of composable agentic intelligence.
items.title_zh: Raven：利用哈内斯为可编译的代理智能
items.detail_zh: 随着大型语言模型的推进，AI代理正在超越孤立的，专有域的任务，转向长视野，跨域工作流程。这一过渡暴露了两个挑战：日益复杂的利用使得人工设计难以规模化，而与具体领域的更紧密的结合限制了单一的利用的通用性。因此，中心问题从如何为一个领域设计更强大的工具转向如何自主地建造专门工具，通过经验改进这些工具，并在各个领域加以协调。我们引入了Raven， The Harnesses，一个开源的多剂生态系统，它自动构建和演化特定模型和域的模块化带，将每个可执行的模型-harness配对作为可调和的智能单元。为了支持一个全域协作网络，其主机代理会分解目标，将子任务匹配到专门代理，协调执行依赖，并整合结果，而主机档案和EverOS则保存跨任务的经验，Skill Forge使该经验成为可重复使用的程序。我们的理论为这种构成提供了充分的条件，以扩大可靠的任务范围，使其超出共享资源预算下现有个别代理人的任务范围。在复杂而长的视野任务上，雷文显著地超越了最先进的特工系统，推动了可复合的特工智能的前沿。

items.subtitle: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. items.detail: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.
items.title_zh: 地面基础：面向视觉原生体的地面基础模型
items.detail_zh: 精密地基事项。它指定了哪个物体是目标，以及该物体的位置，即使是在杂乱无章的物体和小物体中，它必须足够快地进行闭路控制。然而，视觉-语言行动(VLA)和世界行动模型(WAMS)从通用视觉-语言和视频生成主干中吸取了感知力，而这些主干在这样的环境下仍然失败。我们引入了GroundingPI，一种4B的Grounding基础模型，它生成点和框作为共享词汇中的量化坐标。培训将多式联运和空间预训、监督微调、强化学习与GPRO相结合，利用公共数据集和专用数据引擎的监督。根据34个地面基准的44个基线，地面测量项目确定了新的技术水平，平均为73.68%，高于较大的GPT-6 Astra(71.54%)。作为下游视觉骨干，GroundingPI改进了机器人操纵和自主驾驶的性能。在RoboTwin 2.0上，它比我们评价的所有四个分配外设置中的主流骨干要好，相对于最强的骨干而言，最高达24.8%。在RoboCasa-GR1上，50%的示威活动都超过了75%的培训基线。在作为视觉主干线的nuScenes上，GroundingPI平均实现0.296米的开球L2误差。我们系统地分析地表指数在规模和数据构成方面的预训。随着预训规模的扩大，下游自主驾驶和机器人操纵得到了改进。分析这11种感知能力的数据配方，显示出密集地面对两者的巨大好处，以及OCR作为感知学习的催化剂的潜力。这些结果支持将认知基础作为基础，并专门进行认知前培训，作为身体智能基础模型的有希望的方向。

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a fundamental paradigm for expanding Large Language Models beyond their static training limitations. However, a critical misalignment exists between current RAG capabilities and real-world information environments. Modern knowledge repositories are inherently multimodal, containing rich combinations of textual content, visual elements, structured tables, and mathematical expressions. Yet existing RAG frameworks are limited to textual content, creating fundamental gaps when processing multimodal documents. We present RAG-Anything, a unified framework that enables comprehensive knowledge retrieval across all modalities. Our approach reconceptualizes multimodal content as interconnected knowledge entities rather than isolated data types. The framework introduces dual-graph construction to capture both cross-modal relationships and textual semantics within a unified representation. We develop cross-modal hybrid retrieval that combines structural knowledge navigation with semantic matching. This enables effective reasoning over heterogeneous content where relevant evidence spans multiple modalities. RAG-Anything demonstrates superior performance on challenging multimodal benchmarks, achieving significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods. Performance gains become particularly pronounced on long documents where traditional approaches fail. Our framework establishes a new paradigm for multimodal knowledge access, eliminating the architectural fragmentation that constrains current systems. Our framework is open-sourced at: https://github.com/HKUDS/RAG-Anything.
items.title_zh: RAG-任何东西：全方位RAG框架
items.detail_zh: 检索增强型一代(RAG)已成为超越其静态训练局限性扩展大语言模型的基本范例。然而，目前的RAG能力和现实世界信息环境之间存在严重的错位。现代知识库内在是多模式的，包含丰富的文本内容组合，视觉元素，结构化的表格和数学表达。然而，现有的RAG框架仅限于文字内容，在处理多式联运文件时造成了根本的空白。我们提出 " 任何事情 " (RAG-Anything)，这是一个统一的框架，能够对所有模式进行全面的知识检索。我们的方法将多式联运内容重新定义为相互关联的知识实体，而不是孤立的数据类型。该框架引入了双图构思，以在统一代表制内既体现跨模式关系，又体现文字语义。我们开发了跨模式混合检索，将结构知识导航与语义匹配相结合。在相关证据涉及多种模式的情况下，这样就能够有效地对不同内容进行推理。 RAG-任何东西都显示出在挑战多式联运基准方面的优异表现，比最先进的方法有了重大的改进。在传统方法失败的长期文件中，业绩收益尤其明显。我们的框架为获得多式联运知识确立了新的范式，消除了制约现有系统的建筑不成体系。我们的框架开放来源于：https://github.com/HKUDS/RAG-Anything。

items.detail: This paper presents Youtu-Parsing, an efficient and versatile document parsing model designed for high-performance content extraction. The architecture employs a native Vision Transformer (ViT) featuring a dynamic-resolution visual encoder to extract shared document features, coupled with a prompt-guided Youtu-LLM-2B language model for layout analysis and region-prompted decoding. Leveraging this decoupled and feature-reusable framework, we introduce a high-parallelism decoding strategy comprising two core components: token parallelism and query parallelism. The token parallelism strategy concurrently generates up to 64 candidate tokens per inference step, which are subsequently validated through a verification mechanism. This approach yields a 5--11x speedup over traditional autoregressive decoding and is particularly well-suited for highly structured scenarios, such as table recognition. To further exploit the advantages of region-prompted decoding, the query parallelism strategy enables simultaneous content prediction for multiple bounding boxes (up to five), providing an additional 2x acceleration while maintaining output quality equivalent to standard decoding. Youtu-Parsing encompasses a diverse range of document elements, including text, formulas, tables, charts, seals, and hierarchical structures. Furthermore, the model exhibits strong robustness when handling rare characters, multilingual text, and handwritten content. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that Youtu-Parsing achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on both the OmniDocBench and olmOCR-bench benchmarks. Overall, Youtu-Parsing demonstrates significant experimental value and practical utility for large-scale document intelligence applications.
items.title_zh: Youtu-Parersing：通过高保拉利主义解码来认识、构建和识别
items.detail_zh: 本文介绍Youtu-Parsing，这是为高性能内容提取设计的高效多功能文档解析模型。该架构采用了以动态分辨率可视编码器为特色的本土视觉变形器(ViT)来取出共享的文档特性，并配有可被迅速引导的Youtu-LLM-2B语言模型来进行布局分析并进行区域催化解码。我们利用这个脱钩和可重复特性的框架，引入了由两个核心部分组成的高平行性解码战略：符号并行主义和查询并行主义。象征性平行战略同时产生最多64个候选的推断步骤，随后通过核查机制加以验证。这种方法产生5-11x比传统的自旋解码更快的速度，特别适合高度结构化的情景，如表识别。为了进一步发挥区域即时解码的优势，查询并行策略可以同时对多边框(最多为5个)进行内容预测，在保持输出质量等同标准解码的同时，提供额外2x加速。 Youtu-Parsing 包含多种文档元素，包括文本、公式、表格、图表、封条和分级结构。此外，该模型在处理稀有字符、多语种文本和手写内容时表现出了强烈的稳健性。广泛的评价表明，Youtu-Parsing在OmniDoc Bench和olmOCR-bench基准上都取得了最新业绩。总体而言，Youtu-Parsing在大规模文件智能应用中显示出重要的实验价值和实际效用。

items.detail: Vision-language models (VLMs) pretrained on large-scale multimodal datasets encode rich visual and linguistic knowledge, making them a strong foundation for robotics. Rather than training robotic policies from scratch, recent approaches adapt VLMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models that enable natural language-driven perception and control. However, existing VLAs are typically massive--often with billions of parameters--leading to high training costs and limited real-world deployability. Moreover, they rely on academic and industrial datasets, overlooking the growing availability of community-collected data from affordable robotic platforms. In this work, we present SmolVLA, a small, efficient, and community-driven VLA that drastically reduces both training and inference costs, while retaining competitive performance. SmolVLA is designed to be trained on a single GPU and deployed on consumer-grade GPUs or even CPUs. To further improve responsiveness, we introduce an asynchronous inference stack decoupling perception and action prediction from action execution, allowing higher control rates with chunked action generation. Despite its compact size, SmolVLA achieves performance comparable to VLAs that are 10x larger. We evaluate SmolVLA on a range of both simulated as well as real-world robotic benchmarks and release all code, pretrained models, and training data.
items.title_zh: SmolVLA：经济适用和高效机器人的愿景-语言-行动模型
items.detail_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在大规模多式联运数据集上预训，编码了丰富的视觉和语言知识，使其成为机器人学的坚实基础。近期的方法不是从零开始培训机器人政策，而是将VLMs改造为视觉语言动作(VLA)模型，使自然语言驱动的感知和控制成为可能。然而，现有的志愿军通常规模很大，往往有数十亿个参数，导致培训费用高昂，实际世界部署能力有限。此外，它们依靠学术和工业数据集，忽略了社区从负担得起的机器人平台收集的越来越多的数据。在这项工作中，我们介绍了SmolVLA，这是一个小型、高效和社区驱动的VLA，它大大减少了培训和推论费用，同时保留了竞争性业绩。 SmolVLA的设计是在单一GPU上进行训练，并部署在消费级GPU甚至CPU上。为了进一步提高反应能力，我们引入了一个同步推论堆栈，将感知和行动预测与动作执行脱钩，从而能够用块状动作生成来提高控制率。尽管SmolVLA的体积比较紧凑，但能达到与10x更大的VLA相当的性能。我们用一系列模拟和现实世界的机器人基准来评估SmolVLA，并发布所有代码，预先训练的模型和培训数据。

items.detail: While recent generative models advance pixel-space video synthesis, they remain limited in producing professional educational videos, which demand disciplinary knowledge, precise visual structures, and coherent transitions, limiting their applicability in educational scenarios. Intuitively, such requirements are better addressed through the manipulation of a renderable environment, which can be explicitly controlled via logical commands (e.g., code). In this work, we propose Code2Video, a code-centric agent framework for generating educational videos via executable Python code. The framework comprises three collaborative agents: (i) Planner, which structures lecture content into temporally coherent flows and prepares corresponding visual assets; (ii) Coder, which converts structured instructions into executable Python codes while incorporating scope-guided auto-fix to enhance efficiency; and (iii) Critic, which leverages vision-language models (VLM) with visual anchor prompts to refine spatial layout and ensure clarity. To support systematic evaluation, we build MMMC, a benchmark of professionally produced, discipline-specific educational videos. We evaluate MMMC across diverse dimensions, including VLM-as-a-Judge aesthetic scores, code efficiency, and particularly, TeachQuiz, a novel end-to-end metric that quantifies how well a VLM, after unlearning, can recover knowledge by watching the generated videos. Our results demonstrate the potential of Code2Video as a scalable, interpretable, and controllable approach, achieving 40% improvement over direct code generation and producing videos comparable to human-crafted tutorials. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/showlab/Code2Video.
items.title_zh: 代码2Video：以代码为中心的教育视频生成范式
items.detail_zh: 虽然最近的基因模型推进了像素空间视频合成，但它们在制作专业教育视频方面仍然有限，这需要学科知识，精确的视觉结构，以及连贯的过渡，限制了它们在教育情景中的应用性。直觉上，这种要求通过操纵可变的环境得到更好的解决，这种环境可以通过逻辑指令(如代码)明确控制。在这部作品中，我们提出了Code2Video，一个通过可执行的Python代码生成教育视频的以代码为中心的代理框架。框架由3个协作代理组成：(一) 规划员，负责将讲解内容构建为时间上一致的流，并准备相应的视觉资产；(二) 编码员，负责将结构化指令转换为可执行的Python代码，同时纳入范围引导自动固定，以提高效率；(三) 批评员，负责利用视觉语言模型(VLM)，利用视觉主播提示来完善空间布局，确保清晰度。为了支持系统评价，我们建立了MMC，这是专业制作的、针对学科的教育录像的基准。我们从不同角度评价MMMC，包括VLM-as-a-Judge的审美分数，代码效率，特别是TeachQuiz，一个全新的端到端度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度 我们的结果显示了Code2Video作为可伸缩、可解释和可控制方法的潜力，实现了40%的改进而不是直接生成代码，并制作了与人造教学相类似的视频。数据集见https://github.com/showlab/Code2Video。

items.detail: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly deployed in enterprise search and document-centric assistants, where responses must be grounded in long and complex source materials. In practice, verifying that generated answers faithfully reflect retrieved documents is difficult: large language models can check long contexts but are too slow and costly for interactive services, while lightweight classifiers operate within strict context limits and frequently miss evidence outside truncated passages. We present the design of a real-time verification component integrated into a production RAG pipeline that enables full-document grounding under latency constraints. The system processes documents up to 32K tokens and employs adaptive inference strategies to balance response time and verification coverage across workloads. We describe the architectural decisions, operational trade-offs, and evaluation methodology used to deploy the verifier, and show that full-context verification substantially improves detection of unsupported responses compared with truncated validation. Our experience highlights when long-context verification is necessary, why chunk-based checking often fails in real documents, and how latency budgets shape model design. These findings provide practical guidance for practitioners building reliable large-scale retrieval-augmented applications. (Model, benchmark, and code: https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)
items.title_zh: 快速而忠实：长文件检索强化生成系统的实时验证
items.detail_zh: 在企业搜索和以文件为中心的助理中，越来越多地部署检索增强的生成(RAG)，这些助理的反应必须基于长期和复杂的原始材料。在实践中，核查生成的答案忠实地反映检索到的文档是困难的：大型语言模型可以检查较长的上下文，但对于交互服务来说太慢和成本太高，而轻量级分类器在严格的上下文限制下运行，经常在截断的段落之外错过证据。我们提出将实时核查部分纳入生产RAG管道的设计，以便在暂时性限制下全面铺设文件。该系统处理多达32K令牌的文件，并采用适应性的推断战略，以平衡反应时间和工作量的核查范围。我们描述了用于部署核查员的建筑决定、业务权衡和评价方法，并表明，与短时间验证相比，全文核查大大改进了对无支持答复的检测。我们的经验突出表明，何时需要长文核查，为什么在真实文件中往往不进行块式检查，以及预算如何塑造模型。这些研究结果为从业人员建设可靠的大规模检索强化应用程序提供了实际指导。 (模式、基准和代码：https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)

items.detail: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. Qwen3-TTS supports state-of-the-art 3-second voice cloning and description-based control, allowing both the creation of entirely novel voices and fine-grained manipulation over the output speech. Trained on over 5 million hours of speech data spanning 10 languages, Qwen3-TTS adopts a dual-track LM architecture for real-time synthesis, coupled with two speech tokenizers: 1) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz is a single-codebook codec emphasizing semantic content, which offers seamlessly integration with Qwen-Audio and enables streaming waveform reconstruction via a block-wise DiT. 2) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz achieves extreme bitrate reduction and ultra-low-latency streaming, enabling immediate first-packet emission (97,ms) through its 12.5 Hz, 16-layer multi-codebook design and a lightweight causal ConvNet. Extensive experiments indicate state-of-the-art performance across diverse objective and subjective benchmark (e.g., TTS multilingual test set, InstructTTSEval, and our long speech test set). To facilitate community research and development, we release both tokenizers and models under the Apache 2.0 license.
items.title_zh: Qune3-TTS 技术报告
items.detail_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了Qune3-TTS系列，这是一个由先进的多语种，可控，强健，流畅的文本对语音模型组成的家族。 Qune3-TTS支持最先进的3秒语音克隆和基于描述的控制，既允许创造全新的声音，也允许精细地操纵输出语音。 Qune3-TTS对跨越10种语言的500多万小时的语音数据进行了培训，采用双轨LM架构进行实时合成，并配有两种语音示意器： 1) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz是一个强调语义内容的单码簿编码器，它提供与Qun-Audio的无缝集成，并通过区块化的DiT.2实现流波形重建 2) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz实现极端比特率的降低和超低纬度流化，通过它的12.5Hz，16层多码簿设计以及轻量因子ConvNet，使得立即的第一包排放(97，ms)成为可能。广泛的实验表明跨越不同客观和主观基准(如TTS多语种测试集，InstructTTSEval，以及我们的长语音测试集)的先进性能。为了促进社区研发，我们根据Apache 2.0许可证发布了标致剂和模型。

items.detail: Classical structure-from-motion reconstruction proceeds iteratively, refining camera poses and scene geometry from a current estimate. This allows maps to easily expand without recomputing already computed views, or geometry estimates to improve as more observations are provided. Most geometric foundation models, however, predict entire geometry in a single forward pass or update a recurrent state as frames arrive sequentially, making this expansion and refinement non-trivial. We introduce Solv3R, a looped transformer that learns to continue solving multi-view geometry from its current state. Importantly, its update operator is independent of the iteration count, allowing previously refined and newly introduced views to be jointly updated regardless of how ``solved'' they are. We train the operator to preserve accurate reconstructions under continued iteration and correct inaccurate states, enabling refinement of fixed image collections and integration of new observations. Representations of solved views can also be cached once and reused as geometric context across iterations, enabling compact and efficient key-value caching. We analyze the solver dynamics and compare it with the state-of-the-art, demonstrating that a single learned solver supports offline reconstruction, incremental reconstruction, relocalization, and streaming without task-specific training or modules. The code and models will be made publicly available at https://ubc-vision.github.io/solv3r/.
items.title_zh: Solv3R：三维循环变换器作为多视图解析器
items.detail_zh: 古典结构 - 从运动重建 反复进行，精炼相机姿势和场景几何 从目前的估计。这样可以方便地扩展地图，而无需重新计算已经计算的视图，或者随着提供更多的观测结果而改进几何估计。然而，大多数几何地基模型都预测整个几何在一次前行传中，或者随着帧相继到达而更新了常态，使得这种扩展和精炼非三角。我们引入了Solv3R，一种循环变速器，它学习继续从当前状态解决多视图几何问题。重要的是，其更新操作员独立于重复计数，可以让先前经过改进和新提出的观点共同更新，而不论其“解决”的程度如何。我们训练操作人员在不断重复和纠正不准确状态下保存准确的重建，从而能够完善固定图像收集并整合新的观测结果。对已解开的视图的表示也可被缓存一次并重复使用，作为跨迭代的几何上下文，从而能够进行紧凑而高效的密钥值缓存。我们分析解析器动态，并将其与最先进的解析器进行比较，表明一个单一的有学识的解析器支持离线重建，增量重建，再定位，并流出而不进行特定任务的培训或模块。守则和模型将在https://ubc-vision.github.io/solv3r/上公布。

items.title: Fish Audio S2 Technical Report
items.subtitle: We introduce Fish Audio S2, an open-sourced text-to-speech system featuring multi-speaker, multi-turn generation, and, most importantly, instruction-following control via natural-language descriptions. items.detail: We introduce Fish Audio S2, an open-sourced text-to-speech system featuring multi-speaker, multi-turn generation, and, most importantly, instruction-following control via natural-language descriptions. To scale training, we develop a multi-stage training recipe together with a staged data pipeline covering video captioning and speech captioning, voice-quality assessment, and reward modeling. To push the frontier of open-source TTS, we release our model weights, fine-tuning code, and an SGLang-based inference engine. The inference engine is production-ready for streaming, achieving an RTF of 0.195 and a time-to-first-audio below 100 ms.Our code and weights are available on GitHub (https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro). We highly encourage readers to visit https://fish.audio to try custom voices.
items.title_zh: 鱼声S2技术报告
items.detail_zh: 我们引进了Fish Audio S2，一个开源的文字对语音系统，其特点是多语种，多回合生成，最重要的是通过自然语言描述来遵循指令控制。为了扩大培训规模，我们开发了一个多阶段培训配方，以及一个包括视频字幕和语音字幕、语音质量评估和奖励模式的分阶段数据管道。为了推进开源TTS的前沿，我们发布了我们的模型重量，微调代码，以及基于SGLang的推论引擎。推论引擎为流式生产准备，实现0.195RTF，100ms以下时间对首发。我们的代码和权重可在GitHub(https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech)和Hugging Face(https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro)上查阅。我们大力鼓励读者访问https://fish.audio，

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as long-term interactive agents, yet their limited context windows make it difficult to sustain coherent behavior over extended interactions. Existing memory systems often store isolated records and retrieve fragments, limiting their ability to consolidate evolving user states and resolve conflicts. We introduce EverMemOS, a self-organizing memory operating system that implements an engram-inspired lifecycle for computational memory. Episodic Trace Formation converts dialogue streams into MemCells that capture episodic traces, atomic facts, and time-bounded Foresight signals. Semantic Consolidation organizes MemCells into thematic MemScenes, distilling stable semantic structures and updating user profiles. Reconstructive Recollection performs MemScene-guided agentic retrieval to compose the necessary and sufficient context for downstream reasoning. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that EverMemOS achieves state-of-the-art performance on memory-augmented reasoning tasks. We further report a profile study on PersonaMem v2 and qualitative case studies illustrating chat-oriented capabilities such as user profiling and Foresight. Code is available at https://github.com/EverMind-AI/EverMemOS.
items.title_zh: EverMemOS：结构化长视距内存操作系统
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)作为长期互动代理越来越多地被部署，然而其有限的上下文窗口使得在扩展互动上难以维持连贯的行为。现有的内存系统经常存储孤立的记录并检索碎片，限制了它们巩固不断发展的用户状态和解决冲突的能力。我们引入了 EverMemOS，一个自组织内存操作系统，它执行一个被engram启发的生命周期用于计算内存。 Episodic Trace Formation 将对话框流转换成MemCells，可以捕捉偶发的痕迹，原子事实，以及有时限的前瞻信号。语义整合将MemCells组织成主题的MemScens，蒸馏稳定的语义结构并更新用户简介。重构回想执行 MemScene 制导的代理检索，为下游推理创造必要和充分的上下文。 LoCoMo和LongMemEval上的实验显示，EverMemOS在内存增强推理任务上实现了最先进的性能。我们还报告关于PersonaMem v2的概况研究，以及定性案例研究，说明以聊天为导向的能力，如用户剖析和展望。代码见https://github.com/EverMind-AI/EverMemOS。

items.detail: Across coding, web, and tool-use tasks, language-model agents are now routinely trained with the same recipe: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to learn the interface, then multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) to master it. Code-as-policy (CaP) casts robot manipulation in the same form, as the policy writes code against robot APIs and reads back the results, so the same recipe should apply. Yet existing CaP agents sidestep training: they either prompt closed frontier models or delegate manipulation to pre-trained vision-language-action models (VLAs) and high-level skills, while small open vision-language models (VLMs) fail outright. We present CaPtain, an open post-training pipeline that turns a small open VLM into a capable CaP agent, with no VLA, frontier model, or privileged state at test time. CaPtain trains and deploys the policy inside CaPtain-Harness, which exposes low-level perception, geometry, and guarded-motion primitives across simulation and real hardware. We first align the base model via SFT on synthetic trajectories generated with GPT-6 Astra, then apply multi-turn RL. Multi-turn RL must credit tens of agent requests, whose physical effects often surface turns later, from a single end-of-episode outcome. We therefore introduce a physical critic that reads privileged simulator state, never seen by the policy, and credits each request by how much it changes the predicted chance of success. Starting from Qwen3.5-4B (0% zero-shot), CaPtain-4B reaches 55.4% held-out LIBERO success after SFT and 73.8% after RL. On LIBERO-PRO, it reaches 78.5%, surpassing several frontier-model agents, and its RL gains persist across three perturbation suites (+17.6 to +21.2 points). Without target-domain training, it attains 83.3% on SimplerEnv WidowX, exceeds frontier models on CaP-Bench, and runs on a real robot after simulation-only adaptation. We release all code, data, and model weights.
items.title_zh: CaPtain：培训后代码-政策机器人代理的管道
items.detail_zh: 在整个编码、网络和工具使用任务中，语言模型代理人现在都定期接受同样的食谱培训：受监督的微调(SFT)学习界面，然后是多回合强化学习(RL)来掌握界面。代码-as-policy (CaP) 将机器人操控方式设定为同一种形式，因为政策会针对机器人API写出代码并读取结果，所以同样的食谱应该适用。然而，现有的CaP代理商回避培训：他们要么推动封闭的前沿模型，要么授权操纵预先培训的视觉语言行动模型(VLA)和高级技能，而小型开放的视觉语言模型(VLM)则彻底失败。我们介绍CaPtain，一个开放的训练后管道，它把一个小的开放的VLM 变成一个有能力的CaP代理，没有VLA，前沿模型，或特权状态的测试时间。 CaPtain在CaPtain-Harness(英语：CaPtain-Harness)内部进行训练并部署政策，它暴露出低水平的感知，几何，和守护-运动原始人跨越了模拟和真实的硬件。我们首先通过SFT在由GPT-6 Astra所生成的合成轨迹上对准了基础模型，然后应用多回转的RL。多回转的RL必须信用于数十个代理请求，其物理效应往往会从一个单一的终极结果中转出后表面。因此，我们引入了一个物理评论家，阅读特权模拟状态，从来没有被政策看到，从Quen3.5-4B(0%为零发)起，CaPtain-4B在SFT后达到55.4%被搁置的LIBERO成功率，在RL后达到73.8%。在LIBERO-PRO上，它达到了78.5%，超过了几个前沿型特工，它的RL增益在三个扰动套房(+17.6到+21.2分)上持续。没有目标域训练，它在SimmerEnv WiebleX上取得了83.3%的成绩，超过了CaP-Bench上的前沿模型，并在模拟后只进行模拟改造后运行在真正的机器人上。我们发布所有的代码，数据和模型重量。
