items.detail: Conversational systems, such as duplex speech language models (SLMs), still lack a streaming, accurate, and empathetic memory system as their soul. We introduce VoiceMem, a simple memory architecture with a parallel informational left brain, an emotional right brain, and streaming memory I/O mechanisms. We further build a complete pipeline for memory-aware SLM training, long-horizon evaluation, and decoupled deployment with interchangeable memory backends. Experiments and real-world deployment show three advantages: i) Accuracy: under top-5 retrieval, the left brain outperforms classical systems such as Mem0 at top-200 by nearly 30 points; ii) Emotional & Personal: the right brain, with short- and long-horizon affective attribution and dual-node persona modeling, achieves state-of-the-art performance across three persona benchmarks and improves the aggregate score by 4.29 points over the previous best system; and iii) Real-Time & Cheap: VoiceMem completes retrieval in 134 ms, well within standard VAD latency, adding no extra conversational delay while maintaining high accuracy and low cost. These results show that VoiceMem provides a practical memory foundation for real-time, personalized, and emotionally aware speech interaction.
items.title_zh: VoiceMem：流动双脑内存用于实时互动
items.detail_zh: 对话式系统，如双倍语音语言模型(SLMS)，仍然缺乏作为灵魂的流体，准确性和爱心记忆系统。我们引入了VoiceMem，一个简单的记忆架构，它具有平行的信息左脑，情感右脑，以及流传的记忆I/O机制。我们进一步为记忆意识的可持续土地管理培训、长视野评估以及与可互换记忆后端脱钩的部署搭建了完整的管道。实验和现实世界部署显示三个优点： (一)精准度：在最高-5检索下，左脑在最高-200的Mem0等古典系统上以近30分超越； (二)情感与个人：右脑，具有短和长距离的反感归属和双节点人物模型，在三个人物基准上实现最先进的性能，比之前的最佳系统提高总分4.29分； (三)实时与便宜度：声音Mem完成134ms的检索，远在标准的VAD空位内，在保持高精度和低成本的同时，不增加额外的对话延迟。这些结果表明，VoiceMem为实时，个性化，情感意识的语音互动提供了实用的记忆基础。

items.title: LlamaFactory: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ Language Models
items.subtitle: Efficient fine-tuning is vital for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, it requires non-trivial efforts to implement these methods on different models. We present LlamaFactory, a unified framework that integrates a suite of cutting-edge efficient training methods. It allows users to flexibly customize the fine-tuning of 100+ LLMs without the need for coding through the built-in web UI LlamaBoard. We empirically validate the efficiency and effectiveness of our framework on language modeling and text generation tasks. It has been released at https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory and already received over 13,000 stars and 1,600 forks.

items.title_zh: Llama Factory：100+语言模型的统一高效精细化
items.detail_zh: 有效的微调对于大型语言模型适应下游任务至关重要。然而，这需要非三角努力，在不同模式上实施这些方法。我们介绍LlamaFactory，这是一个统一框架，它整合了一套先进的高效培训方法。它允许用户灵活地自定义了100+LLMs的微调而无需通过内置的网络UI LlamaBoard进行编码。我们从经验上验证了我们关于语言建模和文本生成任务的框架的效率和成效。它已经在https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory上发布，已经收到了超过13000颗恒星和1600个叉。

items.title: FunAudioLLM: Voice Understanding and Generation Foundation Models for Natural Interaction Between Humans and LLMs
items.subtitle: This report introduces FunAudioLLM, a model family designed to enhance natural voice interactions between humans and large language models (LLMs). At its core are two innovative models: SenseVoice, which handles multilingual speech recognition, emotion recognition, and audio event detection; and CosyVoice, which facilitates natural speech generation with control over multiple languages, timbre, speaking style, and speaker identity. SenseVoice-Small delivers exceptionally low-latency ASR for 5 languages, and SenseVoice-Large supports high-precision ASR for over 50 languages, while CosyVoice excels in multi-lingual voice generation, zero-shot in-context learning, cross-lingual voice cloning, a
items.detail: This report introduces FunAudioLLM, a model family designed to enhance natural voice interactions between humans and large language models (LLMs). At its core are two innovative models: SenseVoice, which handles multilingual speech recognition, emotion recognition, and audio event detection; and CosyVoice, which facilitates natural speech generation with control over multiple languages, timbre, speaking style, and speaker identity. SenseVoice-Small delivers exceptionally low-latency ASR for 5 languages, and SenseVoice-Large supports high-precision ASR for over 50 languages, while CosyVoice excels in multi-lingual voice generation, zero-shot in-context learning, cross-lingual voice cloning, and instruction-following capabilities. The models related to SenseVoice and CosyVoice have been open-sourced on Modelscope and Huggingface, along with the corresponding training, inference, and fine-tuning codes released on GitHub. By integrating these models with LLMs, FunAudioLLM enables applications such as speech-to-speech translation, emotional voice chat, interactive podcasts, and expressive audiobook narration, thereby pushing the boundaries of voice interaction technology. Demos are available at https://fun-audio-llm.github.io, and the code can be accessed at https://github.com/FunAudioLLM.
items.title_zh: FunAudioLLM：人类与LLMs之间自然互动的语音理解和生成基础模型
items.detail_zh: 这份报告介绍了FunAudioLLM，这是一个模型家族，旨在增强人类和大语言模型(LLM)之间的自然语音相互作用。其核心是两个创新模式：SenseVoice，它处理多语种语音识别，情感识别，和音频事件检测；和CosyVoice，它促进自然语音生成，控制多语言，平淡，说话风格，和扬声器身份。 SenseVoice-Small为5种语言提供极低纬度的ASR，SenseVoice-Large为50多种语言支持高精度ASR，而CosyVoice在多语言语音生成，零镜头的同声文字学习，跨语言语音克隆，以及教学跟踪能力方面表现优异。与SenseVoice和CosyVoice相关的模型已经在Modelscope和Huggingface上开源，同时在GitHub上发布了相应的训练，推论和微调代码。 FunAudioLLM通过将这些模型与LLMs集成，实现了语音对语音翻译，情感语音聊天，交互式播客，以及表达式音频书解说等应用，从而推动语音交互技术的界限。 Demos可在https://fun-audio-llm.github.io上查阅，该代码可在https://github.com/FunAudioLLM上查阅。

items.title: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
items.subtitle: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models into a single framework. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cosmos 3 establishes a new state-of-the-art across a diverse suite of understanding and generation tasks, demonstrating omnimodal world models as scalable, general-purpose backbones for embodied agents. items.detail: We introduce Cosmos 3, a family of omnimodal world models designed to jointly process and generate language, image, video, audio, and action sequences within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. By supporting highly flexible input-output configurations, Cosmos 3 seamlessly unifies critical modalities for Physical AI -- effectively subsuming vision-language models, video generators, world simulators, and world-action models into a single framework. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cosmos 3 establishes a new state-of-the-art across a diverse suite of understanding and generation tasks, demonstrating omnimodal world models as scalable, general-purpose backbones for embodied agents. Our post-trained Cosmos 3 models were ranked as the best open-source Text-to-Image and Image-to-Video models by Artificial Analysis, and the best policy model by RoboArena at the time the technical report was written. To accelerate open research and deployment in Physical AI, we make our code, model checkpoints, curated synthetic datasets, and evaluation benchmark available under the Linux Foundation's OpenMDW-1.1 https://openmdw.ai/license/1-1/ License at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos}{github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3 . The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3 .
items.title_zh: Cosmos 3：物理AI世界模拟模型
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了宇宙3，一个全方位世界模型的家族，目的是在一个统一的转换器混合结构内 共同处理和生成语言，图像，视频，音频，和行动序列。通过支持高度灵活的输入-输出配置，Cosmos 3无缝地统一了物理AI的关键模式 -- -- 有效地将视觉语言模型，视频生成器，世界模拟器，以及世界行动模型等归为单一的框架。我们的评价表明，宇宙三号在各种各样的理解和生成任务中确立了新的最先进水平，展示了全方位世界模式作为可伸缩的、通用的、用于体现物剂的骨干。我们经过后期训练的"宇宙3"模型被"人工分析"评为"最佳开源文本到图像和图像到视频模型"，并被"Roboarena"评为技术报告编写时最佳政策模型。为了加快在物理AI中的公开研究和部署，我们在Linux基金会的OpenMDW-1.1 https://openmdw.ai/license/1-1/Liversity https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos}{github.com/nvidia/cosmos和https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3下提供我们的代码、模版检查站、被整理的合成数据集和评价基准。项目网站见https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos3。

items.title: Agent^2 RL-Bench: Can LLM Agents Engineer Agentic RL Post-Training?

items.detail: We introduce Agent2 RL-Bench, a compact diagnostic benchmark for evaluating agentic RL post-training, which tests whether LLM agents can autonomously design, implement, debug, and execute post-training pipelines that improve foundation models. RL post-training increasingly drives model alignment and specialization, yet existing benchmarks are largely static, rewarding supervised fine-tuning or script generation without assessing an agent's ability to close an interactive RL loop. Agent2 RL-Bench provides a unified agent-facing interface: each run starts from an isolated workspace containing a base model, task data, instructions, and a grading API, and agents must iterate within a fixed budget by training models and submitting artifacts for evaluation. The benchmark spans six tasks across three levels, from static rule-based training to judge-based optimization and closed-loop online RL with trajectory collection. Two diagnostic skills, namely runtime recording and post-hoc summarization, enable structured analysis of agent behavior, facilitating smooth and effective iteration of the benchmark's evaluation framework. Across five agent systems and six driver LLMs, agents show intelligent behavior but clear limitations: one RL-oriented run improves ALFWorld from 4.85 to 93.28 via SFT warm-up and GRPO with online rollouts, yet DeepSearchQA remains difficult, most successful routes rely on supervised pipelines, and interactive outcomes show large single-run differences across agent stacks. Overall, Agent2 RL-Bench shows that current agents can sometimes engineer online RL, but stable agent-driven RL post-training remains rare under fixed budgets. It also demonstrates that our benchmark provides a strong and effective evaluation framework for future research in this direction. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/blob/main/rdagent/scenarios/rl/autorl_bench/README.md
items.title_zh: 代理 ^2 RL- Bench： LLM 代理 工程师 代理 RL 后训练？
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Agent2 RL-Bench，这是评价代理RL后训练的紧凑诊断基准，该基准测试LLM代理是否能够自主地设计，执行，调试，以及执行改进基础模型的训练后管线。 RL后培训越来越能推动模型的对接和专业化，但现有的基准基本是静态的，奖励有监督的微调或脚本生成，而不评估代理商关闭交互式RL环的能力。 Agent2 RL-Bench提供了统一的代理-造型接口：每次运行都从一个孤立的工作空间开始，包含一个基础模型，任务数据，指令，以及一个分级的API，代理必须通过培训模型和提交文物进行评价，在固定预算范围内进行迭接。该基准跨越从静态规则培训到基于法官的优化和有轨迹收集的闭路在线RL等三个层面的6个任务。两种诊断技能，即运行时间记录和随机汇总后，能够对代理行为进行有条理的分析，促进基准评价框架的平稳和有效迭代。在五个代理系统和六个驱动程序LLMs中，代理显示智能行为，但有明显的局限性：一个面向RL的运行改进了ALFWorld，从4.85到93.28通过SFT热身和GPRO在线推出，然而DeepSearchQA仍然困难重重，大多数成功路线依赖于有监督的管线，互动结果显示各代理堆的单运行差异很大。总体而言，Agent2 RL-Bench显示，当前代理有时可以在线设计RL，但稳定代理驱动的RL后培训在固定预算下仍然罕见。它还表明，我们的基准为今后这方面的研究提供了有力而有效的评价框架。代码见https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/blob/main/rdagent/scenarios/rl/autorl bench/README.md。

items.detail: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has proven to be an effective tool for post-training language models (LMs). However, AI systems are increasingly expressed as modular programs that mix together multiple LM calls with distinct prompt templates and other tools, and it is not clear how best to leverage GRPO to improve these systems. We begin to address this challenge by defining mmGRPO, a simple multi-module generalization of GRPO that groups LM calls by module across rollouts and handles variable-length and interrupted trajectories. We find that mmGRPO, composed with automatic prompt optimization, improves accuracy by 11% on average across classification, many-hop search, and privacy-preserving delegation tasks against the post-trained LM, and by 5% against prompt optimization on its own. We open-source mmGRPO in DSPy as the dspy.GRPO optimizer.
items.title_zh: 多模块 GRPO：语言模型程序构建政策梯度和快速优化
items.detail_zh: 团体相对政策优化(GRPO)已被证明是培训后语言模型的有效工具。然而，AI系统越来越多地被表述为模块化程序，将多个LM调用组合在一起，并带有独特的即时模板和其他工具，目前尚不清楚如何最佳地利用GRPO来改进这些系统。我们开始通过定义mmGRPO来应对这一挑战，这是一个简单的GRPO的多模块概括，LM组通过模块逐个调用，处理可变长度和被中断的轨迹。我们发现由自动快速优化组成的 mmGRPO 提高了准确度 11% 跨分类，多跳搜索，和隐私保护任务 后训练的 LM，以及5% 的 自身快速优化。我们在DSPY开源的mmGRPO作为dspy。 GPRO优化器。

items.detail: Data-centric training has emerged as a promising direction for improving large language models (LLMs) by optimizing not only model parameters but also the selection, composition, and weighting of training data during optimization. However, existing approaches to data selection, data mixture optimization, and data reweighting are often developed in isolated codebases with inconsistent interfaces, hindering reproducibility, fair comparison, and practical integration. In this paper, we present DataFlex, a unified data-centric dynamic training framework built upon LLaMA-Factory. DataFlex supports three major paradigms of dynamic data optimization: sample selection, domain mixture adjustment, and sample reweighting, while remaining fully compatible with the original training workflow. It provides extensible trainer abstractions and modular components, enabling a drop-in replacement for standard LLM training, and unifies key model-dependent operations such as embedding extraction, inference, and gradient computation, with support for large-scale settings including DeepSpeed ZeRO-3. We conduct comprehensive experiments across multiple data-centric methods. Dynamic data selection consistently outperforms static full-data training on MMLU across both Mistral-7B and Llama-3.2-3B. For data mixture, DoReMi and ODM improve both MMLU accuracy and corpus-level perplexity over default proportions when pretraining Qwen2.5-1.5B on SlimPajama at 6B and 30B token scales. DataFlex also achieves consistent runtime improvements over original implementations. These results demonstrate that DataFlex provides an effective, efficient, and reproducible infrastructure for data-centric dynamic training of LLMs.
items.title_zh: DataFlex：大语言模型数据-儿童动态培训的统一框架
items.detail_zh: 以数据为中心的培训已成为改进大型语言模型的有希望的方向，不仅优化了模型参数，而且优化了培训数据的选择、组成和权重。然而，数据选择、数据混合物优化和数据重新加权的现有方法常常是在接口不一致的孤立代码库中开发的，阻碍了可复制性、公平比较和实际的整合。在本文中，我们介绍了DataFlex，这是一个基于LLaMA-Factory的统一的数据中心动态培训框架。 DataFlex支持动态数据优化的三个主要范式：样本选择，域混合调整，以及样本重置，同时保持与原始培训工作流程完全兼容。它提供了可扩展的教练抽象和模块化组件，使得标准LLM培训能够进行即时替换，并统一了嵌入提取，推论，梯度计算等依赖模型的关键操作，支持包括DeepSpeed ZeRO-3在内的大规模设置。我们通过多种以数据为中心的方法进行全面实验。动态数据选择在Mistral-7B和Llama-3.2-3B两地的MMLU静态全数据培训上，始终比其业绩要好。对于数据混合物，当在SlimPajama上预训Quen2.5-1.5B时，DoRemi和ODM在6B和30B符号尺度上提高MMLU的精度和实体级的复杂度，而不是默认比例。 DataFlex还实现了与原始执行相比的连续运行时间改进。这些结果表明，DataFlex为LLMs的数据中心动态培训提供了一个有效、高效和可复制的基础设施。

items.detail: Recent text-to-video diffusion models can generate compelling video sequences, yet they remain silent -- missing the semantic, emotional, and atmospheric cues that audio provides. We introduce LTX-2, an open-source foundational model capable of generating high-quality, temporally synchronized audiovisual content in a unified manner. LTX-2 consists of an asymmetric dual-stream transformer with a 14B-parameter video stream and a 5B-parameter audio stream, coupled through bidirectional audio-video cross-attention layers with temporal positional embeddings and cross-modality AdaLN for shared timestep conditioning. This architecture enables efficient training and inference of a unified audiovisual model while allocating more capacity for video generation than audio generation. We employ a multilingual text encoder for broader prompt understanding and introduce a modality-aware classifier-free guidance (modality-CFG) mechanism for improved audiovisual alignment and controllability. Beyond generating speech, LTX-2 produces rich, coherent audio tracks that follow the characters, environment, style, and emotion of each scene -- complete with natural background and foley elements. In our evaluations, the model achieves state-of-the-art audiovisual quality and prompt adherence among open-source systems, while delivering results comparable to proprietary models at a fraction of their computational cost and inference time. All model weights and code are publicly released.
items.title_zh: LTX-2：高效联合视听基础模型
items.detail_zh: 最近的文字到视频传播模型可以产生令人信服的视频序列，然而它们却保持沉默——缺少音频提供的语义，情感和大气提示。我们采用LTX-2，是一种开源基础模型，能够以统一的方式生成高质量，时间同步的视听内容。 LTX-2由非对称双流变压器组成，具有14B参数的视频流和5B参数的音频流，通过双向音频-视频交叉透视层结合而成，具有时间定位嵌入和跨模式的AdaLN用于共享时序调节。这种结构能够有效培训和推论统一的视听模式，同时分配比音频生成更多的视频生成能力。我们使用多语种文本编码器，以便迅速获得更广泛的理解，并采用一种无模式识别的分类器指导(模式-CFG)机制，以改进视听协调和可控性。 LTX-2除了生成语音外，还产生丰富，连贯的音频音轨，跟踪每个场景的人物，环境，风格和情感——完整地带有自然背景和foley元素。在我们的评价中，该模式实现了最先进的视听质量，并使开源系统迅速遵守，同时以占其计算成本和推断时间的一小部分，提供与专有模式可比的成果。所有模型重量和代码都公开发布。

items.title: StreamDuo: A Live Commentator and a Research Agent for Unseen Games
items.subtitle: Streaming video LLMs can now commentate live gameplay, but they are trained and tested on the same games. We study cross-game streaming commentary, in which a model trained on one game commentates games it has never seen, and find that current commentators transfer their timing but not their knowledge of the game world. We propose StreamDuo, which pairs a trainable commentator with a frozen research agent that reads the wiki of the game being played. items.detail: Streaming video LLMs can now commentate live gameplay, but they are trained and tested on the same games. We study cross-game streaming commentary, in which a model trained on one game commentates games it has never seen, and find that current commentators transfer their timing but not their knowledge of the game world. We propose StreamDuo, which pairs a trainable commentator with a frozen research agent that reads the wiki of the game being played. When the commentator sees something it cannot name, it sends the current frames, and the research agent returns a few wiki entries two seconds later while the stream continues. We train only the commentator, on a single game, in two stages. Information-gain labels teach it to ask only where an answer would help it say what the human caster said, and on-policy self-distillation from a copy of itself that sees the ideal answer teaches it to use noisy answers. Trained on Baldur's Gate 3 and tested on ten unseen games, StreamDuo raises entity recall from 0.082 to 0.116 over Proact-VL trained on the same data, cuts source-game leakage from 9.9% to 1.0%, and achieves the best timing and the highest judged liveliness and overall quality among streaming models.

items.detail: The rapidly growing demand for high-quality data in Large Language Models (LLMs) has intensified the need for scalable, reliable, and semantically rich data preparation pipelines. However, current practices remain dominated by ad-hoc scripts and loosely specified workflows, which lack principled abstractions, hinder reproducibility, and offer limited support for model-in-the-loop data generation. To address these challenges, we present DataFlow, a unified and extensible LLM-driven data preparation framework. DataFlow is designed with system-level abstractions that enable modular, reusable, and composable data transformations, and provides a PyTorch-style pipeline construction API for building debuggable and optimizable dataflows. The framework consists of nearly 200 reusable operators and six domain-general pipelines spanning text, mathematical reasoning, code, Text-to-SQL, agentic RAG, and large-scale knowledge extraction. To further improve usability, we introduce DataFlow-Agent, which automatically translates natural-language specifications into executable pipelines via operator synthesis, pipeline planning, and iterative verification. Across six representative use cases, DataFlow consistently improves downstream LLM performance. Our math, code, and text pipelines outperform curated human datasets and specialized synthetic baselines, achieving up to +3\% execution accuracy in Text-to-SQL over SynSQL, +7\% average improvements on code benchmarks, and 1--3 point gains on MATH, GSM8K, and AIME. Moreover, a unified 10K-sample dataset produced by DataFlow enables base models to surpass counterparts trained on 1M Infinity-Instruct data. These results demonstrate that DataFlow provides a practical and high-performance substrate for reliable, reproducible, and scalable LLM data preparation, and establishes a system-level foundation for future data-centric AI development.
items.title_zh: DataFlow：数据科学AI时代统一数据编制和工作流程自动化的LLM-Driven框架
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)对高质量数据的需求迅速增加，因此更加需要可扩展、可靠和精密的数据编制管道。然而，目前的做法仍然以临时的脚本和松散地指定的工作流程为主，这些工作流程缺乏原则性抽象，阻碍可复制性，并且对即时数据模型生成提供了有限的支持。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了“数据流”，一个统一和可扩展的LLM驱动数据编制框架。 DataFlow采用系统级抽象设计，可实现模块化，可再用和可堆叠的数据转换，并提供PyTorch风格的管道构造 API用于构建可调试和可选择的数据流。该框架包括近200个可重复使用的操作员和6个域通管，跨越文本，数学推理，代码，文本到SQL，代理RAG，以及大规模的知识提取。为了进一步提高可用性，我们引入了"DataFlow-Agent"(DataFlow-Agent)，通过运营商合成，管道规划和迭代验证，自动将自然语言规格翻译为可执行管线。在六个有代表性的使用案例中，DataFlow持续改善下游的LLM性能。我们的数学、代码和文本管道比人类数据集和专门的合成基线要好，在文本到SQL的执行精度高于SynSQL， +7+在代码基准上的平均改进，以及MATH、GSM8K和AIME上的1-3分增益。此外，由DataFlow制作的统一10K-抽样数据集使基础模型能够超越接受过1M无穷指令数据培训的对应数据。这些结果表明，"DataFlow"为可靠，可再生，可扩展的LLM数据编制提供了实用而高性能的底板，为未来以数据为中心的AI开发奠定了系统层面的基础。

items.detail: Building applications that perceive the world around them is challenging. A developer needs to (a) select and develop corresponding machine learning algorithms and models, (b) build a series of prototypes and demos, (c) balance resource consumption against the quality of the solutions, and finally (d) identify and mitigate problematic cases. The MediaPipe framework addresses all of these challenges. A developer can use MediaPipe to build prototypes by combining existing perception components, to advance them to polished cross-platform applications and measure system performance and resource consumption on target platforms. We show that these features enable a developer to focus on the algorithm or model development and use MediaPipe as an environment for iteratively improving their application with results reproducible across different devices and platforms. MediaPipe will be open-sourced at https://github.com/google/mediapipe.
items.title_zh: MediaPipe：建设认知管道的框架
items.detail_zh: 建立能感知周围世界的应用是具有挑战性的。开发者需要(a) 选择和开发相应的机器学习算法和模型，(b) 建立一系列原型和演示，(c) 平衡资源消耗与解决方案质量，最后(d) 发现并缓解有问题的案例。 MediaPipe框架处理所有这些挑战。一个开发者可以使用MediaPipe通过将现有的感知组件组合起来来构建原型，以推进它们来抛光跨平台的应用程序并测量目标平台的系统性能和资源消耗。我们显示，这些特性使开发者能够专注于算法或模型开发，并使用MediaPipe作为环境来反复改进它们的应用，其结果可以在不同设备和平台上复制。 MediaPipe将在https://github.com/google/mediapipe上开源。

items.detail: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet. If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.
items.title_zh: 六舍尔：探索作为机器人编码代理的VLM代理的极限的微弱优势
items.detail_zh: 以视觉语言模型(VLMs)为基础的代理商现在与关于机器人操纵领导板的学习政策竞争。我们问一个编码代理在控制一个机器人而不是计算机时能走多远，以及它停在哪里。我们的系统，HexaShell，保持了控制：它只会把特工的命令变成机器人的运动。特工驾驶一个双臂机器人通过一个命令行。它看到三台RGB摄像头并知道它们的校准。每次尝试失败后，代理会读取日志，找到原因，并写或修正名为工具的小程序。这样它就能保持它作为代码学到的东西，就像它修复失败测试时的编码代理所做的那样。这些工具可能只使用机器人观察到的东西。它们利用三角测量来寻找物体的位置，相对彼此和捕捉者。如果两台相机看到同一点，则点位于两台相机射线相遇的地方。如果一个点位于已知的平面上，如桌子或块的顶部，它就位于它的射线与该平面相遇的地方。当头摄像头不够时，机器人会移动手腕摄像头以获得第二个视图。我们每件任务只用一个种子的十种布局来建造工具，然后将其冻结，并在同一个种子的十种新布局上进行测试。我们在中度推理过程中使用GPT-6-Astra的Codex。在所有42项RoboDojo任务中，HexoShell都取得了39.7%的成功率，进步分48.0的平均成绩与领跑板相同。这是关于RoboDojo的新艺术 极限是接触，而不是推理：推力达到92.5%，内存任务达到65.0%，但紧插入率只有8.3%。当代理失败时，它通常会看到失败但不能使运动发挥作用。我们开放了迄今在https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell上演变的工具来源。

items.detail: Well-designed prompts are crucial for enhancing Large language models' (LLMs) reasoning capabilities while aligning their outputs with task requirements across diverse domains. However, manually designed prompts require expertise and iterative experimentation. While existing prompt optimization methods aim to automate this process, they rely heavily on external references such as ground truth or by humans, limiting their applicability in real-world scenarios where such data is unavailable or costly to obtain. To address this, we propose Self-Supervised Prompt Optimization (SPO), a cost-efficient framework that discovers effective prompts for both closed and open-ended tasks without requiring external reference. Motivated by the observations that prompt quality manifests directly in LLM outputs and LLMs can effectively assess adherence to task requirements, we derive evaluation and optimization signals purely from output comparisons. Specifically, SPO selects superior prompts through pairwise output comparisons evaluated by an LLM evaluator, followed by an LLM optimizer that aligns outputs with task requirements. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPO outperforms state-of-the-art prompt optimization methods, achieving comparable or superior results with significantly lower costs (e.g., 1.1% to 5.6% of existing methods) and fewer samples (e.g., three samples). The code is available at https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT.
items.title_zh: 自控快速优化
items.detail_zh: 精心设计的提示对于加强大语言模型的推理能力至关重要，同时使其产出符合不同领域的任务要求。然而，人工设计的提示需要专门知识和迭代实验。虽然现有的即时优化方法旨在使这一进程自动化，但它们严重依赖外部参考，例如地面真理或人类的参考，从而限制了这些参考方法在缺乏这类数据或获取这类数据费用高昂的现实世界情景中的适用性。为了解决这个问题，我们提议自我监督的即时优化(SPO)，这是一个成本效益高的框架，可以发现既可以完成封闭的任务，也可以完成开放式的任务，而不需要外部参考。我们的动机是，及时的质量直接体现在LLM产出中，而LLM能够有效地评估对任务要求的遵守情况，因此，我们纯粹通过产出比较得出评价和优化信号。具体来说，SPO通过由LLM评价员评价的对等输出比较来选择上等提示，然后选择LLM优化器，使输出符合任务要求。广泛的实验表明，SPO优于最先进的即时优化方法，取得可比或优异的结果，成本大幅降低(例如现有方法的1.1%至5.6%)并减少样本(例如三个样本)。该代码可在https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT上查阅。

items.detail: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, Ψ_0, ω-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.
items.title_zh: Ropedia W0：利用人类经验在安徽推广Loco-Manipulation世界模式
items.detail_zh: 世界模式使体现的代理人能够预见到行动的后果，但是，由于行动空间各异和多式联运监督有限，在各种表现形式上联合模拟运动和操纵仍然具有挑战性。我们介绍Ropedia W0，这是第一个以自我为中心 游戏操控世界的基础模型，覆盖了人类和机器人，并有着不同的化身。我们管理Xp-Data，包括10k小时的自我中心人类数据和3k小时的机器人数据，并附有统一的多式联运说明和系统的质量控制。统一的动能表现编码通过相机摆设和操纵通过投影骨架进行运动，机器人骨架将浮雕特异性前动能与广泛的手动键点注释和校正相结合。我们还采用了Xp-Teleop，这是一个基于高质量脱氧核糖核酸人电动操作数据的长视离子操纵基准。评估显示，在五个交叉表现基准(DreamDojo、XΨ 0、Xω-HOME、Xp-Teleop和AgiBot)中，以及在从零镜头推论到数镜头和完整数据培训后视频上，表现最先进的表现。扩大人类培训前数据可提高人类和机器人评价的性能。蒸馏后，我们的模型支持实时，一分钟的推出，使VR能够进行现场互动。政策评估、基于模型的规划和世界行动模型方面的应用进一步表明该模型对体现的决策的有用性。

items.detail: Streaming 3D reconstruction aims to recover 3D information, such as camera poses and point clouds, from a video stream, which necessitates geometric accuracy, temporal consistency, and computational efficiency. Motivated by the principles of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), we introduce LingBot-Map, a feed-forward 3D foundation model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data, built upon a geometric context transformer (GCT) architecture. A defining aspect of LingBot-Map lies in its carefully designed attention mechanism, which integrates an anchor context, a pose-reference window, and a trajectory memory to address coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction, respectively. This design keeps the streaming state compact while retaining rich geometric context, enabling stable efficient inference at around 20 FPS on 518 x 378 resolution inputs over long sequences exceeding 10,000 frames. Extensive evaluations across a variety of benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves superior performance compared to both existing streaming and iterative optimization-based approaches.
items.title_zh: 流出 三维重建的几何上下文变换器
items.detail_zh: 流出3D重建旨在从视频流中恢复相机姿势和点云等3D信息，这需要几何精度，时间一致性和计算效率。以同步本地化和绘图(SLAM)的原理为动机，我们引入了LingBot-Map，这是从流数据重建场景的向导3D地基模型，以几何上下文变压器(GCT)架构为基础。 LingBot-Map的一个决定性方面在于它精心设计的注意机制，它分别结合了锚地上下文，姿势参考窗口，以及处理坐标地平线，密度几何提示和远程漂移修正的轨迹记忆。这种设计保持了流体状态紧凑，同时保留了丰富的几何上下文，使得在518×378分辨率输入器上，在超过一万帧的长序上，约能有20个FPS的稳定高效推论。对各种基准的广泛评价表明，与现有的流式和迭代优化办法相比，我们的方法取得了更好的业绩。

items.detail: Massive unstructured multimodal streams suffer from high "data entropy," impeding both efficient human knowledge acquisition and high-quality AI post-training. Existing passive annotation paradigms, heavily reliant on heuristic rules or general VLMs, are costly, monotonous, and fail to unlock the deep procedural logic embedded in raw data. We elevate data processing to a learnable capability, proposing a paradigm shift towards Agentic Data Tailoring, which actively refining and structuring data to align with diverse user and downstream intents. To overcome the data scarcity bottleneck in training such high-order capabilities, we design a two-stage pipeline grounding generative semantic synthesis in deterministic Factual Anchors, yielding a large-scale dataset spanning five core physical and digital domains. Building upon this, DataClaw_0-9B model synergizes Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), achieving robust alignment with complex refinement and tailoring intents. To systematically quantify this capability, we construct DataClaw_0-val, the first benchmark dedicated to data refinement. Crucially, we adopt downstream post-training as the ultimate validation touchstone. Evaluations on video generation, real-world VQA, and GUI navigation confirm that DataClaw_0 delivers high-information-density tailored data, facilitating efficient model adaptation to new tasks under limited training data regimes. Project page: https://czjdsg.github.io/MakeAnyData
items.title_zh: DataClaw0： Raw Streams 的多式联运数据代理
items.detail_zh: 大规模无结构的多式联运流受到高"数据 en"的影响，妨碍了高效的人类知识获取和高质量的AI后培训。现有的被动注解范式，严重依赖heuristic规则或一般的VLM，成本高昂，单调，未能解开嵌入原始数据中的深层程序逻辑。我们把数据处理提升为可学习的能力，提议向“代理数据裁剪”模式转变，积极改进和调整数据结构，使之符合不同的用户和下游意图。为了克服在培训这种高序能力方面的数据稀缺瓶颈，我们设计了确定性事实控制器的两阶段输油管支脉语义合成，产生一个跨越五个核心物理和数字领域的大规模数据集。在此基础上，DataClaw 0-9B模型与集团相对政策优化(GRPO)协同监督精细化(SFT)，实现与复杂精细化和裁剪意图的有力配合。为了系统地量化这一能力，我们构建了DataClaw 0-val，这是第一个专门用于完善数据的基准。关键的是，我们采用下游后训练作为最终验证试金石。对视频生成，现实世界VQA，GUI导航的评价证实，DataClaw 0提供高信息密度定制数据，有利于在有限的培训数据制度下高效的模型适应新任务。项目网页：https://czjdsg.github.io/MakeAnyData

items.detail: We introduce Moshi, a speech-text foundation model and full-duplex spoken dialogue framework. Current systems for spoken dialogue rely on pipelines of independent components, namely voice activity detection, speech recognition, textual dialogue and text-to-speech. Such frameworks cannot emulate the experience of real conversations. First, their complexity induces a latency of several seconds between interactions. Second, text being the intermediate modality for dialogue, non-linguistic information that modifies meaning -- such as emotion or non-speech sounds -- is lost in the interaction. Finally, they rely on a segmentation into speaker turns, which does not take into account overlapping speech, interruptions and interjections. Moshi solves these independent issues altogether by casting spoken dialogue as speech-to-speech generation. Starting from a text language model backbone, Moshi generates speech as tokens from the residual quantizer of a neural audio codec, while modeling separately its own speech and that of the user into parallel streams. This allows for the removal of explicit speaker turns, and the modeling of arbitrary conversational dynamics. We moreover extend the hierarchical semantic-to-acoustic token generation of previous work to first predict time-aligned text tokens as a prefix to audio tokens. Not only this "Inner Monologue" method significantly improves the linguistic quality of generated speech, but we also illustrate how it can provide streaming speech recognition and text-to-speech. Our resulting model is the first real-time full-duplex spoken large language model, with a theoretical latency of 160ms, 200ms in practice, and is available at https://github.com/kyutai-labs/moshi.
items.title_zh: Moshi：实时对话的语音文本基础模型
items.detail_zh: 我们介绍莫希语，一个语音文字基础模型和完全繁复的口头对话框架。目前的口头对话系统依靠独立组成部分的管道，即语音活动检测、语音识别、文字对话和文字对语音。这种框架不能模仿真正对话的经验。首先，它们的复杂性在相互作用之间引起几秒钟的延迟。第二，文本是对话的中间模式，在互动中丢失了修改含义的非语言信息 -- -- 如情感或非语音声音。最后，他们依靠分化为发言转弯，这并没有考虑到发言、中断和插话的重叠。莫希通过将口语对话设定为对口语一代来解决这些独立的问题。从文字语言模型骨干开始，莫希从神经音频编码器的剩余量子中生成语音作为符号，同时将自己的语音和用户的语音分别建模成平行流。这使得可以删除显式的扬声器转动，以及任意对话动态的模型化。此外，我们扩展了前作的等级语义对音符号的生成，首先预测时间对应的文本符号作为音频符号的前缀。不仅这种"内单词"方法大大提高了生成的语音的语言质量，我们还说明了它如何能够提供流传的语音识别和文字对语音。我们由此形成的模式是第一个实时的全方位的大型口语模式，理论延迟160ms，实践200ms，可在https://github.com/kyutai-labs/moshi上查阅。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become an essential infrastructure for Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), yet their lack of well-defined memory management systems hinders the development of long-context reasoning, continual personalization, and knowledge consistency.Existing models mainly rely on static parameters and short-lived contextual states, limiting their ability to track user preferences or update knowledge over extended periods.While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) introduces external knowledge in plain text, it remains a stateless workaround without lifecycle control or integration with persistent representations.Recent work has modeled the training and inference cost of LLMs from a memory hierarchy perspective, showing that introducing an explicit memory layer between parameter memory and external retrieval can substantially reduce these costs by externalizing specific knowledge. Beyond computational efficiency, LLMs face broader challenges arising from how information is distributed over time and context, requiring systems capable of managing heterogeneous knowledge spanning different temporal scales and sources. To address this challenge, we propose MemOS, a memory operating system that treats memory as a manageable system resource. It unifies the representation, scheduling, and evolution of plaintext, activation-based, and parameter-level memories, enabling cost-efficient storage and retrieval. As the basic unit, a MemCube encapsulates both memory content and metadata such as provenance and versioning. MemCubes can be composed, migrated, and fused over time, enabling flexible transitions between memory types and bridging retrieval with parameter-based learning. MemOS establishes a memory-centric system framework that brings controllability, plasticity, and evolvability to LLMs, laying the foundation for continual learning and personalized modeling.
items.title_zh: MemOS：AI系统的内存OS
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)已经成为人工一般智能(AGI)的基本基础设施，然而它们缺乏定义明确的内存管理系统，阻碍了长语推理，持续的个性化和知识一致性的发展。现有的模型主要依靠静态参数和短寿命的上下文状态，限制了它们在长时间内跟踪用户偏好或更新知识的能力。虽然检索-增强的一代(RAG)以简洁的文字介绍外部知识，但它仍然是无国籍的工作，没有生命周期控制或与持续表述相结合。最近的工作从内存结构的角度模拟了LLMs的培训和推论成本，表明在参数内存和外部检索之间引入一个明确的内存层，通过将特定知识外部化，可以大大减少这些成本。除了计算效率之外，法学硕士课程还面临着因信息如何在时间和背景上分布而带来的更广泛的挑战，需要能够管理跨越不同时间尺度和来源的各种知识的系统。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出MemOS，一种将内存视为可管理系统资源的内存操作系统。它统一了纯文本、基于激活的记忆和参数级记忆的表达、时间安排和演变，从而能够以具有成本效益的方式储存和检索。作为基本单元，一个MemCube同时封装内存内容和元数据，如出处和版本。元立方体可以随时间而组成，迁移，并熔化，使内存类型之间能够灵活过渡，并与基于参数的学习连接检索。 MemOS建立了一个以记忆为中心的系统框架，为LLMS带来可控性，可塑性和可转性，为持续学习和个性化建模奠定了基础。

items.detail: We revisit policy-gradient optimization for Large Language Models (LLMs) from a single-stream perspective. Prevailing group-based methods like GRPO reduce variance with on-the-fly baselines but suffer from critical flaws: frequent degenerate groups erase learning signals, and synchronization barriers hinder scalability. We introduce Single-stream Policy Optimization (SPO), which eliminates these issues by design. SPO replaces per-group baselines with a persistent, KL-adaptive value tracker and normalizes advantages globally across the batch, providing a stable, low-variance learning signal for every sample. Being group-free, SPO enables higher throughput and scales effectively in long-horizon or tool-integrated settings where generation times vary. Furthermore, the persistent value tracker naturally enables an adaptive curriculum via prioritized sampling. Experiments using Qwen3-8B show that SPO converges more smoothly and attains higher accuracy than GRPO, while eliminating computation wasted on degenerate groups. Ablation studies confirm that SPO's gains stem from its principled approach to baseline estimation and advantage normalization, offering a more robust and efficient path for LLM reasoning. Across five hard math benchmarks with Qwen3 8B, SPO improves the average maj@32 by +3.4 percentage points (pp) over GRPO, driven by substantial absolute point gains on challenging datasets, including +7.3 pp on BRUMO 25, +4.4 pp on AIME 25, +3.3 pp on HMMT 25, and achieves consistent relative gain in pass@k across the evaluated k values. SPO's success challenges the prevailing trend of adding incidental complexity to RL algorithms, highlighting a path where fundamental principles, not architectural workarounds, drive the next wave of progress in LLM reasoning.
items.title_zh: 单流政策优化
items.detail_zh: 我们从单一流的角度重新审视大语言模型的政策级优化。常用的基于群体的方法，如GRPO，可以减少与飞行基线的差异，但有重大缺陷：经常退化的群体抹去学习信号，同步障碍阻碍伸缩性。我们引入了单流政策优化(SPO)，通过设计消除了这些问题。 SPO用一个持久的，KL的适应性值跟踪器来取代每个组的基线，使整个批量的全球优势正常化，为每个样本提供稳定，低变异的学习信号。 SPO是无组的，它能够在长视野或工具集成的环境下有效提高吞吐量和规模，因为其生成时间各不相同。此外，持久的价值追踪器自然能够通过优先抽样来调整课程。使用Qune3-8B的实验显示，SPO的汇合更平稳，并获得比GRPO更高的精度，同时消除了浪费在退化组上的计算。比较研究证实，SPO的收益来自其对基线估计和优势正常化采取的原则性办法，为LLM推理提供了更有力和更有效的途径。在使用Qwen3 8B的五个硬数学基准中，SPO将平均maj@32比GRPO提高3.4个百分点(pp)，其驱动力是在挑战数据集上获得实质性的绝对点增益，包括BRUMO 25的+7.3页，AIME 25的+4.4页，HMMT 25的+3.3页，并在经过评价的k值之间实现一致的相对增益@k。 SPO的成功挑战了在RL算法中增加偶然复杂性的普遍趋势，突出了一条基本原则而不是建筑工作环绕驱动LLM推理下一波进步的路径。

items.title: VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems
items.subtitle: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. items.detail: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. Across this progression, visual computation has become increasingly adaptive to each input, yet the rules governing that adaptation remain largely prescribed by the trained backbone. We introduce VisionHOPE, the first generic visual backbone formulated as a self-modifying learning system, in which what the model remembers and how it learns co-evolve within an image. Building on the self-referential construction of Nested Learning (NL), VisionHOPE realizes this co-evolution through five coupled memories that store content, generate key and value representations, and govern learning rate and retention. These memories evolve jointly as visual context accumulates along each scan. However, directly applying the unconstrained self-referential update to a visual backbone leads to instability. We therefore derive a stability-matched step-size control scheme that combines a soft cap on self-referential injection with a spectral clamp on the retained memory transition, and prove that the resulting memory dynamics are non-expansive along each scan. For two-dimensional feature maps, we adapt NL's chunk formulation by aligning chunks with image rows and columns across four directional scans. The proposed VisionHOPE achieves competitive results on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K, establishing self-modifying learning systems as a practical foundation for general-purpose visual backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE.
items.title_zh: 愿景：视觉背骨作为自我改进的学习系统
items.detail_zh: 视觉骨干已经从Convolutional Neural Networks(CNNs)演变而来，局部聚合到具有全球互动的ViTs(ViTs)，具有投入依赖状态过渡的State-Space Models(SSM)，以及在处理图像的同时适应内在学习者的TTT(TTT)层。通过这一进展，视觉计算越来越适应于每项投入，然而，关于适应的规则基本上仍然由经过培训的骨干部门规定。我们介绍VisionHOPE，这是第一个作为自我改造的学习系统而形成的通用视觉骨干，在这个系统中，模型记忆了什么，它是如何在图像中共同学习的。在Nested Learning(NL)的自我偏好构建的基础上，VisionHOPE通过存储内容，生成关键和价值表述，规范学习率和保留率的五种组合记忆，实现了这种共同演变。这些记忆随着视觉上下文在每次扫描过程中的积累而共同演化。然而，将不受约束的自我优惠更新直接应用到视觉骨干上会导致不稳定。因此，我们得出一个稳定相匹配的阶梯大小控制方案，将自偏性注射的软盖与保留内存过渡的光谱夹结合起来，并证明所产生的内存动态在每次扫描过程中都是非扩展的。对于二维特征图，我们调整NL的块式配方，通过四个方向扫描将块与图像行和列对齐。拟议的VisualHOPE在ImageNet-1K，COCO，ADE20K上取得了竞争结果，建立了自我修改的学习系统，作为通用视觉骨干的实际基础。该代码可在https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE查询。

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark
items.subtitle: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
items.detail: A design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode that refuses to look AI-generated. usehallmark.com · fifty themes · custom on request · redesign and audit by name Hallmark holds a hard floor and then gets out of the way. It deals three themes from a catalog of fifty materials, builds the page around what the visitor came to do, and lints the result in a real browser against the tells that read as machine-made: the eyebrow above every heading, tracked-capital labels, one coloured word in a headline, a page of empty frames or nothing but photographs, a hero that misses its screen, an email sign-up at the end of every page, a form that says thanks without sending anything. A fresh-context reviewer gets the last word.
items.detail_zh: Claude Code， Codex， Cursor和OpenCode的设计技巧，拒绝外观AI生成。使用hallmark.com (英语)。 · 重新设计和审计Hallmark的名字。它从一个包含50个材料的目录中处理出三个主题，围绕访问者来做的事情构建一页，并用一个真实的浏览器将结果与被读作机器制作的剧情相对照：每个标题上方的眉毛，有追踪的资本标签，头条上一个有彩色的字，一页空框或只是照片，一个错过屏幕的英雄，每个页的结尾有电子邮件的签注，一个不发送任何东西就表示感谢的表格。新语录评论员获得最后一句话。

items.title: pingdotgg/t3code
items.detail: T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app (iOS, Android), web app and Electron-based desktop app. Works with your subscriptions on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Google Antigravity. If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them. Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar.
items.detail_zh: T3代码是"特工控制带表面"。它通过一个最上等的移动应用(iOS，Android)，网络应用和以Electron为基础的桌面应用来控制您机器上的代理。与你的订阅 克劳德代码， Codex， Cursor， Grok Building， OpenCode，和谷歌反重力。如果它们被安装在你的电脑上，T3代码可以控制它们。没什么 我们建立了T3代码，因为我们想要最好的开发经验 与代理。我们受到诸如Codex桌面应用程序、导师、克洛德桌面和光电玻璃等现有解决方案的启发，但都没有遇到我们的酒吧。

items.title: anthropics/skills
items.subtitle: Public repository for Agent Skills
items.detail: Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to improve performance on specialized tasks. Skills teach Claude how to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way, whether that's creating documents with your company's brand guidelines, analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows, or automating personal tasks. This repository contains skills that demonstrate what's possible with Claude's skills system. These skills range from creative applications (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) to enterprise workflows (communications, branding, etc.). Each skill is self-contained in its own folder with a SKILL.md file containing the instructions and metadata that Claude uses. Browse through these skills to get inspiration for your own skills or to understand different patterns and approaches.
items.subtitle_zh: 代理技能公共仓库
items.detail_zh: 技能是克劳德动态地加载以提高专业任务性能的指令，脚本和资源的文件夹。技能教克洛德如何以可重复的方式完成具体的任务，无论是用你的公司的品牌准则创建文件，利用你的组织的具体工作流程分析数据，还是将个人任务自动化。这个寄存器包含了能展示克劳德的技能系统所可能具备的技能。这些技能从创意应用(艺术，音乐，设计)到技术任务(测试网络应用，MCP服务器生成)到企业工作流程(通信，品牌等)。每种技能都自成一体地放入自己的文件夹，其中包含克洛德使用的指令和元数据的一个SKILL.md文件。通过这些技能来浏览以获得对自身技能的启发或理解不同的模式和方法。

items.title: HKUDS/DeepTutor
items.subtitle: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/ .
items.detail: DeepTutor is an agent-native learning workspace that connects tutoring, research, creation, and practice in one extensible system. Choose the installation path that fits how you want to use DeepTutor. Terminal-based installs share one runtime home: private settings live in data/user/settings/ under the launch directory, or under DEEPTUTORHOME / deeptutor start --home when set explicitly. After starting the app, configure a provider and model in Settings → Providers and Language models. Open DeepTutor bundles Python, Node.js, and the full learning workspace, so no terminal or separate runtime installation is needed. Desktop previews are available on dev; the v1.7.0 Release does not include desktop installers.
items.subtitle_zh: 深通通：终身个性化图通。 https://deeptutor.info/ (中文(简体) )。
items.detail_zh: DeepTutor是一个代理-本土学习工作空间，在一个可扩展系统中连接到辅导，研究，创作和实践。选择适合您如何使用 DeepTutor 的安装路径。基于终端的安装共享一个运行时间的家：私人设置生活在发射目录下的数据/用户/设置中，或者在DEEWTUTORHOME / deeptutor start -- home 当明确设定时。在启动应用程序后，在 Sets → 提供者和语言模型中配置一个提供者和模型。打开DeepTutor捆绑了Python，Node.js，以及完整的学习工作空间，因此不需要终端或单独的运行时间安装。桌面预览可在 dev； v1.7。释放不包括桌面安装器。

items.title: max-sixty/worktrunk
items.subtitle: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
items.detail: Worktrunk is a CLI for git worktree management, designed for running AI agents in parallel. Worktrunk's three core commands make worktrees as easy as branches. Plus, Worktrunk has a bunch of quality-of-life features to simplify working with many parallel changes, including hooks to automate local workflows & copy-on-write build caches. AI agents like Claude Code and Codex can handle longer tasks without supervision, such that it's possible to manage 5-10+ in parallel. Git's native worktree feature gives each agent its own working directory, so they don't step on each other's changes.
items.subtitle_zh: Worktrunk是Git工作树管理的CLI，为平行的AI代理工作流程设计。
items.detail_zh: Worktrunk是用于git工作树管理的CLI，旨在并行运行AI代理。 Worktrunk的三个核心指令使工作树和树枝一样容易。另外，Worktrunk还拥有一系列生活质量特性，以简化与许多平行变化一起工作的功能，包括将本地工作流程自动化的钩子和复制-写上构建缓存。 Claude Code和Codex等AI代理可以在没有监督的情况下处理更长的任务，因此可以同时管理5-10+。 Git的原生工作树特征给每个代理都提供了自己的工作目录，所以他们不会踩到对方的变化。

items.title: milind-soni/OpenMausBot
items.subtitle: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
items.detail: The open-source Grok Bot alternative: your own team of AI bots, in a chat app. OpenMausBot is an open-source Grok Bot alternative: an independent project inspired by Grok Bot, and the open-source alternative to Meta Muse, OpenAI dots and Cue by Manus — bring-your-own-agent, local-first, on the models you already have. Also known as MausBot; formerly OpenGrokBot. Not affiliated with xAI, Meta, OpenAI or Manus. Every bot in the sidebar is a real agent — Claude or Codex running locally under the hood — with its own personality, its own model, its own cloud computer, and its own connected apps. Talk to them like contacts. Watch them work. Approve what matters.

items.detail_zh: 开源Grok Bot可选：你自己的AI bots团队，在一个聊天应用中。 OpenMausBot是一个开源的Grok Bot替代方案：由Grok Bot所启发的独立项目，以及由Manus提供的Meta Muse，OpenAI点和Cue的开源替代方案——在您已经拥有的模型上带来-自有代理，本地第一。又名MausBot；前作OpenGrokBot。不隶属于xAI，Meta，OpenAI或Manus。侧边栏中的每个机器人都是真正的代理——克洛德或克洛德克克克克思在引擎盖下在当地运行——拥有自己的个性，自己的模型，自己的云计算机，以及自己的相通的应用。像接触一样跟他们说话 看他们的工作。批准重要的东西。

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.subtitle: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
items.detail: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them. It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it doesn't just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do. Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest.
items.subtitle_zh: 一种有效的代理技能框架和软件开发方法。
items.detail_zh: 超能力(Superpowers)是您编码代理的一种完整的软件开发方法，它建立在一组可堆叠的技能和一些初始指令之上，以确保您的代理使用它们。从你点燃你的编码代理开始 一旦它发现你正在建造某种东西，它就不只是跳跃到试图写代码。相反，它退一步 问你，你到底想做什么。一旦它从对话中取笑了一点，它会用足够短的块来显示它，以实际阅读和消化。

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.subtitle: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
items.detail: Design guidance for AI coding agents. 1 skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration, and 62 deterministic detector rules for AI-generated frontend design. Skip the guidance and you get the same handful of tells on every project: Inter for everything, purple-to-blue gradients, cards nested in cards, gray text on colored backgrounds, the rounded-square icon tile above every heading.

items.subtitle: UI design skill for Claude Code, Codex and other AI agents: explore distinct directions, compare them side by side, refine against real screenshots. 给 AI Agent 用的 UI 设计 Skill。
items.badge: GitHub · 新创建 Skills 仓库
items.author: Python
items.detail: Oil UI is an interface design skill for AI agents. It explores a few genuinely different design directions side by side, lets you choose one, then refines it against real screenshots. It works for websites, apps, dashboards, and components. See more designs at ui.oiloil.org. 1. Understand what the product is. Before drawing anything, it names the product category, finds two or three peers with the most distinctive styles, and looks at what they do and why. Then it decides what to keep and what to change. 2. Turn “premium” and “clean” into real decisions. Everyone uses these words, but they don't tell you what to put on the screen. It first sets the tone from the subject, audience, and brand voice, such as lively or calm, polished or raw, dense or airy. Then it turns that tone into visible choices: which typefaces, how much white space, and how much of the page uses color. 3. Start each direction from something concrete. That could be a material in its setting, a scene, a character, or the visual language of another field. Ideas come from the product itself, not from adjectives like “minimal” or “bold.” 4. Decide who the first screen is for. On pages where people browse, shop, or get work done, the first screen should be the content itself. Only pages meant to persuade need a designed opening layout, settled before the copy is written. 5. Make the directions truly different. Of

items.detail: Research Solution Supervisor 是一个面向研究型工作的 AI 监督 skill。它不负责把研究重新做一遍，而是判断 AI 的回答、研究 pass 或方案建议是否真正推进了用户的研究目标，并把结论转成下一步可执行动作。 这个 skill 借鉴了 Intent Debugger 的思路：先把目标和判断标准说清楚，再评估当前输出是否满足这些标准。不同点在于，Intent Debugger 更偏“把模糊意图变成可确认需求”，Research Solution Supervisor 更偏“监督 AI 是否让研究方案真的向前走”。 1. 推进判断：当前 AI 工作是否解决了本阶段问题。 2. 关键缺口：哪些缺失、冲突或证据不足会影响继续推进。 3. 下一步动作：下一轮最该做什么，必要时给出可直接发送的 prompt。 4. 当前状态：哪些可以暂时视为成立，哪些仍然不能依赖。

items.detail_en: Research Solutions Manager is an AI skiller for research-oriented work. It is not responsible for re-examining research, but rather for determining whether AI ' s answers, studies pass or programme recommendations really advance the user ' s research objectives and translates the conclusions into next implementable actions. This skill draws on the idea of Intent Debugger: first, to clarify the objective and the judgement criteria, then to assess whether the current output meets them. The difference is that the Intent Debugger prefers "to turn vague intent into an identifiable need" and the Research Solutions Manager favours "supervising AI to make research programmes really move forward." 1. Advance judgement: whether the current AI process has resolved this stage of the problem. 2. Key gaps: what are missing, conflicting or insufficient evidence to influence further progress. 3. Next steps: The next round should do the most, giving, if necessary, a prompt that can be sent directly. 4. Current state: which can be considered valid for the time being and which cannot still be relied upon.

items.detail: Live2D Agent Kit 是一套供 Codex 和其他 coding agent 使用的角色制作工具与工作流程，帮助你从参考图或分层 PSD 制作可运行的 Live2D 模型。仓库包含拆层配方、psd2live 适配器、动漫超分脚本、网页预览，以及动作检查和打包工具。 这套流程来自使用 GPT-6 Astra Ultra 完成的角色制作实践。你可以先运行仓库里的示例，再让 agent 按同样的步骤制作自己的角色。单张立绘中被遮住的眼皮、口腔、头发和衣服仍需补画；制作过程中需要确认画风，并检查拆层和动作效果。 Pink Sakura 提供源图、拆层配方、高清运行模型和验证记录。下方截图和动画来自早期眉毛版本的 WebGL 画布；动画使用合成面捕输入。最新手势画面与完整动作检查见手势验证。
items.subtitle_zh: 用于 Codex 和 AI 代理的 Live2D 创建工作流程，其中PSD/PNG 装配， anime 升级， Core/WebGL 验证，以及 VTube Studio 的范例模型。

items.detail_en: Live2D Agent Kit is a role-making tool and workflow for Codex and other coding events to help you make a live2D model from a reference chart or a layered PSD. The warehouse consists of a decrepit formulation, a psd2live adapter, a comic ultra-script script, a page preview, and a motion check and packing tool. This set of processes comes from the role production practice that was done using GPT-6 Astra Ultra. You can start with the examples in the warehouse, and then you can get angent to do the same thing. The eyelids, mouths, hairs and clothing that are covered in a single set of paintings still need to be supplemented; during the production process, the painting needs to be confirmed and the decorative and action effects checked. Pink Sakura provides source maps, tectonic formulations, high-level operating models and validation records. Below are screenshots and animations from the WebGL canvas of the early eyebrow version; animations use synthetic face capture input. The latest gesture image and full action check will be confirmed by the gesture.
